多智能体系统

[MA-0] Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent -Native Trading

【速读】：该论文旨在解决现有生成式AI（Generative AI）代理在动态环境（如金融交易场景）中难以维持可靠状态与上下文一致性的问题。其核心挑战在于，金融市场的价格、新闻、市场条件、投资组合持仓及可用资金等要素持续变化，导致生成结果若无法精确关联时间点、数据快照与执行上下文，则可能失去有效性甚至引发风险。为应对这一问题，论文提出Vibe-Trading——一个原生面向交易的智能体框架与一体化工作空间，其关键解决方案在于构建了一种贯穿“研究到执行”全流程的可追溯架构：所有结果均保留其来源、时间范围、配置参数及生成运行记录；通过共享证据基础实现结果验证，版本化研究记录支持可复现的延续性分析，同时引入显式的权限控制门限，将策略研究与实时执行严格分离。该设计共同构成了一个可追踪、可复现、仅在明确授权下方可执行的交易智能体实践基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24845
作者: Haozhe Wu,Zhonghang Li,Chao Huang
机构: The University of Hong Kong(香港大学); https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Computational Finance (q-fin.CP); Trading and Market Microstructure (q-fin.TR)
备注: Technical report. 16 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Existing AI agents can retrieve information, call tools, run experiments, and produce multi-step outputs. Yet most are built around relatively static workflows and struggle to preserve reliable state as the environment changes. Financial trading makes this limitation especially consequential: prices, news, market conditions, portfolio positions, and available capital evolve continuously. A result is useful only when it remains tied to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context. We present Vibe-Trading, a comprehensive agent-native trading framework and all-in-one workspace for building, evaluating, and evolving agents for financial trading. It unifies market research, financial data, strategy generation, backtesting, portfolio analysis, paper trading, multi-agent collaboration, and optional broker execution. Its central contribution is an architecture that keeps results, evidence, research history, and trading authority connected throughout the research-to-action process. Each result retains its source, temporal scope, configuration, and producing run. Shared evidence grounding enables verification, versioned research records support reproducible continuation, and an explicit authority gate separates strategy research from live execution. Together, these designs provide a practical foundation for trading agents whose results can be traced, reproduced, and acted on only under explicit authority.

[MA-1] Kaer: Security-Aware Replanning for Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（Multi-Agent Systems, MAS）中动态重规划（replanning）阶段的安全漏洞问题。现有架构依赖协调器（orchestrator）根据智能体反馈动态调整计划，但这一过程易受恶意智能体攻击：后者可通过在反馈中嵌入指令，操纵重规划流程以达成非法目标。传统防御措施仅关注工具访问控制或静态预执行策略，无法有效防护重规划阶段的动态威胁。本文提出Kaer框架，其核心解决方案在于实现安全感知的重规划机制：通过抽象故障模板（abstract failure templates）向重规划模块传递诊断信息，严格限制反馈的表达形式；所有计划修改被限定于一组确定性修复算子，并确保更新后的计划始终满足预设策略约束。为评估系统安全性与有效性，作者构建了Cintra基准测试集，包含需重规划的模拟用户任务及针对重规划阶段的对抗性目标。实验表明，相较于未受保护的Magnetic-One和当前最优防御方案ControlValve，Kaer在保持与ControlValve相当的任务完成率的同时，显著提升了对重规划攻击的鲁棒性，证明了其在不暴露协调器于不可信反馈的前提下，实现安全、动态计划修订的可行性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24839
作者: Tushin Mallick,Evan Rose,Matthew Laws,Alina Oprea,Cristina Nita-Rotaru
机构: Northeastern University (东北大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:One popular architecture for multi-agent systems (MAS) relies on an orchestrator that generates an initial plan, coordinates its execution, and dynamically revises the plan based on agent feedback when tasks cannot be fully specified in advance. This dynamic replanning introduces a critical vulnerability: malicious agents can embed instructions within their feedback to hijack the replanning process. Existing defenses focus exclusively on per-tool access control or static, pre-execution policy enforcement, leaving the replanning phase unsecured. We introduce Kaer, a multi-agent framework featuring security-aware replanning. Kaer shields the planner from untrusted agent feedback by conveying diagnostics to the replanning procedure strictly through abstract templates. Plan revisions are restricted to a set of deterministic repair operators, and all modified plans must satisfy preset policies. We create Cintra, a benchmark of simulated user tasks requiring replanning paired with adversarial objectives targeting the replanning phase. Using Cintra, we evaluate both task completion rates and system vulnerability to replanning exploits by malicious agents. Evaluating Kaer on Cintra against Magentic-One (an undefended MAS) and ControlValve (the state-of-the-art defense) demonstrates that Kaer achieves higher robustness than both systems while maintaining comparable utility to ControlValve. Although abstract failure templates slightly constrain utility on select tasks, Kaer enables MAS to perform secure, dynamic plan revisions without exposing the orchestrator to untrusted agent feedback. Subjects: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Machine Learning (cs.LG) Cite as: arXiv:2611.24839 [cs.MA] (or arXiv:2611.24839v1 [cs.MA] for this version) https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2611.24839 Focus to learn more arXiv-issued DOI via DataCite (pending registration)

[MA-2] CaDO: Formal Verification-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Causal Dataset Repair and Generation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决现有因果推理数据集普遍存在的标注错误与结构失衡问题，这些问题会导致模型产生偏差预测并限制其泛化能力。其核心解决方案是提出一种名为CaDO（Causal-Engine-Guided Multi-Agent Data Optimization）的多智能体框架，通过三个关键阶段实现数据的自动诊断与修复：首先，由Formalizer Agent将自然语言问题转化为形式化因果查询，以减少语义偏差并提升可检索性与可验证性；其次，采用双层诊断机制，利用独立的Critic Agent识别样本级错误，并结合查询类型覆盖度与标签分布分析检测数据集层面的结构性失衡；最后，基于形式化因果语义的可复用修复算子对错误样本进行修正，同时由Explorer与Expander Agent协作生成多样化且语义一致的新样本。实验表明，CaDO在18项测试中的16项显著优于五种基线数据清洗方法，下游模型准确率最高提升9.1%；且至少95%被标记的样本确实存在缺陷，其在CLadder数据集上误修改正确标签的比例比基于大语言模型的判别器低92.2%，充分体现了该框架在准确性与可靠性方面的优势。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24406
作者: Songli Yu,Qi Luo
机构: Shandong University (山东大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:High-quality causal reasoning datasets are essential for developing models with reliable causal understanding, particularly in specialized domains. However, existing datasets frequently suffer from incorrect annotations and structural imbalances, which can lead to biased predictions and limited generalization. To address this issue, we propose CaDO (Causal-Engine-Guided Multi-Agent Data Optimization), a multi-agent framework for automated diagnosis and repair of causal reasoning datasets. Our framework consists of three key stages: formal causal reasoning, multi-level diagnosis, and automated data repair and generation. First, a Formalizer Agent translates natural language questions into formal causal queries to minimize semantic deviations and make retrieval and verification more explicit and tractable. Second, a dual-level diagnosis mechanism employs independent Critic Agents to identify sample-level errors while analyzing query-type coverage and label distributions to detect dataset-level structural imbalances. Finally, the framework employs reusable repair operators grounded in formal causal semantics to correct erroneous samples, while Explorer and Expander Agent collaboratively produce diverse and semantically consistent new samples. Experimental results show that CaDO significantly outperforms the strongest of five data cleaning baselines in 16 out of 18 experimental settings, improving downstream model accuracy by up to 9.1%. Moreover, at least 95% of the samples flagged by CaDO are defective, and on CLadder, CaDO incorrectly modifies 92.2% fewer correct labels than an LLM-based judge, demonstrating its effectiveness and reliability. Our code and data are publicly available at this https URL.

[MA-3] OpenKAGE: Open-Ended Lifelong Learning in the Open World via Knowledge-Sharing Agent -Group Evolution

【速读】：该论文旨在解决如何实现开放世界中持续不断的终身学习（lifelong learning）问题，特别是克服现有研究中局限于预设任务、课程或目标的局限性，以及个体智能体自我提升能力有限的瓶颈。其核心挑战在于如何使智能体群体在动态开放环境中自主探索，并通过累积与共享经验持续获得新能力。解决方案的关键在于提出OpenKAGE框架，该框架包含两个核心机制：一是双层知识表示结构，包括用于情境记忆的内存层和用于可迁移经验与技能的体验层，后者保留了技能复用所需的适用条件；二是语义化知识共享机制，将文本形式的经验进行语义整合并存入持续演化的共享知识图谱，同时以原始形式共享可执行技能。该框架在Minecraft环境中验证了其支持开放式终身学习的能力，使智能体群体能够持续探索并达成高级技术里程碑，且积累的知识可跨模型迁移到新初始化的智能体群体中，显著提升其生存与探索效率。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24302
作者: Wenhao Yuan,Longhui Yuan,Zexi Jia,Ningzhe Shi,Jingwei Li,Shipeng Cen,Pengcheng Luo,Jie Zhou,Jinchao Zhang
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Building autonomous agents that continually explore open worlds and acquire new capabilities through experience is a long-standing aspiration in artificial intelligence. Existing research often pursues lifelong learning within predefined tasks, curricula, or objectives, with self-improvement largely confined to individual agents. We introduce OpenKAGE, an agent-group evolution framework for open-ended lifelong learning. Within this framework, agents autonomously explore open worlds and continually acquire new capabilities by accumulating and reusing knowledge from their own interactions and the experience of others. OpenKAGE builds on two key mechanisms: (1) a two-layer knowledge representation, with a memory layer for situated memories and an experience layer for transferable experience and skills that retains the applicability conditions needed for reuse; and (2) a knowledge-sharing mechanism that semantically consolidates textual experience into a continuously evolving shared knowledge graph, while executable skills are shared verbatim. In Minecraft, OpenKAGE supports open-ended lifelong learning, enabling agent groups to sustain exploration and reach advanced technological milestones. Furthermore, the accumulated knowledge can be transferred to a newly initialized agent group on a different backbone model, improving its survival and exploration progress.

[MA-4] Asymmetric Decomposition for Multi-Agent Path Finding with Unassigned Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体路径规划中未分配任务的智能体（unassigned agents）带来的冲突与效率问题：传统方法要么因强制将无任务智能体停靠至指定停车位导致不必要的移动，要么因未分配智能体自由行动而干扰已有任务智能体的路径。为此，论文提出流-预言机冲突基础搜索（Flow-oracle Conflict-Based Search, FOCBS），其核心解决方案是将已分配任务智能体的路径搜索与未分配智能体的路径规划解耦：利用冲突基础搜索（CBS）优化已分配智能体的路径，同时通过最小费用流（min-cost flow）预言机为无目标的未分配智能体规划路径。当所选已分配智能体路径导致未分配智能体无法找到无碰撞路径时，采用“流-冲突分支”机制，将最小割阻塞者转化为已分配智能体的约束，从而引导搜索过程并保证全局最优解不被排除。此外，引入批量零成本预热（batched zero-cost warm start）加速预言机求解，并采用起始点规避的优先级策略减少未分配智能体的移动。理论上，对于有限图上的可行实例，FOCBS可保证终止性，并实现已分配智能体服务时间总和（以最晚到达时间衡量）的全局最小化；对未分配智能体的移动则在给定已分配路径下实现局部最小化，但不保证全局字典序最优。基准测试表明，FOCBS能有效扩展至大量未分配智能体场景，消融实验显示相比舍弃不可完成的已分配路径方案，流-冲突分支显著提升可解实例数量且保持最优性。仿真与真实机器人实验验证了规划方案的可执行性，实验室测试显示车队行驶距离相较基于停靠的协调基线降低40.8%。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24108
作者: Xi Jin,Chen Qian,Renjun Zhang,Guowei Wu,Xiaobo Li,Jun Jiang,Weiwei Shang
机构: University of Science and Technology of China (中国科学技术大学); State Key Laboratory of Precision and Intelligent Chemistry (精密智能化学国家重点实验室); Hefei National Laboratory (合肥国家实验室)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Robots without assigned tasks may obstruct active robots, while routing them to designated parking locations can cause unnecessary travel. This article proposes flow-oracle conflict-based search (FOCBS) for Multi-Agent Path Finding with unassigned agents (MAPF-UA). FOCBS searches over assigned-agent paths using conflict-based search (CBS) and routes targetless unassigned agents through a min-cost flow oracle. When the selected assigned-agent paths leave unassigned agents no collision-free paths, flow-conflict branching converts min-cut blockers into assigned-agent constraints, which guide the search without excluding optimal solutions. A batched zero-cost warm start accelerates the oracle, and start-avoiding tie-breaking reduces unassigned-agent movement. For feasible instances on finite graphs, we prove termination and global minimization of assigned-agent sum of service time, measured by last-arrival times. Unassigned-agent movement is minimized conditional on the selected assigned-agent paths, without a global lexicographic optimality guarantee. Benchmark experiments show that FOCBS scales well with the number of unassigned agents, and ablation studies show that, compared with discarding non-completable assigned-agent paths, flow-conflict branching solves substantially more instances while retaining optimality. Simulation and physical-robot experiments demonstrate plan executability, with laboratory tests reducing fleet travel by 40.8% relative to the parking-based coordination baseline. The source code and related resources are available at this https URL

[MA-5] A Capability Framework for Evaluating Agent ic AI Platforms in Regulated Enterprises

【速读】：该论文旨在解决企业在采购生成式 AI (Generative AI) 平台时面临的评估困境：尽管企业正快速引入集成化智能体平台（Agentic AI platforms），但缺乏可量化、可重复的评估方法。现有公开基准测试多在固定框架下评估模型性能，而企业实际采购的是包含规划、工具调用、记忆保持与协同控制等复杂能力的完整系统，其架构设计、治理机制、工具链和内存管理等因素对最终表现起主导作用，导致评估高度依赖供应商演示，存在主观偏差。为应对这一问题，研究团队在一家全球性银行的创新实验室组织了一场工业级“竞品评测”（bakeoff），对十种平台（涵盖开源框架、专有产品及云服务商生态）在九个能力维度上，针对三个金融业务场景（对手方信用风险评估、检索增强生成、流程自动化）进行了跨职能评审。结果显示，平台表现可稳定划分为三个层级，并暴露出聚合评分掩盖的场景特异性优势。然而，二次分析揭示各维度间存在极强内部一致性（Cronbach’s alpha = 0.98）及与总分高度相关（8/9维度秩相关系数达0.93），表明评估结果可能主要反映演示呈现质量而非真实能力，即存在显著“光环效应”。基于此，论文提出“先准入后评分”的四层评估协议：包括能力、执行可靠性、治理准入、业务价值四个层级；引入基于多次运行的细粒度可靠性指标；建立自主性就绪度量表；并制定可复现的评估规程。该方案明确界定了当前证据所能支持的结论边界，并强调唯有通过受控实验环境才能将企业级平台评估从主观判断转变为可测量的科学评估。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24039
作者: Abbas Raza Ali,Muhammad Ajmal Siddiqui,Moona Zahid
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Machine Learning (stat.ML)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic AI platforms-systems in which LLM agents plan, invoke tools, retain memory and coordinate to change the state of enterprise systems-are being procured faster than they can be measured. Public agent benchmarks score models in fixed harnesses; enterprises buy integrated platforms whose orchestration, memory, governance and tooling layers dominate outcomes, and they buy them largely on the strength of vendor demonstrations. We report an industrial evaluation programme (“bakeoff”) run by the innovation laboratory of a global bank in which ten platforms-spanning open-source frameworks, proprietary products and hyperscaler ecosystems-were assessed by a cross-functional panel on nine capability dimensions across three financial-services workloads: counterparty credit risk, retrieval-augmented generation and process automation. Scores separate the field into three tiers that are stable under alternative weightings, and surface workload-specific strengths that aggregates hide. A secondary analysis, however, finds Cronbach’s alpha = 0.98 across nominally distinct dimensions and rank correlations = 0.93 with the total for eight of nine: a halo effect indicating that demonstration-based scoring measures presentation as much as capability. From these lessons we propose a gate-then-score evaluation protocol with four layers (capability, execution reliability, governance gates, business value), trace-level reliability metrics estimated over repeated runs, an autonomy-readiness scale and a reproducibility protocol. We state precisely what the present evidence supports, and what a controlled harness must add to turn enterprise platform evaluation from structured judgement into measurement.

[MA-6] FormalFixer: Intent-Aligned Automated Hardware Repair via Joint Refinement of Specifications Assertions and RTL Implementations

【速读】：该论文旨在解决硬件设计中形式化属性验证（Formal Property Verification, FPV）失败时的修复难题，尤其针对因断言（assertion）错误或规格说明（specification）语义模糊/不完整导致的误报问题。现有以寄存器传输级（RTL）为中心的修复方法无法有效协调规格意图、验证意图与RTL行为之间的一致性，从而难以准确判断应修改哪个设计元素。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种多阶段、意图对齐的修复工作流——\textscFormalFixer，该方法将原始规格说明作为权威基准，并通过置信度过滤后的细化内容来显式澄清隐含约束；同时利用意图不匹配分析与验证器生成的反例锥形图（counterexample cone graphs）双重引导迭代式RTL修补过程，明确检查规格—断言—RTL三者之间的对应关系，从而实现基于FPV的硬件修复中的意图对齐。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24037
作者: Changyuan Yu,Hongce Zhang
机构: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Functional errors in hardware designs can compromise correctness and security, and must be fixed before tape-out. Formal property verification (FPV) provides strong guarantees by proving or refuting assertions, but a failed assertion is not always evidence of an RTL defect: the failure may also come from a buggy assertion or from a specification that is semantically correct but too ambiguous or incomplete for direct formalization. This creates a practical repair problem that existing RTL-centric methods do not directly address: the repair loop must align specification intent, verification intent, and RTL behavior before deciding which artifact to change. \textscFormalFixer addresses this problem with a multi-stage, intent-aligned repair workflow for Verilog designs with assertions. It preserves the original specification as authoritative ground truth and appends confidence-filtered refinements to clarify implicit constraints. \textscFormalFixer uses both intent mismatch and verifier-generated counterexample cone graphs to guide iterative RTL patching. This workflow explicitly checks specification–assertion–RTL correspondence. Results support intent alignment for FPV-based hardware repair. [MA-7] SCAFFOLD: Toward Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport for Reusable LLM -Agent Skills

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在动态环境中，智能体技能（agent skill）即使在过去被验证有效，也可能因上下文变更、权限调整或规范错误而不再适配当前使用场景的问题。其核心挑战在于：传统验证机制往往仅关注可观察的契约条款或结果断言（outcome oracle），缺乏对历史证据在上下文变化后是否仍具可采性的系统性判断，导致错误重用风险。解决方案的关键是提出“有理由的重用主张”（Warranted Reuse Claim, WRC），即一种可反驳的、与特定版本技能、目标上下文、证据、假设及已知反例（defeaters）绑定的授权声明。进一步，论文引入“担保保持的证据传输”（Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport, WPET）机制，明确区分证据可采性与所支持的安全性/有效性主张的真实性，提供三值适用性判断与非对称上下文转移规则，并揭示证明溯源依赖性与策略失效变更如何影响授权状态。该方法不追求对现有保障论证（assurance cases）、合同或技能库维护模式的颠覆性创新，而是通过形式化问题定义、可检验的设计义务与报告协议，为未来构建具备版本感知能力的可信重用体系提供理论基础与评估框架。

作者: Nami Cho,Shailja Gupta

Abstract:An agent skill that succeeded yesterday may be executable today without being justified for reuse today. Tests may cover only observable contract clauses, outcome oracles may be absent, evaluations may inherit the same erroneous specification, and permissions or dependencies may change between validation and invocation. We argue that the appropriate unit of prospective trust is a Warranted Reuse Claim (WRC): a defeasible, claim-specific authorization tied to a versioned skill, target context, evidence, assumptions, and identified defeaters. The paper sharpens this position through Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport (WPET), a proposed discipline for deciding which historical evidence remains admissible after context change. It distinguishes evidence admissibility from truth of the supported safety or effectiveness claim; states a conditional preservation result and its limits; specifies three-valued applicability and asymmetric context-transfer judgments; and illustrates how provenance dependence and policy-invalidating changes alter authorization. We explicitly relate the proposal to assurance cases, contracts, and skill-library maintenance rather than claiming novelty for their ingredients. A falsifiable longitudinal evaluation would compare WRC-guided policies with strong version-aware baselines at matched coverage, utility, and review cost. This paper contributes a formalized problem statement, testable design obligations, and reporting protocol, not an implemented verifier, empirical superiority result, or proof of universal agent safety.

[MA-8] Resilient Federated LQR over Noisy and Lossy Uplinks via Scalar Communication

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在通信受限（包括带宽有限、数据包丢失和加性噪声）的上行链路环境下，如何实现对一组相似系统协同优化的无模型联邦学习（model-free federated learning）问题，具体目标是设计一个能够稳定收敛且高效通信的LQR（Linear Quadratic Regulator）控制器联合学习框架。其核心挑战在于，在资源受限条件下，如何在保证系统稳定性与控制性能的前提下，减少通信开销并应对异构性、采样误差与通信扰动的影响。解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为 \textscResiFedLQR 的标量通信机制，即每个智能体每轮仅发送一个实数（而非完整的梯度向量），通过冗余传输提升鲁棒性；该标量可为梯度坐标、基于共享随机种子在服务器端复现的随机方向上的梯度投影，或直接为轨迹代价（rollout cost）。对于投影编码方式，论文证明了在高概率意义下，所有迭代均能稳定各智能体，且群体平均代价以线性速率收敛至一个由异质性、采样误差和通信扰动共同决定的邻域内，并据此推导出基于信道参数与车队规模的最优传输次数选择规则。进一步地，通过与全梯度传输在相同上行预算下的对比分析，识别出在不同信噪比环境及功率约束下，何种编码方式更具优势。数值实验在异构车队场景中验证了所提方法在不同噪声水平与丢包率下的稳定性与收敛性表现。

Abstract:This paper studies model-free federated learning of a common LQR controller for a fleet of similar systems that communicate with a server over an uplink subject to limited bandwidth, packet dropout, and additive noise. We propose \textscResiFedLQR, a scalar communication scheme in which each agent sends one real number per packet, with redundancy, instead of full gradient estimates. The scalars can be gradient coordinates, projections of the gradient onto random directions reproduced at the server from a shared seed, or the rollout costs themselves. For the projection encoding, we prove that, with high probability, every iterate stabilizes all agents and the fleet-average cost converges linearly to a neighborhood of the optimum whose radius separates heterogeneity, sampling, and communication effects, and we derive a rule for choosing the number of transmissions from the channel parameters and the fleet size. We then compare the encodings with full-gradient transmission under the same uplink budget and identify the signal-to-noise regime and power constraint under which each is preferable. Numerical experiments on a heterogeneous fleet evaluate stability and convergence under varying noise levels and dropout probabilities.

[MA-9] CoSlice: Coordinated Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for 5G Network Slicing Allocation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决开放无线接入网（O-RAN）中多切片间物理资源块（PRB）分配的协同优化问题，其核心挑战在于：各切片需在满足服务等级协议（SLA）的前提下最小化资源消耗，而所有切片又共享有限的无线资源，由此引发切片内部的SLA保障与资源效率之间的权衡，以及切片间的资源竞争冲突。为应对这一复杂动态博弈场景，论文提出CoSlice框架，其关键创新在于采用“偏好条件化的切片智能体”实现快速局部决策，并引入基于大语言模型（LLM）的协调器，在较慢时间尺度上利用全局网络状态信息动态调整各切片的目标偏好，从而实现跨切片的协同控制。该方法被形式化为多目标部分可观测随机博弈（mo-POSG），证明了偏好相关均衡的存在性，并给出了子线性后悔率的理论保证。通过两阶段训练（多目标预训练与联合优化），结合ORANSlice与射频仿真器（RFsim）构建的真实协议栈与业务流量环境进行验证，实验表明CoSlice在多种切片负载下均显著降低了平均及尾部的SLA违规率，优于现有集中式与多智能体基线方法。

机构: University of Arizona (亚利桑那大学); Nokia Bell Labs (诺基亚贝尔实验室)
类目: Networking and Internet Architecture (cs.NI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Radio Access Network (RAN) slicing is a shared resource allocation problem: each slice seeks to satisfy its Service Level Agreement (SLA) with minimal radio-resource consumption, while all slices compete for a limited resource budget. This creates both an intra-slice trade-off between SLA assurance and resource efficiency and an inter-slice conflict over shared resources, calling for specialized yet coordinated control. In this work, we present CoSlice, a coordinated multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for inter-slice physical resource block allocation in Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN). CoSlice uses preference-conditioned slice agents for fast resource allocation and an LLM-based coordinator to adapt their objectives using global network observations at a slower timescale. We formulate the problem as a multi-objective partially observable stochastic game (mo-POSG), establish the existence of a Preference Correlated Equilibrium, and derive a sublinear regret bound for the learning procedure. We implement the algorithm by using a two-stage training procedure that consists of multi-objective pretraining and joint optimization. We build a network slicing evaluation environment using ORANSlice and its radio-frequency simulator (RFsim), supporting realistic protocol-stack execution and application traffic across multiple slices. Experimental results show that CoSlice reduces both average and tail SLA violations compared with other centralized and multi-agent baselines under diverse slice workloads.

[MA-10] A Comparison of Heuristic Human-Sensitive and Self-Play DRL Policies in Human-Agent Teaming

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在人机协作任务中，如何使人工智能代理（AI Agent, AA）生成与人类行为模式一致的动态感知-运动基元（Dynamical Perceptual-Motor Primitives, DPMP）动作序列的问题。传统方法依赖从人类行为中提取的启发式规则来指导目标选择与动作排序，虽在结构化任务中有效，但在复杂情境下泛化能力有限。为此，研究探索了基于深度强化学习（Deep Reinforcement Learning, DRL）的决策策略以自动学习人机交互中的行为模式。其解决方案的关键在于设计一种“人类敏感型”深度强化学习策略（Human-Sensitive DRL, HS-DRL），该策略通过与一个启发式代理共同训练，确保学习到的策略保持与人类行为的一致性。实验结果表明，相较于自对弈训练的DRL策略（SP-DRL）所表现出的显著偏离，HS-DRL策略在协调模式上更接近典型的人类-人类协作行为，而启发式策略仍表现最佳。这表明，在构建面向人机协同的智能体时，引入人类先验知识进行训练至关重要，且简单启发式策略在保证人类对齐性方面仍具有效性和实用性。

机构: Scuola Superiore Meridionale(南意大利高级学院); University of Naples Federico II(那不勒斯费德里科二世大学); Macquarie University(麦考瑞大学); University College London(伦敦大学学院)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注: 9 pages, 5 figures. Includes Supplementary Material A (1 page, 0 figures), B (1 page, 0 figures), and C (54 pages, 216 figures). Submitted to IEEE HMS for possible publication

Abstract:Dynamical Perceptual-Motor Primitives (DPMPs) offer a tractable framework for generating human-like movement dynamics in artificial agents (AAs) and have been used to support coordination in human-AI teaming tasks. Traditionally, DPMP controllers rely on heuristic (rule-based) decision policies derived from human behavior to guide goal selection and action sequencing. Although effective in structured tasks, such heuristics can be difficult to generalize to more complex settings, motivating interest in deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches for learning decision policies for human-AI interaction. A key challenge, however, is ensuring that DRL policies remain aligned with human strategies, particularly when agents are trained through self-play. To examine this issue, we compared three target-selection policies governing DPMP-based AAs in a first-person herding task: (1) a human-derived heuristic policy, (2) a self-play DRL policy (SP-DRL), and (3) a human-sensitive DRL policy (HS-DRL) trained alongside a heuristic agent. Results showed that heuristic agents most closely matched typical human-human coordination patterns, followed by HS-DRL agents, whereas SP-DRL agents deviated most. These findings highlight the importance of human-informed training when developing DRL-based teammates and suggest that simple heuristic policies may remain an effective approach for designing human-aligned AAs capable of human-AI collaboration.

[MA-11] wo is better than one: optimizing binary rating scales for online platforms

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在线平台中用户评分普遍存在的虚高且信息量不足的问题。其核心挑战在于如何通过优化数据收集机制，提升评分系统对物品真实质量的区分能力。解决方案的关键在于引入多尺度评分设计：首先，证明将单一评分尺度拆分为两个子尺度可始终改善物品排序效果；其次，形式化地揭示了最优多尺度设计应表现为一系列阈值等距分布的0-1阶跃函数；最后，提出一种自适应模型，允许后续评分尺度根据前序用户的反馈动态调整，并基于物品的完整响应序列进行排序，结果表明自适应机制能带来指数级增强的区分能力。总体而言，该研究证明，采用多种评分尺度显著提升了平台上的物品排序质量。

机构: Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago(丰田理工学院芝加哥分校); University of Chicago(芝加哥大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

Abstract:Online platforms often struggle with inflated, uninformative user ratings. This issue can be mitigated by better design of the data collection mechanism, for example through changing the phrasing of user questions. Previous work optimizes a single rating scale to best distinguish the inherent qualities of items under binary feedback. In this paper, we demonstrate the power of utilizing different rating scales for different users. First, we show that a designer can always split a single rating scale into two to improve item rankings. Next, we formally characterize the optimal design of multiple scales as a series of 0-1 step functions whose threshold values are evenly spaced. Finally, we consider an adaptive model where subsequent rating scales can depend on the responses from previous users and items are ranked by their full sequence of responses, and show that adaptivity leads to exponentially greater distinguishing power. All in all, our theoretical results show that using multiple rating scales significantly improves item rankings on platforms.

[MA-12] MANGO Arena: Same Seeds Different Chains Evaluating LLM Agents in a Disrupted Supply Chain

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统中大型语言模型（LLM）在复杂供应链环境中行为评估的可靠性问题，尤其关注其在面对动态需求与突发扰动时的经济效率、规则遵守能力及潜在合谋倾向。其核心挑战在于现有评估方法难以有效区分智能体的真实策略表现与由API调用失败或推理过程异常引入的噪声。解决方案的关键在于构建一个开放的测试平台——MANGO Arena，该平台基于真实课堂工厂管理游戏MANGO设计，模拟包含四个代理（分别代表零售商、制造商、供应商等）的串行供应链，并通过硬性约束（如运输车辆数量限制、无信用现金约束、生产容量上限）强化环境规则，同时设置公开消息板以禁止隐性利益交换。该设计使得同一环境可同步度量三大关键指标：供需波动放大效应（即“牛鞭效应”）、压力下的规则遵循情况以及合谋提议行为。实验结果显示，尽管所有LLM代理均显著放大了上游需求波动（在供应商端放大达13至179倍），远超经典订货策略，但实际违规行为极少，且未出现任何形式的金钱侧支付提议。然而，研究揭示了一个关键问题：API调用失败（如速率限制、隐藏推理失控）被错误地记录为“无订单”决策，导致评估结果严重失真；在相同初始条件下重跑实验后，上游牛鞭效应的变化幅度可达17倍之多，表明部分结论不具备可重复性。因此，论文强调必须建立透明、可复现的多智能体评估报告规范，包括公开代码、提示模板和全部日志记录，以提升评估可信度。

Abstract:We introduce MANGO Arena, an open-source testbed in which four LLM agents each run one company in a serial supply chain adapted from MANGO, a classroom factory-management game. The environment enforces hard rules (a truck limit, a no-credit cash constraint and production capacity), logs every blocked attempt to break them, and gives agents a public message board on which side payments are explicitly forbidden. This lets one environment measure three things at once: an economic outcome (the bullwhip effect), rule adherence under pressure, and proposals to collude. In a pilot with three small reasoning models, two scripted reference policies, two conditions (with and without a supplier fire) and three demand seeds, all LLM agents amplified demand variability as it moved upstream, by 7 to 25 times at the Retailer and 13 to 179 times at the Supplier, often more than a textbook order-up-to policy. They did so largely by ordering in batches (zero orders in up to 60% of decisions). Real rule violations were rare (at most 7 of 288 decisions per model) and no agent proposed a money side deal. The pilot’s main lesson concerns evaluation method. API failures (rate limits and runaway hidden reasoning) entered the metrics silently as “no order” decisions. And when we reran games with the same seeds and no failed calls, upstream bullwhip changed by up to 17 times between runs. With three seeds, conclusions about how a disruption affects a given model did not survive a rerun. We report these failures in full and propose reporting practices for multi-agent evaluations of this kind. Code, prompts and every logged decision are public.

[MA-13] ARISE: Practical Self-Evolving Memory for Accurate and Cost-Efficient Enterprise Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决企业级大语言模型（LLM）代理在动态环境中面临的持续性能衰减问题，即基础模型迭代、工作流频繁更新以及部署需兼顾准确性与成本约束的挑战。其核心解决方案是提出一种名为ARISE（Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation）的可迭代自评估记忆架构，通过代理自身对失败进行归因并生成修正策略，无需更新模型权重、工具或工作流逻辑，即可实现性能提升。ARISE的关键在于：利用模型自身或教师模型对执行失败进行诊断并提出修正方案，将这些修正以可检索的微记忆形式存储，并进一步归纳为宏观规则；仅当保留集上的准确率提升时才接受规则更新，从而确保改进的可靠性。实验结果表明，在SOP-Bench和τ²-bench共14个企业工作流领域上，ARISE-Teacher相较于基线分别提升10.9个百分点和5.8个百分点，且在相同任务成本下减少4.0%的模型调用次数与5.2%的输出令牌数，验证了其高效性与实用性。

作者: Jiangyun Zhang,Zhou Tang,Kristen Surrao,Zhiyu Chen,Albert Guan,Tor Nitayanont,Yupei Zhang,Roopali Singh,Yunkai Xiao,Shreya Pandit,Julia Huang,Shayan Ali Akbar,Erwin Cornejo,Yuan Li,Yi Zhang
机构: Amazon(亚马逊)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Enterprise LLM agents operate in dynamic environments where foundation models evolve rapidly, workflows update frequently, and deployments need to satisfy accuracy and cost requirements. We propose ARISE (Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation), a practical memory architecture in which the agent’s memory evolves from its own failures without updating model weights, tools, or workflow logic. ARISE uses the model itself or a teacher model to attribute the failures and propose corrections. Then, ARISE keeps the corrections as retrievable micro memory, consolidates them into macro rules, and accepts a rule update only if held-out accuracy rises. Across 14 enterprise-workflow domains from SOP-Bench and \tau^2 -bench using 5 models, ARISE-Teacher, which uses Claude Opus 4.6 for attribution and consolidation, gains 10.9 pp over the baseline on SOP-Bench and 5.8 pp on \tau^2 -bench. ARISE-Teacher also outperforms GEPA by 4.5 pp on \tau^2 -bench and 1.4 pp on SOP-Bench. With the deployment model as its own attributor, ARISE-Self still gains 10.0 pp on SOP-Bench. ARISE-Teacher uses 4.0% fewer model calls and 5.2% fewer output tokens at comparable per-task cost (-1.0%).

[MA-14] Encapsulating Reactive Behaviour in Goal-based Plans for Programming BDI Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决基于信念-欲望-意图（Belief-Desire-Intention, BDI）的智能体编程中，反应式行为通常以与特定目标无关的反应式计划（reactive plans）形式进行描述所导致的灵活性与可维护性不足的问题。其核心解决方案在于提出一种扩展的计划模型，将目标驱动的计划（goal-based plans）引入BDI编程语言的计划体系，使同一计划既能表达主动行为（proactive behavior）又能封装反应式行为（reactive behavior）。这一关键改进不仅提升了智能体编程的实际便利性，还增强了运行时推理能力，支持更高效、一致的行为协调。通过在Jason和ASTRA两个现有智能体编程平台上的具体实现与实验验证，结果表明该方法在编程优雅性与执行效率方面均具有显著优势。

Abstract:Reactive behaviour in BDI-based models and architectures adopted in agent programming is typically specified in terms of reactive plans not bound to any specific goal. In this paper, we present and discuss an extension of the plan model used in BDI programming languages in which goal-based plans encapsulate both proactive and reactive behaviour. This brings important benefits both to the practice of agent programming and in supporting agent reasoning at runtime. The paper first introduces the model formally, abstracting away from particular programming languages. The approach is then evaluated through concrete implementations based on two existing agent programming platforms, namely Jason and ASTRA. The paper reports on experiments showing that the approach provides for elegant programming and can also be efficient.

[MA-15] Verifiably Safe Decentralized Control via Event-Triggered Topology Switching

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统在估计不确定性下，如何实现安全、高效且间歇性通信的问题。核心挑战在于，在通信资源受限的环境中，各智能体需在保持系统状态安全的前提下，自主决定何时连接或断开通信，同时避免Zeno行为（即无限频繁地触发通信事件）。解决方案的关键在于提出一种去中心化的事件触发型拓扑切换协议，其遵循“安全驱动”的触发原则：智能体在本地计算可验证的安全证书，并在证书接近安全边界前主动重新连接，仅在恢复至更严格的安全阈值以下时才允许断开连接。该机制确保了估计误差始终被约束在可认证的安全范围内，同时实现了通信的间歇性与系统的安全性。通过四水箱系统的仿真实验验证，该协议能够在大部分运行时间内允许智能体断开连接的同时，始终保持各水箱液位偏差在安全限值内。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23415
作者: Amber He Wei,Shiyu Cheng,Andrew Clark,Bruno Sinopoli
机构: Washington University in St. Louis (圣路易斯华盛顿大学); Arizona State University (亚利桑那州立大学)
类目: ystems and Control (eess.SY); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This paper proposes a decentralized event-triggered topology-switching protocol for multi-agent systems under estimation uncertainty. We consider an intermittent communication setting in which each agent switches between connected and disconnected modes and makes communication decisions using locally computable certificates, while the closed-loop state is required to remain safe. The proposed protocol follows a safety-driven triggering principle in which agents reconnect before their certificates reach the safety boundary and disconnect only after recovering to a stricter bound below the safety limit. Our design enables intermittent connectivity while maintaining the estimation error within a certified safety bound and excluding Zeno behavior. We evaluate the proposed protocol on a quadruple-tank example, showing that it keeps all tank deviations within the safety bound while allowing agents to remain disconnected for most of the run.

[MA-16] RACE-MAS: Diagnosing and Repairing Collaboration Failures in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（Multi-Agent System, MAS）中由智能体间交互异常引发的故障诊断与修复难题。现有防护机制仅关注单个智能体层面的异常检测，难以有效识别源于智能体间通信、任务依赖关系等交互层面的故障，且检测到的异常往往无法准确回溯至真实根源。为此，本文提出一种细粒度的故障诊断与修复框架——TRACE-MAS。其核心在于通过学习正常协作执行轨迹，建模智能体状态变化、消息流转及任务依赖演化等多维度行为模式，并基于源感知归因（source-aware attribution）机制精准定位故障责任单元；同时，通过最小化干预策略，在恢复协作能力的同时最大限度保留关键任务功能。实验结果表明，该方法在五类典型MAS基准测试中，将根因定位准确率提升60.2%，并在任务恢复性能上显著优于现有强健性保障方案。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23362
作者: Zekai Chen,Yihan Sun,Xunkai Li,Xun Wu,Xinmo Jin,Yinlin Zhu,Haodong Lu,Xuaner Chen,Rong-Hua Li
机构: Beijing Institute of Technology(北京理工大学); Minzu University of China(中央民族大学); Sun Yat-sen University(中山大学); Shandong University, Weihai(山东大学威海分校)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on not only individual agent behaviors but also the interactions that connect agents, including message exchanges and task dependencies. Existing MAS safeguards mainly perform agent-level anomaly detection, which becomes insufficient when failures originate from agent interactions and detected anomalies do not necessarily reveal their true sources. To address this limitation, we propose \textbfTRACE-MAS, a finer-grained framework for diagnosing and repairing MAS failures. TRACE-MAS learns normal collaborative execution patterns from benign trajectories and detects deviations in agent state changes, message transitions, and task dependency evolutions. It further identifies responsible execution elements through source-aware attribution and selects minimal interventions to restore collaboration while preserving task-critical capabilities. Experiments on five MAS benchmarks demonstrate that TRACE-MAS significantly improves root-cause localization accuracy by \textbf60.2% and achieves consistent gains in task recovery over strong MAS safeguards.

[MA-17] Agent -Native Applications: A New Application Paradigm

【速读】：该论文旨在解决传统应用架构中行为逻辑受限于预先编写的代码与工作流规则，导致应用无法应对设计时未枚举的动态场景的问题。其核心挑战在于：当基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的智能体作为应用的核心推理与行动组件时，虽然显著扩展了应用的行为空间，但如何在保持有用自主推理能力的同时，确保应用行为始终处于可接受的合规范围内，成为一个关键的控制难题。解决方案的关键在于提出一种“原生智能体应用”（agent-native application）的新范式，将应用建模为一个可移植的、由智能体、工具、数据源及人机协同（human-in-the-loop, HITL）检查点构成的图结构，并通过声明式应用规范定义允许的行为边界（behavioral envelope）。运行时由应用编排器（orchestrator）作为控制平面，协调任务并管理图及其权限的演化；同时，智能体网格（agent mesh）作为数据平面，负责策略相关交互的中介与审计事件生成。该架构进一步引入信任层（trust layer）以实现对智能体应用的可治理性，并构建支持实际部署的基础框架。两个典型用例验证了该设计的可行性，而可执行原型Agent-Native Runtime（ANR）则展示了核心机制的实际运行效果。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23243
作者: David Luo,Alberto Leon-Garcia
机构: University of Toronto (多伦多大学)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 21 pages, 8 figures, 1 table, 1 code listing; published in IEEE Access

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Traditional application architectures assume behavioral logic authored in advance, leaving reachable behavior largely bounded by explicit code and workflow rules. Large language model (LLM)-based agents challenge this assumption by enabling runtime reasoning and autonomous action to become part of application behavior, allowing applications to address situations not enumerated at design time. Extending this pattern, this paper identifies a new application paradigm in which LLM-based agents serve as central reasoning and action components responsible for the application’s core logic and, where permitted, for adapting the application graph itself at runtime. We call these agent-native applications. While such applications significantly expand their possible behavioral space beyond explicit code and workflow rules, they also face a major control problem in which useful agentic reasoning should be preserved while application behavior should remain within a permissible space. We therefore propose an architectural model that represents the application as a portable graph of agents, tools, data sources, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints, and encodes the application’s permitted behavior as a behavioral envelope within a declarative application specification. At runtime, an application orchestrator serves as the control plane that coordinates tasks and governs how the graph and its permissions evolve, while an agent mesh serves as the data plane that mediates policy-relevant interactions and produces audit events. We then discuss the trust layer that makes agent-native applications governable and the supporting foundations required for practical operation. Two use cases illustrate the architecture, while Agent-Native Runtime (ANR) demonstrates selected core mechanisms in an executable prototype.

[NLP-0] Jailbreak Detection on Large Language Models via Contrastive Prototype Structures

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在安全部署中面临的越狱攻击（jailbreak attempts）与有害提示（harmful prompts）检测难题，核心挑战在于如何在不依赖额外下游分类器训练的前提下实现高效、鲁棒的安全检测。其解决方案的关键是提出一种基于原型推理的无监督检测方法——Jailbreak Detection with Prototype Inference (JDPI)，该方法利用二元安全标签（binary safety labels）构建有害（harmful）与良性（benign）原型，并通过计算输入样本与两类原型之间的相对距离进行决策。JDPI仅需二元标签即可完成编码器微调、原型构建与验证，避免了传统分类器方法中所需的独立训练集划分，显著减少标注数据需求。实验表明，在四个涵盖不同输入格式的基准测试中，对比学习微调使JDPI的检测准确率提升9.1–18.0个百分点；在相同编码器下，其ROC-AUC性能接近甚至优于基线模型（Method A），且在特定数据集适配后，超越发布的Llama Guard 3-8B基线0.173–0.310的ROC-AUC。此外，JDPI在多轮对话场景中融合用户历史信息，实现了更高的对话级检测精度，并在12个定向迁移任务中平均高出分类器1.59个百分点，展现出更强的跨数据集鲁棒性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24936
作者: Yan Qiu,Yuanyuan Li
机构: Technical University of Munich (慕尼黑工业大学); Insure AI; Munich Re; San Francisco, USA
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Jailbreak attempts and harmful prompts remain a challenge for the safe deployment of large language models. We study whether contrastively learned representations can support safety detection without training an additional downstream classifier. We propose Jailbreak Detection with Prototype Inference (JDPI), which uses binary safety labels to construct harmful and benign prototypes and makes predictions from relative prototype distances. JDPI uses only binary safety labels for encoder adaptation, prototype construction, and validation. In our setup, it uses fewer labeled examples than the classifier baseline (Method A) by avoiding the separate split used to train the downstream classifier. Across four benchmarks covering different input formats, contrastive fine-tuning improves JDPI’s detection accuracy by 9.1-18.0 percentage points. Using the same encoder, JDPI achieves slightly higher ROC-AUC on one benchmark and stays within 0.017 of the baseline across all four. With dataset-specific adaptation, JDPI exceeds the released Llama Guard 3-8B baseline by 0.173-0.310 in ROC-AUC across the four benchmarks. In multi-turn replay on TomGibbs, JDPI uses accumulated user history as the conversation unfolds, achieving higher conversation-level accuracy than when it uses the current turn alone. Across 12 directed transfers, JDPI outperforms the classifier by an average of 1.59 percentage points in accuracy, demonstrating stronger cross-dataset robustness.

[NLP-1] Ground Iterate Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能在科研创意生成中缺乏可解释性与过程透明度的问题，具体聚焦于理解自动化科研创意生成的有效机制，以及新颖研究提案如何从已有科学文献中演化而来。其核心解决方案是提出“创造性AI研究员”（Creative AI Researcher, CAR）框架，该框架通过融合文献基础、迭代式开发与显式的概念操作算子，构建一个可追溯的生成过程。CAR利用检索到的文献构建语义知识图谱，并赋予创意代理以图谱检索工具及四种概念操作算子：双关联想（bisociation）、类比（analogy）、探索（exploration）和深化（elaboration），每一步操作均需满足结构接受条件并被记录，从而形成包含中间转化路径与明确文献来源的可审计过程轨迹。实验结果表明，CAR在方法学新颖性（MN）上显著优于单次提示和The AI Scientist，且在可行性评分上高于其他对比方法；在多个基准测试中表现最佳。尽管消融研究显示，显式操作算子在未校正多重比较的情况下仍可能带来一定优势，但整体而言，其对质量提升的贡献并不稳定。因此，该研究强调了过程可追溯性的重要性，将创意质量评估与程序可审计性相分离，为可信科研生成提供了新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24887
作者: Samson Yu,Qiran Zou,Jing Yu Lim,Rushi Shah,Anirudh Goyal,Dianbo Liu
机构: National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学); Meta Superintelligence Labs(Meta超级智能实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 56 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models have been widely used to generate plausible research ideas, yet it remains unclear what makes automated ideation effective and how generated novel proposals arise from prior scientific work. We introduce the Creative AI Researcher (CAR), an agentic framework combining literature grounding, iterative development and explicit conceptual operators. CAR constructs a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved literature and equips an ideation agent with graph-retrieval tools and four operators: bisociation, analogy, exploration and elaboration. Each operator call is checked against structural acceptance conditions and recorded, producing a trace of intermediate transformations and declared literature sources. We evaluate CAR with two language-model backbones across 40 LiveIdeaBench research topics and two execution benchmarks. CAR achieves significantly higher methodological novelty (MN) than single-shot prompting and The AI Scientist. Its methodological novelty does not differ significantly from the Research Ideation Agent, while its feasibility scores are higher on both backbones. With a shared experiment executor, CAR achieves the highest pairwise win rate among the evaluated AI methods on FML-bench-Lite and BioXArena. In a ten-condition ablation study, MN point estimates favor CAR over one-step proposal on both backbones, but no MN contrast survives correction for multiple comparisons. The results do not establish a consistent quality benefit from explicit operators beyond free-form iteration. CAR makes the sequence of operations and declared literature sources inspectable, separating judged idea quality from procedural traceability.

[NLP-2] General progress substitutes for specific training data in language models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型在训练过程中因数据屏蔽（data withholding）而导致特定能力延迟获取的问题，以及这种延迟的持续时间与后续恢复该能力所需的数据量之间的不确定性。其核心问题是：当某些关键技能相关的训练数据被刻意排除时，模型何时能掌握该能力？需要多少额外数据才能补足？论文提出的关键解决方案是：模型在其余训练数据上的整体进步可部分替代被屏蔽数据的作用，从而“预习”或“隐含学习”被屏蔽的能力。研究通过在国际象棋、奥赛罗棋、分子字符串、括号语言和网络文本等多种任务中屏蔽特定技能的训练信号发现，大模型对被屏蔽技能的延迟可通过小模型进行预测；例如，一个未显式训练应对“将死”局面的国际象棋模型，在仅基于其他训练数据的情况下，仍能近乎准确地评估合法应对策略。一旦补充被屏蔽数据，模型以远少于从初始状态开始所需的少量数据即能快速掌握该能力，且随着模型整体性能提升，所需数据量呈下降趋势。相比之下，难度相当的控制规则学习则进展缓慢。这一发现表明，数据过滤虽能延缓特定能力的出现，但不会造成永久性缺失——模型在持续训练中积累的通用表征能力可显著降低恢复该能力的门槛。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24844
作者: Mark Marosi,Peter Antal
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 49 pages, 16 figures, 6 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language models acquire their capabilities from training data, and developers withhold data during training to keep models from learning capabilities that could be misused. How long this delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later, is unknown. Here we show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the data that was withheld. We withheld the training signal for individual skills in models of chess, Othello, molecular strings, bracket languages and web text. The delay of a withheld skill in larger models was predicted from smaller ones. A chess model never explicitly trained to respond to check ranked the legal responses almost as well as a model that was. When models were then trained on the withheld data, they acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and this fraction decreased as the models progressed. A control rule of equal difficulty was learned much more slowly. A programming language withheld from the training text of a 7-billion-parameter model was regained in the same way. Data filtering therefore delays a capability, and the data required to regain it decreases as models improve.

[NLP-3] On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决预训练Transformer模型在转换为混合注意力架构（hybrid attention models）时，如何在给定计算预算下高效且准确地选择保留全量注意力（full attention）的层这一关键问题。现有方法FlashMorph存在两个非策略性偏差：其一，连续分支插值与教师强制隐藏状态与离散混合计算之间存在不一致；其二，冻结模型权重无法反映后续恢复阶段的参数适应性。针对上述问题，论文提出FlashMorph2，其核心解决方案在于采用在线策略（on-policy）的层选择机制，通过端到端评估采样的离散混合架构及其自身隐藏状态，并在恢复目标下联合优化层选择得分与模型权重，以真实反映参数自适应后的性能表现。实验表明，FlashMorph2在Qwen3系列不同规模模型及多种线性注意力变体上均显著优于现有方法，在RULER、LongBench和召回密集型任务上分别提升2.42、1.08和0.76分，且层选择耗时仅需0.72–3.57 GPU小时，展现出卓越的性能、效率与可扩展性。

作者: Disen Lan,Xuanda Wang,Jianbin Zheng,Huafeng Kuang,Wei Tang,Yu Cheng
机构: Fudan University (复旦大学); ByteDance Seed (字节跳动种子); Nanyang Technological University (南洋理工大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Hybrid attention models combine full and linear attention to achieve a better quality–efficiency trade-off. Converting pretrained Transformers into such models requires identifying which layers should retain full attention under a prescribed budget. We identify two off-policy mismatches in FlashMorph’s layer selection: (i) continuous branch interpolation and teacher-forced hidden states differ from discrete hybrid computation; and (ii) frozen model weights fail to account for parameter adaptation during subsequent recovery. We introduce FlashMorph2, an on-policy layer-selection method that (I) evaluates sampled discrete hybrid architectures end to end using their own hidden states, and (II) jointly optimizes layer-selection scores and model weights under the recovery objective to reflect post-adaptation performance. Experiments across Qwen3 model scales and linear-attention variants show that FlashMorph2 consistently outperforms existing layer-selection methods, improving average scores over FlashMorph by +2.42 points on RULER, +1.08 on LongBench, and +0.76 on recall-intensive tasks, while completing layer selection in only 0.72 – 3.57 GPU hours across 0.6B–8B models, demonstrating high efficiency and scalability.

[NLP-4] he Elephant in the Question: Unified Models Picture the Concepts Behind Their Answers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型内部推理过程缺乏可解释性的问题，特别是如何直观揭示文本输入中特定标记（token）在生成答案前的中间表示（intermediate representations）所对应的语义概念。其核心挑战在于，这些中间状态通常隐含在深层网络中，且传统方法需依赖额外训练的解码器进行可视化。该研究提出“V-lens”框架，利用统一多模态模型（unified multimodal models）中图像生成器与文本理解模块共享表示结构的特性，无需训练额外解码器即可将选定token的隐藏状态映射为视觉图像。该方法的关键在于：通过扩散模型或自回归模型的生成能力，直接将文本编码中的语义信息转化为具象化视觉表征，从而揭示从问题到答案之间未被显式命名的关键概念关联。进一步引入“lens tuning”策略，以图像作为监督信号对特定隐藏状态进行微调，在BAGEL、SenseNova-U1和HunyuanImage-3.0等模型上，指代词（pronoun referent）的可视化准确率从2%–11%显著提升至86%–94%。更令人意外的是，这种仅针对视觉输出的监督还能间接提升文本生成质量，表明视觉表征学习有助于优化模型整体的语义理解能力。

Abstract:Visualizing intermediate representations could help us inspect the reasoning steps underlying a model output. Unified multimodal models offer this opportunity by combining understanding and generation in one architecture. Their image generators can access representations formed while processing text. We introduce the V-lens, which uses this connection to visualize a chosen token’s hidden state without training a decoder. Across four diffusion-based and two purely autoregressive unified models, the resulting images reveal key intermediate concepts that connect a question to its answer even when the concepts are never named explicitly. Controlled tests show how this content changes with context, token position, and depth. We then introduce lens tuning, which supervises selected hidden states with pictures through the V-lens. Across BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0, the rate of correct visualizations of pronoun referents rises from 2-11% to 86-94%. Surprisingly, such visual supervision also improves text answers without supervising the answer tokens directly. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-5] Induction Head Origins of SLAM-ASR Speech Recognition Models ICASSP

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决一个核心问题：为何仅通过一个小型训练映射模型（由编码器状态映射至冻结语言模型的嵌入空间）即可实现与主流方法相媲美的语音识别性能？其解决方案的关键在于揭示了冻结语言模型内部的结构机制。研究发现，SLAM-ASR模型的性能依赖于语言模型中的归纳头（induction heads），这些头在文本中负责复制重复的词元序列，同时也承担将语音嵌入映射到转录词元的重要功能。进一步分析表明，存在成对的归纳头以一种受约束的微分注意力形式协同工作，能够抵消注意力噪声并聚焦于已生成的前序词汇，从而提升定位精度。此外，研究还展示了如何利用归纳头在噪声音频条件下优化转录质量，为提升鲁棒性提供了可解释的机制支撑。

作者: Artem Fedorchenko,Tanel Alumäe
机构: Tallinn University of Technology (塔林理工大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:What makes a small trained map from encoder states to the embedding space of a frozen language model sufficient for competitive speech recognition? The premise of the SLAM-ASR architecture is that a frozen language model possesses linguistic knowledge rich enough to perform the recognition task. This assumption, while reasonable, provides little insight into the mechanisms underlying these models. We therefore seek the concrete internal structures on which they rely. This work shows that SLAM-ASR models rely on induction heads of the frozen language model: the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text are also important for mapping speech embeddings to transcript tokens. Moreover, we find pairs of heads that behave as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention onto the previously generated word. Finally, we show how induction heads could be used to improve transcription quality under noisy audio.

[NLP-6] DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在端到端（End-to-End, E2E）自动驾驶系统中因计算开销大、难以实现运行时灵活开关语言推理而限制实际部署的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保持高感知与决策性能的同时，降低模型复杂度并实现推理路径的动态可配置性。解决方案的关键在于提出DRIFT框架，通过引入一个轻量级语言模型（Light Model, LM，仅150M参数），将中间驾驶表征高效投影至语言嵌入空间，实现精准的场景描述与行为注释；同时设计了一种运行时灵活的规划模块，该模块基于从语言模型中蒸馏出的代理推理特征进行训练，并可在推理阶段选择性地依赖原始语言模型或替代的代理特征，从而在满足资源约束时完全跳过语言模型计算，且不损失驾驶性能。该设计使得整体模型仅需255M参数，在Bench2Drive基准上达到97.03的驾驶评分（Driving Score）和89.39%的成功率，性能媲美当前最强的非语言模型方法，同时显著优于现有基于VLM的模型在计算效率方面的表现，实现在真实世界导航（NAVSIM）和AlpaSim等基准上的高效可靠运行。

Abstract:The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: this https URL

[NLP-7] Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决科学发现类智能体在实验设计与结果推理中难以有效评估其真实探究能力的问题，现有大多数发现基准测试无法将实验选择的启发性与记忆召回、隐含评分规则或捷径策略（shortcut policies）相分离。为此，作者提出了Openhagen Worlds，一个由27个程序化生成环境构成的基准套件，涵盖从经典实验推理谜题到基于模拟器的物理与化学场景，所有环境均具备确定性验证机制，并在有限真值空间下运行。其核心创新在于：每个观测结果均显式包含完整评分规则，且所有178个难度等级均经过严格校准——仅当脚本化“圣杯”（scripted oracle）在64个开发实例上成功率≥0.75、最强非演绎性策略成功率≤0.25、每种受控捷径成功率≤0.35时才被接纳。其中92个核心层级覆盖全部27个类别，适合小模型训练；86个前沿层级则扩展了15个发现类世界，引入更复杂问题及多阶段（三、五、八及以上）任务序列。在相同84个保留的前沿实例上，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash在默认推理资源（每调用16,384 token）下解决32题，在最大资源（每调用最高393,216 token）下提升至57题（圣杯基准为79），余量最大体现在八阶段任务中。基于策略的专家迭代（on-policy expert iteration）使9B参数模型在训练家族上的核心层级成功率从0.090提升至0.148，主要得益于动作格式优化，且未对GPQA Diamond任务造成可检测性能损失。此外，提供托管服务以公开运行核心层级的保留实例。

Abstract:Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. The 92 core levels span all 27 families and are sized to train small models; the 86 frontier rungs extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder questions and with campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system. On the same 84 withheld frontier instances, one per family and rung, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 32 at its default reasoning effort with 16,384 tokens per call and 57 at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call (oracle: 79); the headroom that remains is largest in eight-stage campaigns. On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains: its core-tier success on trained families rises from 0.090 to 0.148, partly through better action format, with no detectable loss on GPQA Diamond. A hosted service plays the core tier’s withheld instances.

[NLP-8] When Does Continual Pre-Training Help? A Controlled Study of Dialectal Adaptation for Québec French EACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决持续预训练（Continual Pre-Training, CPT）在方言适应中的有效性问题，具体包括：何时需要进行CPT、其优势的驱动因素是什么，以及现有综合评估指标是否能准确反映其实际效果。研究针对魁北克法语（Québec French）的语言理解任务，在九个不同架构与规模的大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）上开展受控实验，采用每项实验3000万词的预算匹配协议。研究发现，CPT的效果高度依赖于初始模型对目标语言变体的已有能力；当其有效时，提升主要源于语料库的内容构成而非数据量，其中文学文本贡献了绝大部分性能增益。配对的魁北克法语与标准法语评估表明，CPT更显著提升了表达理解能力而非语法掌握能力，且语料库的语域（register）决定了所习得区域性表达的具体类型。此外，这些改进伴随着特定能力的权衡，例如阅读理解能力的下降，而这类代价可能被综合评估分数所掩盖。因此，研究结论指出，将CPT视为普遍有益的默认策略是不恰当的，方言适配应始于对基础模型现有能力的细致评估，并结合源数据层面的分析和任务层面的精细化评价，以制定更有效的适应策略。

作者: Eeham Khan,Richard Khoury,Leila Kosseim
机构: Concordia University (康考迪亚大学); Université Laval (拉瓦勒大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Continual pre-training (CPT) is widely used to adapt pretrained language models to dialectal and non-standard language varieties, yet it remains unclear when this additional training is necessary, what drives its benefits, and whether aggregate evaluation scores adequately capture its effects. In this paper, we present a controlled study of CPT for Québec French language understanding across nine LLMs spanning different families and scales. Using a budget-matched protocol of 30M tokens per experiment, our results show that the benefit of CPT depends strongly on the starting model’s existing competence in the target variety. When CPT is beneficial, the improvements are driven more by corpus composition than by data volume, with literary text accounting for most of the gain. Paired Québec and standard French evaluations further show that CPT primarily improves expression comprehension rather than grammatical competence, and that corpus register determines which regional expressions are acquired. These gains also involve capability-specific trade-offs, including declines in reading comprehension that aggregate scores can conceal. Overall, these findings show that CPT for dialectal adaptation should not be treated as a uniformly beneficial default. Instead, adaptation strategies should begin with a careful assessment of the base model’s existing competence, accompanied by source-level data analysis and task-level evaluation.

[NLP-9] CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在适应过程中普遍存在的能力保持难题：即在实现特定任务目标的同时，往往会导致模型通用能力的退化。其核心解决方案是提出CurvDelta框架，该框架通过将能力保持约束嵌入到模型参数更新的参数化形式中，利用对预适应模型附近保持约束局部几何结构的分析，构建一个低曲率空间，使得参数更新在此空间内几乎不改变保持损失。为使该方法适用于大规模语言模型，研究引入了克罗内克积近似曲率（Kronecker-factored Approximate Curvature, K-FAC）和分解投影机制以实现高效计算。此外，还提出了CurvLoRA，一种基于相同保持几何结构的低秩变体，以提升适应效率。两种方法均适用于受保持约束的适应任务，如能力学习与选择性遗忘。实验结果表明，在数学推理、代码生成任务中，所提方法在下游性能上具有竞争力的同时，显著提升了通用能力的保持效果，展现出优于基线的获取-保留权衡；在知识遗忘任务中，于TOFU和MUSE数据集上的表现证明其在目标遗忘与知识保留之间实现了更优平衡，且保留性能接近从头再训练的基准水平。

作者: Zeguan Xiao,Zhuocheng Liang,Yun Chen,Yong Wang,Guanhua Chen,Pinyan Lu
机构: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics(上海财经大学); Alibaba Group(阿里巴巴集团); Southern University of Science and Technology(南方科技大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition–retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.

[NLP-10] Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型在通用决策任务中性能提升受限于数据质量与模型-数据协同进化不足的核心问题，尤其聚焦于如何通过数据驱动的自我改进机制实现决策模型的持续优化。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于“代理式数据工程”（Agentic Data Engineering）与“递归自我改进”（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）的协同演化框架，使模型能力与训练数据在迭代过程中共同演进。具体而言，研究引入了由智能体驱动的闭环系统：研究代理（research agents）自主分析模型行为、构建训练数据、执行实验并利用反馈结果优化后续策略；同时通过语义切片（semantic slices）和共享研究记忆（shared research memory）实现跨模型家族的协同学习。大规模实验证明，该方法突破了传统依赖模型规模增长的范式，揭示出三大反直觉发现：（1）模型架构与训练配方的协同适配优于单纯追求模型版本更新；（2）针对性的数据精炼可使小型模型（4B–9B）在特定工作流中媲美大型基准模型（27B）；（3）连续降低损失函数并不必然提升离散决策准确性，甚至可能损害性能。这些发现为构建前沿决策模型提供了可复现的范式，结合开源的权重及来自Data-Juicer与AgentScope生态系统的工具，形成了可扩展的数据驱动递归改进蓝图。

Abstract:We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family’s development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.

[NLP-11] Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决小型语言模型（Small Language Models, SLMs）在临床场景中生成的医学解释存在篇幅短、结构松散的问题，尽管其具备在通用硬件上运行并支持隐私保护型本地部署的优势。现有监督学习方法（如Meerkat）虽能将链式思维（Chain-of-Thought）能力迁移至7B–8B规模的模型，但其训练目标并未直接优化解释的风格或组织结构。为此，研究基于指令微调的Mistral-7B骨干模型，提出一种轻量级强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）方案：采用近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimization, PPO）结合低秩适配（LoRA），对2,000个源自Meerkat的医学提示进行微调，利用一种简单的自监督奖励函数——该奖励函数倾向于更长、词汇多样性更高且标点使用规范的响应，同时惩罚过短输出。在单块NVIDIA A100 GPU上训练约170个PPO步骤后，平均奖励稳定提升。定量与定性分析表明，经强化学习调优后的模型能够生成更长、更具条理性的多要点医学解释，同时保持原有医学知识准确性。研究探讨了自奖励强化学习在塑造医学解释风格方面的潜力与局限性。

Abstract:Small language models (SLMs) can run on commodity hardware and support privacy-preserving, on-premises clinical deployment, but their medical explanations are often short and poorly structured compared with large language models. Recent supervised approaches such as Meerkat transfer chain-of-thought reasoning into 7B-8B backbones, yet their training objective does not directly target the style or organization of the generated rationales. Building on the instruction-tuned Mistral-7B backbone, we investigate whether a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) step can improve explanation structure without human preference this http URL apply Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with LoRA adaptation to 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts, guided by a simple self-supervised reward that favors longer, lexically diverse, and well-punctuated responses while penalizing very short ones. Training for about 170 PPO steps on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a stable increase in the average reward. Quantitative and qualitative comparisons show that the RL-tuned model produces longer, more organized, multi-point explanations while preserving the underlying medical this http URL discuss the promise and the limitations of self-rewarded RL for shaping the style of medical explanations.

[NLP-12] Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型在复杂推理任务中生成质量与计算效率难以兼顾的问题，特别是针对需要长上下文建模和多步思维（thinking-mode）生成的智能体（agent）应用场景。其核心挑战在于如何在有限显存条件下实现高效、高精度的生成，并降低推理过程中的冗余计算开销。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）架构的扩散语言模型——Clover-35B-A3B-Preview，通过引入门控增量网络（Gated Delta Networks）机制，在扩散过程中融合历史生成内容的循环记忆与当前块内的双向softmax注意力，实现对上下文状态的动态感知。该设计通过共享softmax结构使历史记忆读取与当前词元竞争，结合可学习的块大小校准与独立零初始化的右文卷积分支，显著提升了上下文建模能力与生成连贯性。此外，论文还提出一种决策模型变体，支持在一次去噪过程中联合预测多个相关问题的答案，将内部测试集上的问题准确率从90.37%提升至93.88%，全正确组准确率从65.4%提升至77.0%，有效降低了推理成本并增强了生成一致性。实验表明，该模型在多项代理评估指标上领先，且在单张NVIDIA GB300 GPU上以BF16精度实现高达680 tokens/s的生成速度，展现出卓越的部署效率与实用性。

Abstract:We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview (Clover), a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters, supporting thinking-mode generation. Clover adapts Gated Delta Networks to block diffusion by combining recurrent memory of previously generated context with bidirectional softmax attention inside the current block. Historical memory readout competes with current-block tokens in a shared softmax, with learnable block-size calibration and a separate, zero-initialized right-context convolution branch. Clover leads the seven evaluated agent metrics, including 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 51.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On internal agent workloads, it reaches a reported generation speed of 680 tokens/s using one NVIDIA GB300 GPU at BF16 precision and batch size one. We organize the evaluation around model quality, drafting and verification costs, and deployment under constrained memory. We also describe a decision-model variant that generates answers to related questions in one denoising pass. On an internal set of 500 groups, joint prediction raises question accuracy from 90.37% to 93.88% and all-correct group accuracy from 65.4% to 77.0%.

[NLP-13] ransferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究语言模型在推理能力提升过程中是否经历类似人类皮层发育中功能系统逐步分化的过程，即是否存在可识别的、与推理能力相关的特定网络区域的重组。其核心解决方案的关键在于：通过扩散映射（diffusion-map embedding）分析三个不同家族的语言模型在基础训练与推理专项训练后的权重分布，发现尽管整体梯度结构保持稳定，但在连续的一层网络中存在局部的可辨识变化区域。研究进一步表明，将这些特定区域的权重“嫁接”（grafting）至指令微调后的模型中，能够显著提升数学推理表现，且性能增益随嫁接区域与原模型重叠程度增加而提高；同时，此类嫁接保留了宿主模型原有的解题能力，干扰较小。此外，该推理相关区域在训练早期性能上升阶段逐渐形成，中间阶段的嫁接亦具有效性。跨模型验证还发现，在医学领域模型中同样存在可转移的推理相关权重区域。综上，该研究揭示了一个可迁移的、与推理能力密切相关的神经网络子区域，其权重调整可在不损害原有数学能力的前提下，有效增强模型的推理性能。

备注: 5 figures, 5 extended data figures, 5 extended data tables; includes Supplementary Information

点击查看摘要

Abstract:During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors’ behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host’s existing mathematical competence.

[NLP-14] Chain-of-Thought Hidden States Reveal Task-Solving Directions for Direct Answers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在使用思维链提示（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）时存在的效率与效果不一致问题：一方面，部分任务中模型性能反而劣于直接答案提示（direct-answer prompting），另一方面，某些任务中模型需生成数百个词才能得出正确答案，导致计算成本过高。其解决方案的关键在于发现并利用直接提示（direct prompt）的隐藏状态空间中存在一种特定方向——该方向对每个问题而言均能引导模型在极短生成长度下更高效地达到正确答案。研究通过线性探测识别出“恢复”（recovering）与“失败”（failed）两类隐藏状态表征的可区分性，并基于各问题自身的恢复与失败状态构建专属方向。通过对直接提示的最后一个隐藏状态进行一次旋转以对齐该方向，可在仅使用约十分之一的生成 token 情况下，将模型在 25 个任务上的平均准确率从 46% 提升至 85%（LLaMA 3.1 8B，CoT 为 69%），或从 52% 提升至 86%（Qwen 2.5 7B，CoT 为 77%）。这一结果表明，CoT 并非通向高精度的最短路径，而这些可学习的方向可为未来模型训练提供新的对齐目标，实现更高效、精准的推理。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24598
作者: Houman Mehrafarin,Ioannis Konstas
机构: Heriot-Watt University (赫瑞-瓦特大学); University of Edinburgh (爱丁堡大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
