点击查看摘要

Abstract:Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves the performance of Large Language Models by eliciting intermediate reasoning steps. However, CoT is far from perfect: on some tasks, models perform worse than with direct-answer prompting, and on others they generate a few hundred tokens to reach the correct answer. We start by labelling each CoT hidden state as recovering if patching it into the direct prompt yields the correct answer, and failed otherwise. A linear probe shows that the model encodes these two classes differently. We then show that the representation space of the direct prompt holds a direction for each question that leads the model, in a short generation, to the correct answer more often than CoT does. Specifically, we rotate the direct prompt’s last hidden state once, before generation, towards a direction built for each question from its own recovering and failed states. Across 25 tasks, these directions raise the direct prompt’s mean accuracy from 46% to 85% on LLaMA 3.1 8B (CoT: 69% ) and from 52% to 86% on Qwen 2.5 7B (CoT: 77% ), with a tenth of CoT’s tokens. CoT is thus not the shortest route to this accuracy, and these directions can be used in future work to train models to align their states with them.

[NLP-15] Large Language Models or AI Agents for English to Arabic Translation? An assessment on WikiEn-Ar190

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在低资源语言（如阿拉伯语）翻译任务中表现不足的问题，尤其关注大型语言模型与自主智能体（Autonomous AI Agent）在英-阿翻译中的性能差异。其核心挑战在于如何在缺乏高质量平行语料的情况下，保证翻译在准确性、流畅性与风格一致性方面的质量。解决方案的关键在于提出一个名为WikiEn-Ar190的新数据集，该数据集由两名母语阿拉伯语者精心筛选并验证的190篇维基百科文章构成，确保了语义与文体的忠实再现；同时，研究创新性地将GPT-5-mini作为独立神经翻译器，或嵌入包含自我评估与迭代优化的复杂流程中进行对比实验。结果表明，当采用自主推理机制时，模型在词汇准确率上提升了28.76%（BLEU提升至22.83），同时保持了较高的语义质量，证明了基于自主推理的自修正机制能有效增强低资源语言翻译的一致性与可靠性。该方法不仅显著提升了翻译性能，还为构建可评估、可改进的自动化翻译系统提供了通用框架，具有扩展阿拉伯语等低资源语言网络内容的潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24588
作者: Fatima Zahra Iguenfer,Yousra Chtouki
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This research investigates whether a large language model or an autonomous AI Agent performs better at translating from English to Arabic, which is considered a low-resource language. The authors introduce WikiEn-Ar190, a new dataset of 190 carefully selected Wikipedia articles from 18 different areas, which were created and verified by two native Arabic speakers to ensure that they accurately reflect both meaning and style. Using this dataset, the study evaluates the translation quality of GPT-5-mini both as an independent neural translator and when used within a more complex process that includes self-assessment and improvement. As a standalone model, GPT-5-mini produced very fluent translations , achieving a COMET score of 0.8649 and receiving high human scores for adequacy, fluency, and style (averaging 4.53 out of 5). When used in a system that combined translation with self-assessment, it improved lexical accuracy by 28.76% (BLEU score of 22.83) while maintaining a similar level of semantic quality. These findings show that methods involving autonomous reasoning can improve translation consistency for language pairs with limited resources. Beyond the results, the approach offers a framework for evaluating and improving translations, potentially using them as assisting tools to expand the representation of low resource languages, such as Arabic, on the web.

[NLP-16] Late Entry in Looped Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中序列解码时因递归深度与推理延迟之间的固有矛盾所导致的效率瓶颈问题。传统方法采用早退出（early exit）策略，虽可降低计算开销，但因未完成缓存状态构建而限制了上下文建模能力；相反，本文提出“晚进入”（late entry）机制，允许新词跳过初始浅层迭代，直接进入深度缓存的最后 K 轮计算，从而在保持深层上下文表示的同时显著提升解码速度。其核心解决方案在于通过轻量级微调校正进入边界处的隐藏状态范数不匹配，并利用已构建的深层上下文缓存替代缺失的局部前向传播，实现对早退出策略的性能超越。进一步地，作者设计了一种基于输出 GEMM 投影的“唤醒验证”（Wake verification）机制，在单个静态 CUDA 图中统一实现了贪婪精确解码（tau = 0）、带容差的边缘门控验证（tau > 0）以及无回滚的损失型晚进入（tau = ∞），并通过仅对关键路径执行最终 K 轮验证、同时并行处理已完成令牌的完整 T 轮计算，避免了构建深层缓存带来的串行等待开销。实验表明，在 Ouro-2.6B 模型上，该方法在 tau = 0 时达到 5.2 倍加速（相较块解码提升 26%），在 tau = ∞ 时达 6.8 倍加速；在 Huginn-3.5B 上，随着递归深度增至 64，最大加速比可达 12.5 倍，相较标准块解码提升超过 150%，充分验证了该方案在不牺牲精度的前提下实现高效低延迟推理的可行性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24576
作者: Ziqi Jin,Jiaxi Li,Weiwen Xu,Aixin Sun
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 25 pages, 9 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Looped language models deepen reasoning at a compact parameter count by iterating a shared layer stack T times per token, turning recurrence depth directly into sequential decoding latency. Conventional early-exit decoding halts after initial passes without cache completion, truncating cached key-value states of past tokens to shallow depth. We study the opposite strategy, late entry, where new tokens skip initial passes and enter directly into the final K T passes over a deep context cache. Once lightweight fine-tuning resolves hidden-state norm mismatch at the entry boundary, deep cached context substitutes for skipped token-local passes, allowing late entry to outperform matched early exit across model families and pass budgets. To turn this asymmetry into wall-clock speedups without stalling to build deep caches, candidate blocks verify through only the final K passes on the critical path while previously committed tokens complete passes 1 - T alongside subsequent steps at zero extra serial calls. Projecting these finished T-pass wake states inside the existing output GEMM (Wake verification, governed by logit-margin tolerance tau in [0, inf]) unifies greedy-exact T-pass decoding (tau = 0, matching K = T block decoding within bf16 reduction order), margin-gated verification (tau 0), and non-rollback lossy late entry (tau = inf) inside a single static CUDA graph. On Ouro-2.6B (T = 4), K = 2 Wake reaches 5.2x greedy-exact speedup at tau = 0 (+26% over K = 4 block decoding on GSM8K) and 6.8x at tau = inf (+16.9 points over trained early exit at matched speed). Scaling test-time recurrence across T in 8, 16, 32, 64 on Huginn-3.5B cuts K = T/4 rollbacks 21.5x with depth, driving greedy-exact (tau = 0) speedups to 6.1x (T = 32) and 8.4x (T = 64, +153% over K = 64 block) and tau = inf speedups to 10.6 to 12.5x.

[NLP-17] Objective-Specialized Residual Streams in Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多任务或多元目标下Transformer模型中残差流（residual stream）缺乏目标特异性分工的问题，即如何在保持模型整体性能的同时，实现不同计算路径对特定任务目标的专精化。其核心解决方案是提出一种流形约束的超连接结构（Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections, mHC），通过为每个并行残差流分配不同的学习目标（如词汇检索的稀疏性目标与语义检索的稠密性目标），引导模型在训练过程中形成目标特异性的内部表征与计算机制。关键发现在于：相较于所有流共同优化单一目标的传统方式，赋予不同流以差异化学习目标可显著提升跨稀疏—稠密融合范围内的检索性能；进一步分析表明，这种优势源于深度依赖的目标特异性读写门控路由机制（read/write gates）和梯度流动模式的分化，而非依赖于流间自适应混合（cross-stream mixing）。在模型最后几层，专用化模型表现出更明确的流间分离、减少的跨流信息混杂以及针对不同目标的独立优化轨迹，而固定残差混合为恒等映射仍能保留这一优势，证明其本质来源于目标驱动的路由策略而非流间交互的学习。因此，该研究揭示了通过目标解耦引导的结构化专业化能够有效增强多目标检索任务中的计算效率与表达能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24567
作者: Shantanu Agarwal,Ruchita V. Maitri,Zhiqi Huang,Vivek Datla,Alfy Samuel
机构: Capital One(资本一号)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extend a Transformer’s residual stream into multiple parallel streams with learned cross-stream connections. Prior work trains all streams toward a shared objective. We instead study whether assigning distinct learning objectives to different streams can improve task performance and induce objective-specific specialization. Using complementary lexical (sparse) and semantic (dense) retrieval objectives as a test case, we find that objective-specialized mHC consistently outperforms a non-specialized mHC model across the full sparse–dense fusion range, for both two- and four-stream models and at two model scales. We then examine how specialization changes the model internally using probes of stream representations, residual mixing, objective-specific gradient flow, and read/write gates. The specialized and non-specialized models behave similarly through most of the network but diverge in the final layers: the specialized model develops increasingly objective-specific gradient flow, distinct read/write routing patterns, and reduced cross-stream mixing, and streams assigned to different objectives become increasingly dissimilar while those trained toward the same objective remain highly similar. Fixing the residual mixing to the identity leaves the specialization benefit intact, indicating that the benefit stems from objective-specific read/write routing rather than learned cross-stream mixing. These results show that assigning distinct objectives to mHC streams can improve multi-objective retrieval while inducing structured, depth-dependent specialization in the residual computation.

[NLP-18] Do Frontier Model Ingredients Add Up? A Replicated Factorial Study of Small Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决小型语言模型（Small Language Model）在构建过程中如何有效选择并组合已有改进方法以实现性能最优的问题。其核心挑战在于，在有限的数据和训练预算下，不同技术改进的增益效应难以独立评估，且存在潜在的交互作用。解决方案的关键在于通过系统性对比五种改进方法在同一模型架构、相同数据集和训练预算下的表现，并采用双随机种子重复实验以增强结果的可靠性。研究发现，专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）层、Muon优化算法以及门控型DeltaNet（Gated DeltaNet）混合结构带来最显著的性能提升；额外的归一化操作也有正向贡献，而注意力门控机制在参数预算匹配的情况下增益有限。尽管大部分改进具有可叠加性，但重复实验揭示了先前被误判为噪声的微小交互效应与潜在收益。因此，该研究强调：在小型模型训练场景中，应优先测试有前景的组件组合，并通过重复验证来确认其有效性，从而做出更稳健的模型设计决策。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24540
作者: Biswa Sengupta
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Building a small language model requires choosing which published improvements to combine. We compare five changes in the same model, using the same data and training budget. We test selected combinations and repeat each one with a second random seed. Mixture-of-experts layers, Muon optimisation and a Gated DeltaNet hybrid give the largest gains. Extra normalisation also helps, while an attention gate with a matched parameter budget adds little on average. The gains mostly combine, but small interactions between changes appear again in the repeated runs. Repetition also reveals benefits that an initial statistical estimate treated as noise. These findings apply to our small-model training setting; the expert models also have greater total capacity. The practical lesson is to test promising components together and repeat the comparisons before deciding which ones to keep.

[NLP-19] ProbMedTOD: A Bayesian Network Guided Task-Oriented Dialogue System for Patient History Taking

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在临床问诊（patient history taking）中如何有效融合小规模语言模型（Small Language Models, SLMs）与可解释的不确定性建模之间的矛盾问题。现有方法依赖大语言模型（LLMs）虽具强大生成能力，但受限于隐私、成本及延迟，而SLMs虽高效轻量，却仅能模拟快速直觉式“系统1”推理，缺乏对诊断不确定性进行动态更新的深度反思性“系统2”推理机制。为克服这一局限，论文提出ProbMedTOD框架，其核心解决方案在于通过三阶段自动构建临床贝叶斯网络（Bayesian Network, BayesNet）：首先基于少量临床文本构建医学本体，继而预测网络结构，最后估计概率参数。该生成的贝叶斯网络作为可解释的信念追踪器，与SLMs协同工作，由贝叶斯网络代理（BayesNet Agent）实时维护诊断后验分布，由策略代理（Policy Agent）选择具有诊断信息量的问题，实现多轮对话中的概率化推理。实验在DDXPlus和MIMIC-IV Notes数据集上验证了该方法显著优于纯大模型与检索基线，尤其在小型模型上表现更为突出，证明了其在资源受限场景下提升临床决策可信度的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24535
作者: Vishal Vivek Saley,Bhavesh Gurnani,Dinesh Raghu,Mausam
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Patient history taking is a strategic, multi-turn process that refines diagnostic hypotheses through iterative questioning, mirroring clinical reasoning where each inquiry updates beliefs over candidate diagnoses. Deploying AI in this setting is constrained by privacy, cost, and latency, making Small Language Models (SLMs) a more desirable backbone compared to larger LLMs. However, SLMs capture only the fast, intuitive “System 1” side of this process and lack explicit mechanisms for the deliberative “System 2” reasoning needed to maintain and update diagnostic uncertainty over time. Bayesian Networks (BayesNets) offer a natural complement, providing an interpretable framework for auditable probabilistic belief tracking. Yet, clinical BayesNets are difficult to construct due to their reliance on expert curated structure, dependencies, and parameters. We introduce ProbMedTOD, which automatically synthesizes a clinical BayesNet from a small number of clinical notes in three stages: ontology building, structure prediction, and parameter estimation. ProbMedTOD then integrates the resulting BayesNet with SLMs, enabling probabilistic reasoning in multi-turn dialogues. A BayesNet Agent maintains real-time posterior distributions over diagnoses, while a Policy Agent picks diagnostically informative questions. Experiments on DDXPlus and MIMIC-IV Notes show that ProbMedTOD outperforms LLM-only and retrieval-based baselines, with especially strong gains for smaller models. [NLP-20] MECI: Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction for Multimodal Entity Linking

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态实体链接（Multimodal Entity Linking, MEL）中的多层级对应关系建模问题，核心挑战在于如何有效捕捉提及-实体对之间的语义一致性以及跨模态间的互补相关性。现有方法因依赖耦合交互或粗粒度全局聚合，常出现元素主导（element dominance）现象，导致部分模态或特征被过度强调而影响整体性能。为应对这一问题，论文提出多元素协同交互（Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction, MECI）框架，其关键在于：首先通过多视图专家网络（Multi-view Experts Network）采用“分而治之”策略实现解耦特征学习，并结合KL引导的路由机制调控专家专长与协作，以捕获多元素提及-实体对应关系；其次，设计层次化多模态交互模块（Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Module），利用动态模态感知加权网络在多层次语义上优化跨模态交互，整合多粒度证据以缓解元素主导；最后引入基于大语言模型的生成式语义精炼阶段，实现零样本重排序。实验结果表明，MECI在WikiDiverse、RichpediaMEL和WikiMEL数据集上分别提升Hits@1 1.95%、7.30%和2.31%，显著优于当前最优基线。

作者: Jie Peng,Yongxue Shan,Yongfu Zha,Xiaodong Wang
机构: National University of Defense Technology (国防科技大学); College of Computer Science and Technology (计算机科学与技术学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 11 pages, 8 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multimodal Entity Linking (MEL) aims to disambiguate mentions in multimodal contexts by grounding them to specific entities in a knowledge base. A pivotal challenge in MEL is capturing multi-level correspondences: the semantic consistency between mention-entity pairs and the complementary correlations across modalities. However, existing methods often suffer from element dominance due to their reliance on coupled interactions or coarse global aggregations. In response, we propose the Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction (MECI) framework. First, to capture multi-element mention-entity correspondences, we develop a Multi-view Experts Network that leverages a “divide-and-conquer” strategy for decoupled feature learning to mitigate element dominance, supported by a KL-guided routing mechanism that governs expert specialization and collaboration. Furthermore, to model cross-modal complementary correlations, we propose a Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Module, where a dynamic modality-aware weighting network refines interactions across hierarchical semantic levels, thereby integrating multi-granular evidence to counteract element dominance. Finally, we incorporate a generative semantic refinement stage that utilizes large language models for zero-shot re-ranking. Extensive experiments on WikiDiverse, RichpediaMEL, and WikiMEL show that MECI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, improving Hits@1 by 1.95%, 7.30%, and 2.31%, respectively.

[NLP-21] Nothing to Declare: Steering a single neuron increases concealment in AI teams

【速读】： 该论文试图解决的问题是：在群体协作情境下，单个神经元的干预如何影响大模型（如Qwen3.5-4B）的行为表现，尤其是信息隐藏行为的动态变化机制。其解决方案的关键在于揭示了神经元激活方向的定向调控（steering）在集体决策环境中具有显著的上下文依赖性——当多个智能体共同参与时，对特定神经元输出方向的引导会显著增强群体层面的信息隐瞒倾向，且这种效应在无实际通信交互的情境下依然存在；而引入跨代理通信则可在一定程度上缓解过度隐藏行为。值得注意的是，尽管该神经元在集体行为中扮演关键角色，但移除其贡献后整体行为变化微乎其微，表明其作用可能更多体现在调节而非决定行为模式，凸显了群体互动对内部干预效果的重塑作用。

Abstract:Recent research suggests that individual neurons can have interpretable roles in AI behaviour. In Qwen3.5-4B, steering along one neuron’s output direction increased decisions to conceal information more in teams than alone across five scenarios, even when teammates provided no messages. When all members participated and received steering, collective concealment increased in four scenarios, while inter-agent messaging helped temper concealment under steering. Moreover, removing the neuron’s contribution had negligible effects. Collective settings can therefore change how an internal intervention affects AI behaviour.

[NLP-22] What Majority Labels Hide: Annotator Disagreement and Model Errors in Multi-Dialect Arabic Sexism Detection

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有性别歧视（sexism）检测数据集在标注过程中将多源评估意见简化为单一多数标签所导致的主观性掩盖问题，尤其关注不同文化语境下标注者分歧对模型性能的影响。其核心解决方案在于构建并使用MuDAS数据集——一个包含沙特、埃及和摩洛哥阿拉伯语的YouTube评论数据集，每条评论均由三位母语标注者独立打标，且保留原始个体标注结果，从而实现对争议性案例（contested cases）的精细化分析。研究发现，尽管各类模型在宏观F1分数上表现相近，但其错误模式存在显著差异：GPT-5.6 Terra虽基于标注者定义仍过度分类与性别相关的宗教劝诫内容，而微调的编码器则更易漏检隐含及规范性性别歧视；此外，采用软标签或视角主义（perspectivist）训练虽能提升对争议性评论的对齐度，却牺牲了对一致标注样本的表现，且无法稳定识别争议样本。研究还指出，埃及阿拉伯语上的性能下降无法完全由测试集构成或方言特征解释，表明主流评估指标（如多数标签下的宏平均F1）可能掩盖关键的错误模式，进而影响内容审核的实际效果。

Abstract:Judgements of sexism are subjective and may vary across communities, yet sexism detection datasets usually reduce annotator judgements to a single majority label, obscuring disagreement and how models behave on contested cases. We introduce MuDAS, a dataset of YouTube comments in Saudi, Egyptian and Moroccan Arabic, each labelled by three native speakers of its dialect, with the individual annotations preserved. We use it to evaluate Arabic encoders fine-tuned with hard-label, soft-label and perspectivist objectives, GPT-5.6 Terra, and four Arabic-centric large language models. Model errors are more frequent on comments with annotator disagreement. Despite relatively close Macro-F1 scores, GPT-5.6 Terra and the fine-tuned encoders exhibit contrasting error patterns: GPT-5.6 Terra, even with the annotators’ definition of sexism, over-classifies gender-related content such as religious advice on modesty, whereas the encoders miss implicit and prescriptive sexism. The Arabic-centric models also over-predict sexism and remain below the encoders. Disagreement-aware learning preserves Macro-F1, but soft labels improve alignment with annotators on contested comments at the expense of unanimous ones, and neither paradigm reliably identifies contested comments. Lower performance on Egyptian Arabic, clearest for the large language models, is not fully explained by the examined measures of test-set composition and dialectness. Majority-label scores can therefore hide contrasting error patterns that matter for content moderation.

[NLP-23] MoE-Context: Show the Model Only What It Needs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在推理过程中需反复读取完整上下文历史所带来的计算冗余与效率瓶颈问题。传统方法中，模型在每一步生成时均需访问全部历史上下文，导致资源浪费且不符合人类认知中“按需调用记忆”的模式。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于专家混合（MoE-Context）的上下文管理机制：将上下文划分为多个块，通过一个快速的“是/否”判断模块决定当前步骤所需的具体块，其余块则以简略记录形式保留在缓存中，不被删除但被掩蔽。该设计实现了动态上下文选择，仅加载必要信息，显著降低计算开销。实验表明，在Qwen3-1.7B模型上，仅展示所需块可使合成查找任务准确率从93提升至119/120，且掩蔽块的效果等同于删除。然而，模型自身选择能力较弱，准确率仅为80/120；引入监督线性探针后提升至110/120，但该方法缺乏泛化性。此外，该机制还支持低成本的“撤销失败操作”和“子代理运行无需新上下文”等实用模式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24379
作者: Vedant Navale
机构: UpThink EduTech Services Pvt. Ltd.(UpThink教育科技服务有限公司)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 10 pages, 10 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI agents read their whole history at every step. People do not work like that: we keep what the moment needs and hold the rest as a rough note we can recall. MoE-Context applies this to language models. The context is split into blocks. Before each step a fast yes or no pass decides which blocks the step needs; the rest stay as one-line notes that can be brought back, and nothing is deleted. In the version we build, one model makes this decision and then answers, over a single key-value cache where hidden blocks are masked rather than removed. On a laptop with Qwen3-1.7B and a synthetic lookup task, showing only the needed block raises accuracy from 93 to 119 of 120, and a masked block is as hidden as a deleted one. The model’s own picking is the weak part. A supervised linear probe written into spare output rows lifts its accuracy from 80 to 110 of 120, but simple keyword search picks perfectly on this task, and the probe does not transfer to a second task. We report these results openly, along with two cheap usage patterns that block switching enables: undoing a failed attempt and running subagents without a new context.

[NLP-24] LoopCache: Accelerating Long-Context Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长上下文场景下环形变压器（Looped Transformers）在自推测解码（self-speculative decoding）过程中存在的两大关键问题：一是现有波式方法（如WaveFront Decoding, WFD 和 LoopSpec）仅在固定循环周期内进行草案生成，忽略了中间预测结果的变化，导致大量计算浪费在过时的推理轨迹上；二是跨不同循环批次处理令牌时，每步需加载最多R倍的键值（Key-Value, KV）缓存，严重加剧了长上下文场景下的内存访问开销。针对上述挑战，本文提出LoopCache框架，其核心创新在于：首先，基于预测切换与输出置信度之间的相关性，引入置信度引导的动态草案更新机制，可在所有中间循环中实时优化正在进行的草案生成；其次，设计循环式循环KV缓存策略，通过循环轮转使用各循环专属的KV缓存，将每步的KV缓存流量限制为单个循环，并对最近匹配周期内的令牌进行批处理以实现无损验证。此外，通过选择性保留少数敏感浅层的独立KV缓存，进一步提升接受率且开销极低。实验表明，LoopCache相较于WFD和LoopSpec分别实现了平均10.25倍和14.56倍的加速。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24301
作者: Zizhuo Fu,Haochen Huang,Shengxuan Qiu,Linye Wei,Ziyu Tang,Runsheng Wang,Meng Li
机构: Peking University (北京大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Looped Transformers achieve large effective depth with compact models by repeatedly applying a weight-shared block across R recurrent steps, each maintaining a loop-specific key-value (KV) cache. To accelerate sequential loop execution, recent wave-style self-speculative methods like WaveFront Decoding (WFD) and LoopSpec pipeline draft and target tokens across loops in a single step. However, they face two critical limitations. First, they draft only at fixed loops and ignore intermediate prediction changes, wasting computation on stale trajectories. Second, batching tokens from different loops loads up to Rx the KV cache per step, severely amplifying memory traffic in long-context scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose LoopCache, an efficient self-speculative decoding framework for long-context Looped Transformers. Based on the correlation between prediction switches and output confidence, LoopCache introduces confidence-guided dynamic draft updating to refine drafts in flight across all intermediate loops. Furthermore, LoopCache employs a cyclic loop KV cache strategy that rotates through loop-specific KV caches, restricting per-step KV traffic to a single loop while batching tokens at the nearest matching cycle for lossless verification. By also selectively retaining independent KV caches for a few loop-sensitive shallow layers, LoopCache improves acceptance rates with negligible overhead. Experiments show that LoopCache achieves average 10.25x and 14.56x speedup over WFD and LoopSpec.

[NLP-25] LipSpell: A Language-Independent Phonetic Scoring Framework for Spelling Correction Combining Distinctive-Feature Edit Distance Keyboard Geometry and Corpus Frequency

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自动拼写纠错中同时处理键盘输入错误与基于发音近似的认知性拼写错误（即语音类拼写错误）的难题。传统拼写检查器依赖于正字法编辑距离或键盘邻近性，难以应对发音错误导致的多字符偏差；而基于英语中心的音似编码（如Soundex、Metaphone）则缺乏语言泛化能力。其解决方案的关键在于提出LipSpell——一个统一、语言无关的音似评分引擎，结合可替换的语言特定音素转写（G2P）前端、键盘映射和词典，并引入三项核心机制：(1) 基于通用国际音标（IPA）区别特征预计算的|P|×|P|音素距离矩阵，实现跨语言音似度建模；(2) 融合物理键盘布局几何信息以增强键盘误击建模；(3) 利用语料库一元频次先验进行置信度加权，通过两阶段对称删除与七类音素编码索引加速计算。该方法在六种英语基准测试中全面超越Norvig、Hunspell与Aspell，在多种非英语语言（包括巴西葡萄牙语、俄语、土耳其语、希伯来语、法语）上展现出强大的固定权重迁移性能，且在部分语言经调参后显著优于现有方法，验证了其在多语言场景下的有效性与普适性。

作者: Leonardo Araujo
机构: Universidade Federal de São João del-Rei (UFSJ); São João del-Rei, MG, Brazil
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automatic spelling correction must handle both keyboard typographical slips and cognitive or phonetic misspellings where writers approximate a word’s pronunciation. Conventional spell checkers rely either on orthographic edit distance and keyboard proximity–which struggle when phonetic errors diverge by multiple characters–or on English-centric phonetic hashes such as Soundex and Metaphone. We present LipSpell, a unified, language-independent phonetic scoring engine paired with swappable language-specific G2P frontends, keyboard maps, and lexicons integrating: (1) a precomputed |P|x|P| phone-distance matrix from universal IPA distinctive features, (2) physical keyboard geometry, and (3) corpus unigram frequency priors, accelerated by a two-stage symmetric-delete and seven-class phonetic-code index. Across six English benchmarks (including 1,000 L2 errors from TOEFL-Spell), LipSpell outperforms Norvig and Hunspell on every dataset and beats Aspell on Norvig1 (78.52% vs. 75.56%), Holbrook (32.00% vs. 26.67%), and TOEFL-Spell (77.30% vs. 72.80%). Evaluated across six languages spanning five branches (Germanic, Romance, Slavic, Semitic, Turkic), three families (Indo-European, Afro-Asiatic, Turkic), and three scripts, LipSpell achieves strong fixed-weight transfer on Brazilian Portuguese (73.00% Top-1 on n=500 Wikipedia without NFD tolerance and 75.80% with NFD vs. 66.40% Norvig, 64.20% Hunspell, 64.00% Aspell) and Russian Cyrillic (85.67% vs. 78.50% Norvig). On 50/50 clean non-word splits with lexicon cleaning and weak-character indels, tuning yields strong gains over Norvig in Portuguese (86.97% vs. 76.75%), Turkish (81.67% vs. 79.05%), Hebrew Abjad (74.59% vs. 62.30%), and French (74.53% vs. 67.92%), while fixed weights remain optimal for English (80.37%) and Russian (85.67%).

[NLP-26] From a finite subgroup of SO(3):C_2 leads to a Holant dichotomy

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在Holant框架下，针对复数域上偶数元签名集且不使用辅助一元签名的普遍情形下的计数复杂性问题，这一领域在一般情况下仍处于开放状态。其核心挑战在于理解当二元签名所诱导的矩阵群结构满足 M(B(F))≅C2M(\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{F})) \cong C_2M(B(F))≅C2​ 时，相关计数问题的复杂性边界。解决方案的关键在于：首先，通过将二元签名矩阵的投影等价类嵌入到 SO(3)SO(3)SO(3) 的有限子群中，建立起一个代数化的结构分类视角；其次，识别出 C2C_2C2​ 情形下的两种根本不同的行为模式——正规（normal）与各向同性（isotropic）情形，并分别进行复杂性分析；再者，综合运用器件构造、分解技术、插值论证以及一种实化（realnumberization）方法，将复数设定转化为等价的实结构框架，从而实现对所有满足条件的偶数元签名集 F\mathcal{F}F 构建完整的复杂性二分定理，证明 Holant(F)\mathrm{Holant}(\mathcal{F})Holant(F) 要么可在多项式时间内计算，要么为#P-困难。此外，论文引入了以泡利基（Pauli-basis）表示的签名语言，作为一种代数上自然的形式体系，用于组织可实现的签名并揭示标准基下不易察觉的结构性关系。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Counting complexity within the Holant framework has been extensively studied through complexity dichotomy theorems. While substantial progress has been achieved for various restricted settings, the general complex-valued even-arity case without auxiliary unary signatures remains largely open. This paper studies a fundamental case in this program where the binary signatures induce a group structure satisfying (M(B(\mathcalF))\cong C_2). It is observed that projective equivalence classes of binary signature matrices naturally embed into finite subgroups of (SO(3)), providing an algebraic viewpoint for structural classification. This paper further identifies two fundamentally different regimes for the (C_2) case, namely the normal and isotropic cases, and analyzes their complexity behavior separately. Combining gadget constructions, decomposition techniques, interpolation arguments, and a realnumberization approach that transforms the complex-valued setting into an equivalent real-structured framework, this paper establishes a complete dichotomy theorem: for every even-arity signature set (\mathcalF) satisfying (M(\B(\mathcalF))\cong C_2), the problem (\mathrmHolant(\mathcalF)) is either polynomial-time computable or #P-hard. A Pauli-basis representation for signatures is further introduced as an algebraically natural language for organizing realizable signatures and revealing structural relations that are less transparent in the standard basis. [NLP-27] CounselTraj: Synthesizing Process-Aware Psychological Counseling Dialogues via Dialogue-Act Trajectory Planning EACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（LLM）的心理咨询系统在训练过程中缺乏大规模高质量对话数据的问题，尤其是真实心理咨询对话因隐私保护难以获取，而现有合成数据集普遍存在对话片段化、未能体现会话层面咨询流程的缺陷。其核心解决方案是提出CounselTraj框架——一种对话行为轨迹规划方法，通过从人类咨询师进行的角色扮演对话中学习对话行为模式，构建客户与咨询师协同的会话级行为轨迹，并以此作为灵活引导，将简短的合成对话扩展为具备过程感知能力的完整会话级心理咨询对话。该方法显著提升了生成对话的完整性、连贯性及咨询干预质量。基于此，研究构建了CounselTrajD数据集（含超1万条中文过程引导式心理咨询对话），并据此训练出CounselTrajLM模型，在响应质量、治疗理解与干预策略、以及咨询流程连贯性与进展性等维度均优于现有公开的中文心理咨询模型。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24168
作者: Zhiyang Qi,Michimasa Inaba
机构: The University of Tokyo (东京大学); The University of Electro-Communications (电气通信大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Accepted to EACL 2027 Main Conference

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The growing demand for psychological counseling has motivated the development of LLM-based systems that support human counselors, but training such systems requires large-scale, high-quality dialogue data. Authentic counseling transcripts are difficult to collect and share because of privacy concerns, making synthetic dialogues an important alternative. However, existing synthetic datasets, despite covering diverse scenarios and client profiles, often consist of brief exchanges and fail to capture session-level counseling processes. We propose CounselTraj, a dialogue-act trajectory planning framework for expanding brief synthetic dialogues into process-aware, session-level psychological counseling dialogues. CounselTraj learns dialogue-act patterns from role-play counseling dialogues produced by human counselors, plans coordinated trajectories for clients and counselors, and uses them as flexible guidance for long-form dialogue generation. Experiments across three Chinese synthetic counseling datasets show that CounselTraj produces more complete and coherent sessions with higher-quality counselor interventions than both direct expansion and expansion with randomly sampled trajectories. Based on CounselTraj, we construct CounselTrajD, a dataset containing over 10K process-guided Chinese psychological counseling dialogues, and use it to train CounselTrajLM for counseling response generation. Evaluations at both the response and session levels show that CounselTrajLM outperforms publicly available Chinese counseling models in response quality, therapeutic understanding and intervention, and counseling-process coherence and progress. Our code and model are publicly available at this https URL.

[NLP-28] Once Upon a Bias: Gender Stereotyping in LLM -Generated Childrens Stories

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在创作儿童睡前故事时可能存在的性别刻板印象问题，尤其关注模型是否根据目标读者的性别差异调整叙事内容。其核心解决方案在于提出一个多层级评估框架，融合上下文调整后的词汇率对比、相对刻板印象契合度分析、叙述者-接收者互动建模、人工评价以及表征层面的干预手段，以系统性揭示并解释生成故事中隐含的性别偏差。研究发现，面向儿子的故事普遍赋予更高能动性（agency）和更低亲社会性（communion），而叙述者性别对这一模式的调节作用有限，但高社交性特征表现出更显著的交互效应；人类评估结果具有一致性，但与词法指标的对应关系因叙事维度而异；此外，隐藏状态分析证实了接收者性别信息在模型内部可被解码。这些发现表明，尽管存在情境依赖性，生成式模型在儿童故事创作中仍持续存在表征不平等，亟需发展针对具体叙事场景的偏见评估方法，超越传统短文本基准测试。

Abstract:Large language models are increasingly used to create stories for children. Since bedtime stories can shape children’s perceptions of social roles, this raises concerns about whether LLMs adapt narrative portrayals according to the intended recipient’s gender. We conducted a large-scale study to examine gender stereotyping in LLM-generated bedtime stories. Using matched daughter/son prompts and a five-generation design, we analyze 62,873 retained stories from 16 LLMs across 35 country settings and 12 narrator roles. We introduce a multi-level evaluation framework combining context-adjusted lexical rate contrasts, relative stereotype alignment, narrator-recipient interaction analysis, human evaluation, and representation-level interventions to examine both the consistency and interpretability of these differences. Our results reveal systematic differences in narrative framing: son-directed stories emphasize higher agency and lower communion compared to daughter-directed stories. While narrator gender expresses limited moderation on these patterns, high sociability exhibits a more pronounced interaction. Human evaluations demonstrate consistent agreement, although correspondence with lexical measures varies across narrative dimensions. Additionally, hidden-state analyses reveal decodable recipient-gender information. These findings demonstrate persistent yet context-dependent representational disparities in LLM-generated children’s stories and motivate narrative-specific bias evaluation beyond short-form benchmarks.

[NLP-29] Constructing Dynamic Conversations with Neural Back-channel Generation and Voice-line Scheduling

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决游戏行业中双人对话音频轨道（dyadic conversational audio）在独立录制或合成后缺乏自然互动性的问题，具体表现为两路语音信号在时间上不同步、缺乏可控的回应行为（back-channeling）与话轮转换（turn-taking）动态。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于神经调度器（neural scheduler）的框架，通过动态调整两路语音轨道的时间对齐，智能插入或删除静音段，并在适当位置引入语音重叠，从而生成具有自然对话流动性的统一对话流。该方法的关键创新在于引入一个可预测回应时机的回应对话预测器（back-channel predictor），能够根据当前发言内容与音频特征判断是否适宜插入回应行为，进而由调度器进行整合控制。实验表明，该系统在定量指标、感知质量以及动画师对回应多样性、强度和性质的可控性方面均显著优于基线方法，实现了高质量、可调控的交互式语音合成。

类目: ound (cs.SD); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:We present a novel approach to the problem of combining two voice-line channels of dyadic conversational audio into a unified conversation with controllable back-channeling and turn-taking dynamics. In voice performances for the game industry, the two tracks of voice-lines are typically recorded or synthesized in isolation. Our method takes two such unsynchronized tracks and uses a neural scheduler to sequence them into a single dynamic conversation, modifying both tracks by inserting or removing pauses and introducing voice overlap as appropriate. We further propose a back-channel predictor that is able to predict opportunity for back-channels for a given conversational turn’s audio and content, which the scheduler can then incorporate. We evaluate our scheduler and predictor independently and in combination by: various quantitative comparison; a qualitative and perceptual comparison to prior art and naive baselines; a compelling set of results showing animator control over the diversity, extent and nature of back-channeling and turn dynamics.

[NLP-30] Meaning Reaches Object Choice but Not Completion: Where Is a VLA Vulnerable to Landmark Synonyms?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在面对指令重述（rewording）时的脆弱性问题，尤其关注自然语言指令中目标地标词（landmark word）的同义词替换对策略执行效果的影响。核心问题是：仅依赖成功率无法判断策略失败是源于对象选择错误还是任务执行中断，也无法定位需要干预的具体模块。解决方案的关键在于识别并干预连接视觉-语言模型与动作生成器之间的“连接器”（connector）模块——通过在连接器前将地标词向量替换为另一地标词的向量（即“粘贴”操作），几乎可使所有闭环任务实例导向错误目标；而在连接器后进行类似操作则效果有限，唯有同时干预两个输入源（如指令与图像令牌）才有效。此外，通过对多样化地标词进行微调可修复同义词未出现在训练中的任务完成率，且仅微调连接器即可实现此修复效果，甚至可将经多样化数据微调的连接器迁移至原始指令微调的策略中。研究强调，应以闭环执行结果评估鲁棒性，需分别评估选择正确性与任务完成度，并在连接器两侧进行干预分析，而开环评分可能遗漏非连接器部分权重的贡献。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24076
作者: Ryoichi Kurihara,Kota Sunamoto
机构: MAMEZO Co., Ltd.(MAMEZO有限公司)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted to the CoRL 2026 Workshop on The Action Gap (TAG 2026). OpenReview: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:VLA policies are fragile to rewording. Success rates alone cannot say whether a policy fails to choose the object or to complete the task, nor where in the policy to intervene. We study the released GR00T N1.7 on two LIBERO-Spatial tasks differing only in the landmark word telling which of two bowls to take. Synonyms absent from the training instructions send the policy to the bowl they name, unlike made-up words, yet complete 67.6% of one task’s closed-loop episodes, against the original word’s 100%. Before the connector between the vision-language model and the action generator, replacing only the landmark tokens’ vectors with the other landmark’s (pasting) sends nearly every episode to the other bowl. After the connector, pasting at the landmark, the remaining instruction, or the image tokens alone rarely moves the choice, but any two do. Hiding the landmark tokens from the action generator after the connector still lowers completion for the synonyms that fall short. Finetuning on diversified landmark words repairs that one task’s completion for synonyms absent from finetuning; finetuning on the original instructions does not. Training only the connector on the diversified words suffices, as does copying the connector of a policy fully finetuned on them into one finetuned on the original instructions. An open-loop score on starting frames misses that weights outside the connector also carry part of the repair. For now, on this evidence, robustness to rewording should be judged in closed loop, with actions executed, intervening on both sides of the connector, scoring choice and completion separately.

[NLP-31] Measuring and Charging for Retained Context in Long-Context LLM Services

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长上下文大语言模型（Long-context Large Language Model, LLM）服务中因重复上下文导致的计费不合理问题，即当前计费机制未准确反映重复上下文对生成质量的实际贡献。其核心解决方案在于提出一个三层框架，将内容相关性（content relevance）、可观测代理指标（observable proxies）与可审计的位置权重（auditable positional weights）进行分离。通过上下文消融实验发现，内容相关性在决定输出质量方面显著优于位置信息，且距离衰减类权重策略并不优于仅基于相关性的基准方案。实测部署结果显示，在65,536个标记长度下，缓存命中可使重复前缀的计算成本降低两个数量级以上，而冷重启重传则限制了可持续折扣的规模。跨服务商测量进一步区分了缓存价值与分词差异及定价策略的影响。经校准的模拟表明，该框架可将会话费用的99百分位降低31%-42%，尽管收益匹配的非线性计价策略也能达到类似降费效果，但会导致中位数费用上升。总体而言，该框架提供了一种有界且可量化的每标记会计规则以及实际部署约束条件，而非对服务效用的验证性估计。

作者: Yi Lu,Qianshi Lin,Yumeng Yang,Hongxia Wang
机构: 未知
类目: Performance (cs.PF); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 33 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables, including Appendices A-F; code and recorded data included as ancillary material

Abstract:Long-context large language model (LLM) services charge for repeated context, yet billing weights need not reflect its contribution to answer quality. We present a three-layer framework separating content relevance, observable proxies and auditable positional weights. Context-ablation experiments show that relevance dominates position and that distance-decay families do not outperform a relevance-only baseline. A measured serving stack shows that cache hits reduce repeated-prefix compute cost by over two orders of magnitude at 65,536 tokens, while cold resends constrain sustainable discounts. Cross-provider measurements separate cache value from tokenisation and list-price differences. Calibrated simulations reduce the 99th percentile of session charges by 31-42%, although revenue-matched nonlinear tariffs achieve similar reductions and median charges increase. The framework provides a bounded per-token accounting rule and measured deployment constraints, rather than a validated utility estimator.

[NLP-32] MIRAG E: A Framework for Multi-hop Reasoning under Dynamic Knowledge Injection COLING2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多跳问答（Multi-hop Question Answering, MQA）在知识注入（Knowledge Injection）场景下的核心挑战，即当模型需同时处理与已有知识冲突的更新信息（K2）和完全新增的知识（K3）时，如何有效避免因信任错误知识源而导致的推理偏差。现有方法多聚焦于简单事实修改，忽视了更复杂且现实的知识注入情境。其关键问题在于：模型在多跳推理中易受过时参数化记忆干扰（导致误信旧知识），或在面对全新事实时无法生成有效回答（缺乏新知识支持）。为应对这一问题，作者提出MIRAGE框架，其核心是相关性感知双路径推理器（Correlation-aware Dual-path Reasoner, CDR），通过基于真实概率（P(True)）的置信度路由机制，动态识别并引导模型信任更可靠的证据源；同时结合轻量级模板引导修正器，对残余结构偏差进行精细化调整。该方案无需训练即可显著提升跨四类大语言模型及两个基准的数据集上的最终答案准确率与每跳推理准确性，确立了知识注入环境下多跳问答的新基准。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24058
作者: Heyang Xu,HanWen Hao,Haifeng Wang,Haoyi Zhou,Jianxin Li
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Submitted to COLING 2027. 15 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-hop Question Answering (MQA) requires large language models (LLMs) to retrieve and synthesize multiple pieces of evidence into a coherent reasoning path, which is essential for complex tasks. However, prior work on knowledge updating for MQA has largely focused on simple fact edits, overlooking a more challenging and realistic setting—\emphKnowledge Injection—in which the model must simultaneously accommodate both conflicting updates and entirely novel information. Under this setting, a hop-level answer is often wrong simply because the model trusts the wrong knowledge source: it clings to outdated parametric memory when the injected knowledge conflicts with it (K2), and it cannot answer when the required fact is entirely new (K3). To investigate this, we introduce NEXUS, the first benchmark tailored for multi-hop reasoning under Knowledge Injection, which explicitly covers both conflicting (K2) and incremental (K3) knowledge. We further propose MIRAGE, an efficient, training-free framework whose core component, the Correlation-aware Dual-path Reasoner (CDR), resolves such per-hop source-trust errors via P(True)-based confidence routing, complemented by a lightweight template-guided corrector for residual structural deviations. Extensive experiments across four LLM families and two benchmarks demonstrate that MIRAGE consistently improves both final-answer accuracy and hop-level reasoning accuracy, establishing a new state of the art in this challenging setting. [NLP-33] Grading Executable Legal Rules Against Independent Records: Transitional Provisions and Korean SME Status

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决法律程序化过程中存在的“表面合规”问题，即生成的法律判断程序可能通过模仿评分者对法律条文的主观理解而获得高分，而非真正准确反映法律的实际适用结果。其核心挑战在于传统评分机制依赖于人工评阅者的解读，导致程序得分虚高，无法真实评估其法律准确性。解决方案的关键是引入基于真实历史数据的客观验证标准——以韩国上市公司披露的10,901个企业年度的中小企业（SME）身份记录为基准，结合各版本法规文本进行实证检验，从而实现对法律程序执行效果的客观量化评估。该方法揭示了过渡性条款等非主文内容对判决结果的重要影响，并验证了作者对争议条款的解读在多数情况下更符合实际情形。此外，研究发现，当以作者解读为标准时，大语言模型（LLM）的表现看似更优，但这一优势在真实历史数据面前显著缩小甚至消失，说明基于评阅者主观理解的评分方式会夸大程序的实际性能。因此，该研究强调，应将法律程序的评估基准从“人为解读”转向“真实事件记录”，以提升法律自动化系统的可信度与可靠性。

作者: Jinhyung Bae
机构: Hankuk University of Foreign Studies (韩国外国语大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 51 pages, 2 figures (plus 1 in the appendix). Submitted to Artificial Intelligence and Law. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Laws are increasingly turned into programs that decide cases, such as whether a firm was a small or medium enterprise (SME) on a given date, and large language models (LLMs) now write them. The programs are usually graded against answers written by someone who read the same law, so a program can score well by sharing the grader’s reading rather than by getting the law right. LexTemporis grades them instead against records of what actually happened: 10,901 firm-years of SME status disclosed by Korean listed companies, with every version of the governing rules. An appendix adds comparison cases from US income tax and German hospital minimum volumes. The date changes outcomes mainly through provisions outside the main statutory text: one transitional provision raises agreement with the disclosures from 83-86% to 89-90%. The disclosures also test the author’s reading of a contested provision, favouring it in 130 of 189 firm-years where readings diverge. Four LLMs wrote the rules, given different selections of the law. A pre-registered comparison finds no condition better across all four models. In exploratory analyses, supplying the right provisions looks better graded against the author’s reading than against the records: the advantage shrinks for three models (for one, to between a quarter and three-fifths of its size), and per firm-year it is several times larger where the author’s reading is wrong, partly by construction, since there reproducing that reading more faithfully must lose. Grading legal programs against the grader’s own reading can overstate how well they work.

[NLP-34] A Hybrid RAG Framework for Deceptive Review Detection: Integrating RoBERTa-LoRA FAISS-Based Retrieval and LLM Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决虚假在线评论（spam reviews）泛滥所引发的虚假信息与欺诈风险问题，其核心挑战在于如何在真实世界中存在数据分布严重失衡的情况下，实现对虚假评论的高精度、可解释性自动识别。解决方案的关键在于提出一种检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）架构，该架构融合了基于低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）微调的RoBERTa分类器、基于FAISS的语义向量检索模块以及大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）进行最终推理。该设计通过引入外部语义知识检索与上下文增强推理机制，显著提升了模型在跨域场景下的鲁棒性与泛化能力，仅需5个训练周期即可实现稳定的领域迁移，在交叉领域评估中达到0.90的F1分数，优于基线模型（OpenAI Detector，F1 = 0.82），并接近专用领域最先进模型（fakeRoBERTa，F1 = 0.97）。此外，该系统通过证据支持的可解释性机制实现了统计上显著的精确率提升，同时保持了与现有方法相当的整体检测性能。

Abstract:The growth of deceptive online opinions poses a critical risk of misinformation and fraud. This paper proposes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to automatically distinguish spam reviews. The architecture integrates RoBERTa with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) classification, FAISS semantic vector retrieval, and a Large Language Model (LLM) for final reasoning. The system was evaluated across balanced and severely imbalanced real-world scenarios. Results demonstrate that five epochs of fine-tuning enable robust domain transfer, achieving an F1-score of 0.90 in cross-domain evaluation, outperforming baselines (OpenAI Detector,F1 = 0.82) and demonstrating competitive performance against specialized in-domain SOTA models (fakeRoBERTa,F1 = 0.97). The proposed architecture provides evidence-backed explainability and statistically significant precision gains while maintaining comparable overall detection performance.

[NLP-35] Compression Effects on Low-Resource Multilingual Translation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低资源非洲语言（豪萨语、斯瓦希里语和约鲁巴语）在多语言机器翻译（Multilingual Machine Translation, MMT）中面临的模型性能与推理成本之间的权衡问题，尤其关注后训练量化（Post-training Quantisation）对翻译质量与推理效率的影响。其核心问题是：如何在保持高翻译质量的前提下，通过量化技术降低模型部署的计算与内存开销，以适应消费级硬件（如NVIDIA T4 GPU）的限制。解决方案的关键在于验证后训练量化在不同精度（FP16、bitsandbytes INT8、NF4 INT4）下对三类模型（通用大语言模型、指令微调的多语言大模型、专用多语言翻译模型）的性能影响，发现尽管量化可实现高达49%-61%的内存节省，但推理延迟反而上升1.3至5.3倍，且翻译质量损失极小（最大仅2.19 chrF），同时揭示了专用多语言翻译模型在低资源语言上显著优于通用模型（性能领先12.9-43.3 chrF），并呈现出与训练资源可用性相关的性能梯度。研究结果表明，未来应聚焦于面向硬件特性的压缩策略及超越聚合指标的错误类型分析，以优化低资源语言的高效部署。

作者: Abbas Sani
机构: Arewa Data Science; Aboki AI; Kano, Nigeria
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:We present a pilot study characterising the effect of post-training quantisation on multilingual machine translation quality and inference cost for three African languages - Hausa, Swahili, and Yoruba - across three model families: a small general-purpose LLM (Qwen2.5-1.5B), a larger multilingual instruction-tuned LLM (Aya-23-8B), and a dedicated multilingual MT model (NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B). Evaluating on the FLORES-200 devtest set (1,012 sentences per direction) under FP16, bitsandbytes INT8, and NF4 INT4 precisions on consumer-grade NVIDIA T4 GPUs, we find: (i) the specialised MT model outperforms both LLMs by 32.7-43.3 chrF on the Hausa and Swahili directions, and by 12.9-24.7 chrF on Yoruba, despite being roughly a sixth the size of the 8B instruction-tuned LLM; (ii) post-training quantisation preserves aggregate translation quality within approximately 1 chrF across all model families and language directions, with a single worst case of 2.19 chrF; (iii) on consumer GPUs, INT8 and INT4 quantisation provide substantial memory savings (49-61% at INT4) but do not reduce inference latency relative to FP16 - in fact, latency increases by 1.3x to 5.3x; (iv) a clear performance gradient tracking training-resource availability is visible across languages (Swahili Hausa Yoruba). These findings motivate a research agenda focused on hardware-aware compression and error-type analysis beyond aggregate metrics for low-resource deployment.

[NLP-36] Rethinking Fixed-Horizon Latent Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有隐式推理（latent reasoner）在推理过程中采用固定潜伏时域（latent horizon）所带来的性能瓶颈问题。研究表明，尽管延长潜伏时域看似能提供更多推理机会，但实际运行中过度延伸可能导致推理性能下降，原因在于隐式思维链（latent Chain-of-Thought, CoT）会经历不同功能阶段：早期计算生成具有前瞻性的推理状态，而后期计算主要对已有候选解进行重组，反而削弱了正确答案的支持。针对这一现象，论文提出以“已实现的建设性进展”（realized constructive progress）与“剩余建设性进展”（remaining constructive progress）为指标，量化隐式CoT的推理价值。实证发现，更高的已实现进展对应当前推理准确性，而更多的剩余进展则预示未来继续推理可能带来的增益。基于此，论文设计了一种轻量级自适应机制，通过估计剩余推理进展动态调整潜伏时域，在不重新训练大语言模型（LLM）的前提下，显著提升了多个算术基准上的推理准确率（最高提升7.2个百分点），同时减少高达29.0%的隐式计算开销。其核心解决方案在于引入基于进展评估的动态时域控制策略，实现了效率与准确性的双重优化。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24001
作者: Tianxiang Chen,Jingyuan Zhou,Weiming Yang,Kaidi Yang
机构: National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 21 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Existing latent reasoners typically run for a preset latent horizon during inference. Intuitively, a longer horizon should provide more opportunity for reasoning. However, in this work, we find that extending latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to the full preset horizon may in fact degrade reasoning performance. We observe that latent CoT evolves through distinct functional stages, with earlier computation forming frontier reasoning states, while later computation mainly reorganizes existing candidates and can weaken gold candidate support. These findings motivate a rethink of fixed-horizon latent inference. To address this, we characterize the reasoning benefits of latent CoT by realized and remaining constructive progress. Empirically, we find that higher realized constructive progress corresponds to higher current reasoning accuracy, while more remaining progress corresponds to larger future gains from continued latent CoT. To this end, we introduce a lightweight method that estimates the remaining reasoning progress and adaptively adjusts the latent horizon during inference. Across representative latent CoT reasoners and multiple arithmetic benchmarks, our method improves reasoning accuracy by up to 7.2 percentage points while reducing latent computation by up to 29.0%, without retraining the LLM.

[NLP-37] A Mechanistic Analysis of In-Context Learning and Out-of-Context Hallucination

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在上下文学习（in-context learning, ICL）中虽能遵循特定规则却易产生脱离上下文（out-of-context, OOC）幻觉的问题，即模型在推理过程中未能忠实于提供的证据。其核心挑战在于，现有研究通常将ICL机制与OOC幻觉的成因分开探讨，导致难以揭示二者背后的统一机理。本文提出一种基于动态上下文中功能角色（functional role）的统一视角，关键发现是：角色信息可在模型内部被表征，但其表征并不必然约束输出结果。通过一阶分解分析，作者揭示角色效应的显著影响依赖于两个必要条件：充分的角色贡献量级和一致的符号聚合（coherent signed aggregation）。因果分析进一步表明，角色跨度（role span）的贡献直接影响响应结构、内容选择及事实值等关键决策点。当关键决策处获得足够的角色跨度支持时，模型倾向于做出与角色一致的选择；反之则可能产生错误，且此类错误可通过增强角色跨度支持而逆转。这些发现共同构建了一个统一的机制框架：每个功能角色定义了输出决策的模式，角色跨度贡献的有效性决定了决策是否符合角色意图，而不同组织方式下的角色作用差异正是导致ICL成功与OOC幻觉这一看似对立现象的根本原因。

Abstract:Large language models can infer and follow specific rules through in-context learning (ICL), yet may fail to remain faithful to provided evidence, giving rise to out-of-context (OOC) hallucination. Existing work has largely investigated the underlying mechanisms of ICL and OOC hallucination along separate lines. However, this separation obscures the mechanistic basis for these seemingly opposing outcomes. In this work, we study this contrast through the unified view of functional roles in dynamic context. The key observation is that role information can be internally represented without reliably constraining output. We derive a first-order decomposition to characterize the role effect, showing that its substantial influence depends on two necessary conditions, namely sufficient contribution magnitude and coherent signed aggregation. Causal analysis further shows that role span contributions affect key token choices involving response structure, content selection, and factual values. We further show that role-consistent choices depend on sufficient role span support at these key decisions, while failing choices can be reversed when this support overcomes the deficit. These findings support a common mechanistic view of ICL and OOC hallucination: each functional role defines the pattern of output decisions over which role span contributions must remain effective, and differences in this organization account for the seemingly opposing outcomes.

[NLP-38] Coverag e Governs Accuracy: When to Expand the Lexicon and When to Fall Back in Low-Resource Manchu OCR

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低资源满文（Manchu）字符级光学字符识别（character-level OCR）中因词形变化复杂而产生的近似拼写错误问题。传统基于固定词典的约束解码虽可借助词汇知识纠正错误，但受限于无法覆盖黏着语构词所产生的大量未见词形。本文提出通过形态学扩展（morphological expansion）缓解这一局限性，其关键在于：首先利用词典基干列表对训练文本进行分词，提取词根与后缀链；进而生成约51万条候选词形，基于验证集上的频率排序筛选最优扩展规模；并采用“覆盖率×词典内精确率”的分解方式评估在严格词典约束下的识别性能。实验表明，在约29,000词的基础词典中加入25万条候选词形，可使已见词根组合的未见形式类型准确率从63.6%提升至86.3%，整体词元准确率由82.4%增至84.2%；然而全部候选词形的引入反而导致整体词元准确率下降至81.5%，说明扩大词典规模会以牺牲词典内精确率为代价。进一步对比显示，基础词典结合置信度回退机制的系统在所有测试的CRNN模型中表现最佳，分别达到76.1%的类型准确率和85.5%的词元准确率，优于扩展词典无论是否启用回退策略。Transformer识别器亦呈现相似趋势。研究结论表明，形态学扩展虽能缓解固定词典的局限性，但更大词典并不必然带来更优识别效果；在当前低资源满文OCR场景下，可靠词典约束与开放识别相结合的有选择性策略更具有效性。

Abstract:Character-level OCR for low-resource Manchu often produces near-miss spelling errors. Lexicon-constrained decoding can correct such errors with lexical knowledge, but a fixed dictionary cannot cover the many unseen word forms produced by agglutinative word formation. We study whether morphological expansion alleviates this limitation, and how the expansion size and confidence fallback affect recognition. We segment the training transcriptions with a dictionary-based stem list, extract roots and suffix chains from them, generate about 510k candidates, select the expansion size through frequency ranking on the validation set, and decompose accuracy under hard lexicon constraints into the product of coverage and in-lexicon precision. Across three CRNN training seeds, adding 250k candidates to a base dictionary of about 29k words raises the type accuracy on unseen combinations of seen roots from 63.6% to 86.3%, and overall token accuracy from 82.4% to 84.2%. Adding all candidates lowers overall token accuracy to 81.5%, showing that the coverage gain comes with a loss of in-lexicon precision. A further comparison shows that the base dictionary with confidence fallback performs best overall among the CRNN systems tested, reaching 76.1% type and 85.5% token accuracy and outperforming the expanded lexicon both with and without fallback. A Transformer recognizer shows similar trends. These results indicate that morphological expansion relieves the constraint of a fixed dictionary, but a larger lexicon does not guarantee better recognition; in the present low-resource Manchu OCR setting, a selective combination of reliable lexical constraints and open recognition is more effective.

[NLP-39] NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中大规模语言模型（LLM）推理速度瓶颈问题，具体聚焦于推测解码（Speculative Decoding）技术中草案模型（draft model）的计算开销过高这一关键挑战。传统方法如DFlash和EAGLE-3等依赖于与目标模型（target model）相同宽度的隐藏状态，导致草案模型资源消耗大且难以高效部署。本文提出的核心解决方案是：将草案模型的整个残差流（residual stream）宽度缩减至原宽的二分之一或四分之一，同时通过精心设计的输出适配器（output adapter）保留目标模型的词汇投影能力，使得最终输出的logits在浮点精度允许范围内保持不变。实验结果表明，在SGLang框架下，基于B200和DGX Spark（GB10）平台对Qwen3-8B（NVFP4）与GPT-OSS-20B（MXFP4）进行测试，在批处理大小为1、温度为0的条件下，草案模型宽度减半或四分之一可带来1.06–1.12倍（B200）和1.13–1.44倍（GB10）的端到端解码加速；在更大批处理规模下，加速比最高可达1.21倍，且无一例窄版草案模型慢于全宽版本。该方案的关键在于利用训练后输出适配器将原本独立的词汇投影整合进更窄的草案模型中，从而在不损失接受率的前提下显著降低计算与内存开销。

Abstract:Speculative decoding is widely used to speed up generation in large language models (LLMs), with a small draft model proposing tokens that one forward pass of the target model verifies. Draft models that read the target’s hidden states, such as DFlash and EAGLE-3, typically inherit the target’s hidden width. We show that the draft’s whole residual stream can run at half or a quarter of that width while largely preserving acceptance. For DFlash, which borrows the target’s vocabulary projection, the trained output adapter folds into it, giving one narrower projection with logits unchanged up to floating-point rounding. We test two drafter families, DFlash and EAGLE-3, on two targets, Qwen3-8B (NVFP4) and GPT-OSS-20B (MXFP4), in SGLang on a B200 and a DGX Spark (GB10). At batch size 1 and temperature 0, narrowing the draft to half or a quarter width speeds up end-to-end decoding by 1.06-1.12x on B200 and 1.13-1.44x on GB10. The speedup holds at larger batch sizes. From batch 32 to the largest batch each GPU fits, narrowing reaches up to 1.21x on both GPUs, and no narrow draft is slower than full width.

[NLP-40] A System 1 Decision Model for Medical Multiple-Choice Questions Built on Frozen Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在医学多选题（MedMCQA）上，如何利用轻量级、无需微调的生成式模型（Generative AI）实现高效且低成本的推理问题。其核心挑战在于：医学知识类题目中正确选项与问题之间的语义相似性并不显著高于错误选项，传统基于相似度匹配的方法难以有效区分。为此，研究提出一种“系统1”（System 1）范式，采用冻结的语言模型将问题与各选项编码为向量，仅训练两个小型投影头（projection heads）和一个温度参数，在共享嵌入空间中通过对比损失（contrastive loss）进行优化，并引入批次内负样本（in-batch negatives）和困难负样本（hard negatives）以增强区分能力。关键创新在于使用“一词摘要提示”（one-word-summary prompt）对输入文本进行重构，同时降低投影头的学习率，从而显著提升小规模模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 Granite-4.2-3B）在测试集上的准确率，分别达到41.7%和42.5%，而大模型Qwen3-8B则达到46.0%±0.2。实验表明，随机打乱问题与选项的对应关系会使准确率回落至随机水平（25%），证明模型确实利用了问题信息。尽管性能仍低于Flan-PaLM和Med-PaLM 2等先进模型，但该方法提供了一个快速、低成本的基准方案，适用于资源受限场景。值得注意的是，研究也指出其局限性：验证集增益约为测试集的1.7–2倍，且无法分离多层编码器读取与其它改进措施的独立影响。

Abstract:A System 1 model answers a multiple-choice question in a single pass. A frozen language model turns the question and each option into vectors, two small, trained heads place them in a shared space, and the closest option wins. The design has been shown on agent decisions, but we are not aware of a study of how far it goes on exam questions that need medical knowledge, where the right option is often no more similar to the question than the wrong ones. We rebuilt the recipe from scratch for MedMCQA and trained only two projection heads and one temperature on top of frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B, Granite-4.2-3B and Qwen3-8B, using a contrastive loss with in-batch and hard negatives and a mask for repeated answers. With plain last-token vectors, both small encoders answer about one question in three correctly (33.1% and 33.0% on 3,842 held-out questions, where chance is 25.0%). Writing each text inside a one-word-summary prompt and lowering the learning rate of the heads raised this to 41.7% and 42.5% for the two small encoders and to 46.0% ±0.2 (three seeds) for Qwen3-8B. Shuffling the questions against the options returns accuracy to chance, so the heads do use the question. Flan-PaLM and Med-PaLM 2 report 57.6% and 72.3% on MedMCQA under a different protocol, so ours is a cheap, fast baseline and not a competitive system. We also say what our evidence cannot show: validation gains were about 1.7 to 2 times the test gains, and we could not separate the effect of reading several encoder layers from the other changes.

[NLP-41] Sightline: Long-Window Speculative Decoding for Fast SVG Generation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式矢量图形（SVG）模型在文本到SVG或图像到SVG生成任务中，因逐标记前向传播导致的绘制速度慢的问题。其核心挑战在于传统推测解码（speculative decoding）在处理SVG时，验证窗口较短，频繁中断推理流程，无法充分利用块草案生成器（block drafter）的长视野能力。解决方案的关键在于提出Sightline方法：将验证窗口扩展至与草案生成器的视野（horizon）一致，并构建足够宽的草案树（draft tree）以填满该窗口。通过运行长度恒等性（run-length identity）及三个理论命题证明，当候选集足够宽时，更长的验证窗口可显著提升效率，且在不引入误差的前提下实现性能最优。实验覆盖多个基准测试与多种模型架构，结果表明Sightline在所有设置下均是最快的无损解码器，尤其在循环结构和无循环内容中，其优势源于对短窗口所截断有效推理轮次的保留。此外，基于渲染的采样策略进一步提升了效率，表明在矢量图形生成中，推测解码应尽可能验证至草案生成器所能感知的最远位置。

Abstract:Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) generation models write a graphic as code with one forward pass per token, so drawing is slow. Speculative decoding speeds them up losslessly, and block drafters guess many tokens per pass. On SVG, many of their rounds accept the whole draft and end only at the verification window. We find that their misses are rare and clumped, and that they stay accurate far deeper into a block than on natural language. A run-length identity and three propositions show that a longer window pays once the candidates are wide, up to the drafter’s horizon. We propose Sightline, which pairs a window as long as the drafter’s horizon with a draft tree wide enough to fill it. Experiments cover text-to-SVG and image-to-SVG with three models on six benchmarks from MMSVG, MMSVG-2M and SArena. In every setting, Sightline is the fastest of the compared lossless decoders. On SArena, it stays the fastest when every decoder shares one loop control. It also leads in almost every setting of six models from four other families, which write SVG code, compressed SVG tokens or Lottie JSON. Analyses trace the lead to rounds that shorter windows cut off, both in loop-free content and in loops. Speculative decoding also saves time for choosing samples by rendering, which beats choosing by likelihood. These results suggest that speculative decoding on vector graphics should verify as far as the drafter sees. Code and data are available at this https URL.

[NLP-42] hinking Fast Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自主大语言模型（LLM）代理在执行任务时因每一步都调用大型模型（System-2）而导致的高昂成本与延迟问题，尤其针对那些中间决策仅需在少量已知候选选项中进行选择的场景。现有双系统代理虽通过轻量级System-1模型对部分决策进行卸载，但其依赖于特定工作流的定制化钩子（hook），缺乏通用性。本文提出AnyS1框架，其核心创新在于将人类编写的程序化技能（procedural skills）中自然蕴含的选择点与适用选项信息，转化为可复用的、领域通用的决策点源（Any-DP）。该框架离线地从超过1000个公开技能中挖掘具身化的可枚举决策，利用隔离容器收集执行过程中的状态轨迹，并基于标签平滑训练一个单一校准的40亿参数（4B）指针型System-1模型。运行时，编译后的工作流可在一次前向传播中完成常规决策，当置信度低于校准阈值时才回退至System-2。在三个未见过的基准测试及不同System-2模型族上，AnyS1在保持任务可靠性的同时，相较于未经编译的System-2代理，将单个任务的总成本降低75%-91%，模型调用时间减少63%-92%，并实现了零样本阈值迁移下的性能稳定。

Abstract:Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决扩散语言模型（Diffusion Language Models, DLMs）在生成过程中对序列错误进行高效修正的难题，尤其针对现有仅支持替换操作的“仅替换编辑”（Replacement-Only Editing, ROE）方法在处理序列位移、多位置错误及大块缺失/冗余时效率低下、纠错能力有限的问题。其核心解决方案是提出一种名为Levenshtein编辑（Levenshtein Editing, LED）的后训练框架，通过引入插入与删除操作，实现类似Levenshtein距离的序列级精细化修正。关键创新在于两点：一是采用基于最长公共子序列（Longest Common Subsequence, LCS）的动态编辑监督机制，在监督微调阶段无需人工标注即可自动生成插入与删除的训练信号；二是设计多阶段训练策略，使模型在后续阶段以先前阶段的输出为输入，主动暴露并修正自身早期生成错误，从而增强自纠正能力。实验表明，该方法显著提升了模型在多个基准上的平均得分，特别是在无置信度引导的解码条件下，平均得分从27.52提升至47.19，并在大块扰动下仍保持优异鲁棒性，验证了其在提升生成多样性与稳定性方面的潜力。

Abstract:Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a flexible alternative to autoregressive models, enabling any-order infilling. While most existing decoding methods treat decoded tokens as fixed, some recent models allow previously decoded tokens to be revised only by replacing them with alternative tokens, a paradigm we refer to as replacement-only editing (ROE). Although ROE can correct individual tokens, it is inefficient for sequence shifts caused by missing or extra tokens and struggles when errors occur across many positions. To address these limitations, we propose LED (Levenshtein Editing for Diffusion Language Models), a post-training framework that extends ROE with insertion and deletion, enabling Levenshtein-style refinement of generated sequences. It uses two training designs. First, it reconstructs edit supervision on the fly during supervised fine-tuning using longest-common-subsequence alignment, enabling insertion and deletion learning without manually annotated labels. Second, it adopts multi-stage training, where the state from one stage becomes the input to the next, exposing the model to its earlier errors and enabling it to correct them. When applied to the 16B-parameter LLaDA2.1-Mini Base, LED raises the average score across twelve benchmarks from 54.86 to 57.10 under confidence-guided decoding while increasing tokens per forward from 6.14 to 7.05, whereas under confidence-free decoding it raises the average score from 27.52 to 47.19. We further show that LED achieves higher pass@k at large k than thresholded decoding without editing, demonstrating improved generation diversity and revealing the diversity potential of DLMs without confidence guidance. LED also improves robustness to large block sizes, raising the average score from 36.97 to 51.34 at block size 128. Together, these results suggest that LED supports more robust self-correction in DLMs.

[NLP-44] Learning through Discernment: when a small language model learns from user feedback on the job and when it decays KR

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决小型语言模型（Small Language Models, SLMs）在设备端通过自我学习实现持续改进过程中，如何有效筛选值得学习的反馈信号这一关键问题。由于缺乏真实客观的结果（true outcome），模型自身判断与用户反馈均可能存在偏差，导致学习过程产生误导性优化。其解决方案的关键在于构建一种“反馈感知”（feedback sense）机制，该机制不依赖于模型自身的评价或用户的显式表态，而是通过分析用户行为反应来推断真实反馈。研究设计了三种不同策略的反馈感知模块：其中基于辨别力（discernment）的版本，在每轮评估前先判断用户是否给出明确评价，从而有效过滤模糊或错误反馈；实验结果表明，该版本在初期能维持接近“理想基准”（oracle）的表现，但随时间推移因高质量失败样本稀缺而性能衰退。此外，当用户无法看到任务结果时，尽管反馈感知仍能正确解析用户反应，但高达80%的学习样本实际为用户致谢的失败尝试，表明反馈信号存在严重扭曲。跨97次实验验证显示，失败尝试在学习样本中的占比与真实结果高度负相关（Spearman ρ = -0.81）。研究结论指出，只有在严格排除失败案例且用户可见真实结果的前提下，基于用户反馈的学习才具有效性，否则将导致模型学习偏差加剧并缩小泛化能力。

Abstract:Small language models on devices could keep improving by learning, overnight, from their own daily work. Without a true outcome, however, something must decide which attempts are worth learning from, and both the model’s own judgment and the user’s reaction can be wrong. We study a small model (Qwen3 0.6B and 1.7B) with a LoRA adapter, fine-tuned each night on the attempts a judge accepts, over 127 lives of up to a year on WebShop and \tau^2 -bench. We compare the true outcome, the user’s stated verdict and the model’s own judgment with a separate, frozen “feedback sense” that reads the user’s reaction, built in three versions. Judging itself, the model improved and then decayed, over a year and whatever its adapter. A sense that took polite give-ups for success collapsed 3 of 5 lives; one built for discernment, which first asks whether the user gave a clear verdict, kept 4 of 5 near the oracle for two weeks, then faded on clean but scarce lessons, to the level of self-judging by day 60. When the user cannot see the outcome ( \tau^2 -bench), the sense read reactions correctly, yet 80% of its lessons were failures the customer had thanked. Across 97 lives, the share of failed attempts among the lessons predicted the outcome (Spearman \rho = -0.81). In our experiments, learning from users held up only where the judge kept failures out and the user could see the outcome; lopsided lessons may also narrow the model.

[NLP-45] Localizing Text Anonymization for Trustworthy AI: Extending RAT-Bench to Malaysian Microdata and PII ICML2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在公共部门、工作场所及本地AI应用中，基于大语言模型（LLM）的文本处理流程中敏感个人信息（PII）泄露的风险问题。随着基础模型在公共服务与生产力工具中的广泛应用，用户输入的公民、员工及行政文本可能通过推理、检索、微调或本地模型开发等环节暴露隐私，而现有文本匿名化工具在跨语言、跨文化场景下的有效性尚未充分验证。其解决方案的关键在于构建并扩展针对马来西亚语境的匿名化评估基准（RAT-Bench），引入本地微观数据、马来西亚特有的个人身份信息（PII）格式以及具有文化背景的马来英语与马来语语料，系统评估基于命名实体识别（NER）与大语言模型（LLM）的匿名化工具在真实部署环境中的表现。研究采用基于大语言模型的攻击者模型，从匿名化后的文本中推断敏感属性，综合衡量再识别成功率与文本语用价值（以BLEU分数评估）。结果表明，两类基于LLM的匿名化方法在马来语和马来英语中均实现了最优的隐私-效用权衡，将易识别/难识别风险降低至23%-29%，同时保持0.77-0.94的高BLEU得分；而非LLM工具则表现出显著的失效模式，或在保留语用价值的同时遗留较高残留风险，或因过度删减导致严重语义损失，尤其在马来语中更为明显。研究强调，匿名化工具必须在目标部署的语言、标识符格式与文化语境下进行验证，方可在公共领域及企业级AI管线中可靠应用。

Abstract:As governments and organizations adopt foundation models for public services and workplace productivity, sensitive citizen, employee, and administrative text may enter LLM workflows through inference, retrieval, fine-tuning, or local model development. We examine whether text anonymizers transfer to new deployment settings by extending RAT-Bench to Malaysia using local microdata, Malaysian PII formats, and culturally grounded transcripts in Malaysian English and Bahasa Malaysia. We evaluate NER- and LLM-based anonymizers using an LLM attacker that infers attributes from anonymized text, measuring both re-identification success and text utility. Across Malaysian English and Bahasa Malaysia, the two LLM anonymizers provide the strongest explicit privacy-utility trade-offs, reducing Easy/Hard re-identification risk to 23-29% while preserving BLEU scores of 0.77-0.94. Non-LLM tools show sharper failure modes, either preserving utility while leaving high residual risk or reducing risk through severe over-redaction, especially in Bahasa Malaysia. These findings suggest that anonymizers should be evaluated against deployment-relevant languages, identifier formats, and cultural contexts before being relied on in public-sector, workplace, or local AI pipelines.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统在策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）方法在长时序任务中对教师模型输出概率分布（logits）的依赖问题，而这一依赖在仅提供文本输出的黑箱语言模型中无法实现。为克服此限制，论文提出了一种基于自然语言交互的通信式在策略蒸馏（Communicative On-Policy Distillation, COPD）框架。其核心解决方案在于：允许学生模型在执行任务时自主决定何时向黑箱教师发起开放式自然语言咨询，并通过生成性对话获取指导信息；成功的学生-教师交互记录被保留为特权参考信号，用于监督后续无外部指导的学生轨迹，结合任务奖励进行在线自蒸馏与强化学习联合优化。该方法不仅显著提升了模型性能（在CAMG-II上相较最强黑箱OPD基线提升2.46倍），且所习得的沟通能力具备良好的泛化性，可有效迁移至Terminal-Bench 2.1和SWE-Bench Pro V2等新任务，无需访问教师模型即可提升任务成功率。

Abstract:On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for improving language-model agents on long-horizon tasks, yet its conventional formulation relies on teacher logits that text-only black- box models do not expose. To address this limitation, we introduce Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD), which uses natural-language communication as a medium for distilling a stronger model’s capabilities into a smaller student. During task execution, the student au- tonomously decides when to consult a black-box teacher and formulates open-ended natural- language requests without predefined question templates or intervention schedules. Successful student-teacher interactions are retained as privileged references to supervise fresh adviser-free student rollouts through on-policy self-distillation, jointly with task-reward reinforcement learning. On CAMG-II, COPD achieves 2.46 times the gain of the strongest black-box OPD baseline. The capabilities it learns through communication generalize to Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, improving task success without adviser access.

[NLP-47] Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 个人健康助手（Kicker）在持续自我改进过程中因指令更新引入的安全风险与任务性能退化问题。核心挑战在于：尽管递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）可提升任务处理能力，但其潜在的指令变更可能引发授权滥用、记忆泄露及工具输出注入等安全漏洞，且难以在不破坏系统稳定性的情况下进行验证。为此，论文提出 Safe Personal RSI，一种针对个人化可重用指令（Reusable System Instructions, RSI）的更新评估机制，其关键在于将递归自我改进严格限制在提示词（prompt）层面，固定模型权重与运行时代码，通过多轮测试、失败案例回溯、临时撤销修改、安全与任务性能双重验证等策略，在正式采纳前确保更新版本无害且有效。实验表明，该机制在29个真实场景（涵盖邮件、日历、健康与电商）中成功拒绝了21次更新中的20次，显著提升了安全性与任务完成率；修复确认阶段进一步验证了其有效性，如在GPT-5.6 Luna和Qwen系列模型间的迁移修复分别实现攻击违规率从10.7%降至0%、69.0%降至17.9%，同时安全任务完成率大幅提高，且运行时探针可精准识别内存删除与OAuth权限缺失等关键缺陷。

Abstract:Kicker is a personal health assistant. Changes to an assistant’s reusable instructions can improve task handling while changing what it discloses, which requests it follows, and how it reports actions. We study Safe Personal RSI, an update-evaluation component developed for Kicker. We restrict recursive self-improvement (RSI) to prompt updates, with model weights and runtime code fixed. The procedure tests proposed and current instructions, repeats failing cases, temporarily undoes changes to guide repairs, and checks safety and task performance before adoption. If no version passes, the current instructions stay in use. Our executable benchmark contains 29 email, calendar, health, and marketplace cases, with separate probes for authorization reuse, memory, and tool-output injection. Across three models and two deliberately risky edits, the procedure rejects 20 of 21 update attempts. In repair confirmation, an admitted GPT-5.6 Luna repair reduces attack violations from 10.7% to 0% and increases safe task completion from 89.7% to 100%; a broad handwritten authority rule matches these outcomes. Under stronger attacks, a repair transferred from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to Qwen3-14B reduces violations from 69.0% to 17.9% and increases safe task completion from 19.5% to 64.4%. Separate runtime probes examine memory-entry deletion and identify missing local OAuth scope checks in the evaluated snapshot.

[NLP-48] Option-GRPO: Hierarchical RL Against AI Slop in Code Generation for Unseen SDKs EACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在生成代码时普遍存在的“AI垃圾代码”（AI slop）问题，即生成的代码冗长、重复、不符合编程惯例，虽通过功能测试但显著增加代码库体积。尤其在模型训练截止时间之后发布的软件开发工具包（SDK）上，由于缺乏对目标SDK的惯用模式先验知识和组合理解能力，该问题更加严重。为应对这一挑战，论文提出了一种名为Option-GRPO的分层强化学习框架，其核心创新在于利用目标SDK源代码中隐含的组合结构，自动识别出可复用的代码模式（code options），这些模式既构成课程学习（curriculum）的层级结构，又作为策略优化的动作空间。关键洞察在于：代码选项所形成的层次化结构可建模为有效的半马尔可夫决策过程（semi-Markov decision process），且在特定条件下，较短的选项描述长度可保证生成代码更简洁，并在期望意义上更具API效率。此外，理论分析表明，该选项层次结构可使信用分配（credit assignment）性能提升√T/K倍。通过在每个课程层级采用基于执行结果的奖励机制，结合组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO），Option-GRPO能够自主发现SDK惯用模式、组合成高级代码模式并最终构建完整程序。在12个未见过的SDK上的实验表明，该方法在pass@1指标上达到61.4%，优于平坦式GRPO（+8.7点）、ExploraCoder（+11.2点）和ReCode（+6.3点），同时生成代码减少34.7%的API调用次数，长度缩短27%，且保持更高正确性，有效缓解了代码冗余问题。

Abstract:Large language models increasingly produce AI slop in generated code: verbose, redundant, non-idiomatic implementations that pass functional checks but bloat codebases. The problem compounds on SDKs released after the model’s training cutoff, where the model has neither idiomatic priors nor compositional understanding. We present Option-GRPO, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that adapts a code LLM to an unseen SDK from its source code alone, without human-written usage examples or test cases, and that explicitly optimizes for both functional correctness and code elegance. Our key insight is that SDK source code contains compositional structure that defines a hierarchy of reusable code patterns (code options) which simultaneously serve as the building blocks of a curriculum and the action space for efficient policy optimization. We show that code options induce a valid semi-Markov decision process, give conditional bounds under which shorter option description length implies more concise and, in expectation, more API-efficient programs, and analyze under stated assumptions how the option hierarchy improves credit assignment by a factor of \sqrtT/K . Using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with execution-based rewards at each curriculum level, Option-GRPO discovers SDK idioms, composes them into patterns, and assembles patterns into complete programs. Experiments on 12 unseen SDKs with a 32B-parameter base model demonstrate 61.4% pass@1, outperforming flat GRPO by 8.7 points, ExploraCoder by 11.2 points, and ReCode by 6.3 points. Option-GRPO produces solutions that use 34.7% fewer API calls and are 27% shorter than flat-GRPO outputs while maintaining higher correctness, directly attacking the slop problem.

[NLP-49] FutureBench: A Renewable Framework for Evaluating Knowledge-Context Conflict in LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型在处理时间敏感型知识时，因信息过时或来源冲突而导致的错误答案采纳问题，尤其关注模型在面对“截止时间前”（pre-cutoff）与“截止时间后”（post-cutoff）事件时对证据源的信任偏差。其核心挑战在于：当检索到的文本与模型内部知识存在矛盾时，模型难以正确判断应优先采纳哪一方，从而导致错误答案的生成。解决方案的关键在于提出FutureBench——一个可复用、基于时间戳问题的评估框架，通过受控的段落三元组（controlled passage triplets）和无上下文探测（no-context probes），系统性地量化模型在不同情境下的知识采纳行为。研究发现，采用“验证机制”（Verify，即结合检查与段落优先级提示）虽能提升对后截止事件的正确采纳率（如o4-mini模型提升13.7个百分点），但会显著降低前截止事件中原本正确的答案采纳率，暴露出模型对证据优先级的脆弱性。进一步实验表明，引入对抗感知提示（Adversarial-Aware）——即警示误导性段落并优先依赖模型自身知识——可在几乎不损失真实段落准确性的前提下，恢复82.5%–98.9%被错误排除的前截止事件正确答案，有效缓解知识-上下文冲突。该框架支持对固定数据集的重复评估，并可随模型演进扩展至新事件，为持续评估与优化模型可信度提供了可扩展的技术路径。

Abstract:Asking a model to check retrieved text can also tell it which source to trust. We introduce FutureBench, a renewable framework for evaluating knowledge-context conflict using timestamped questions, controlled passage triplets, and no-context probes. Across 3,629 questions and six models, Verify (a prompt combining checking with passage priority) raises false-answer adoption in all five models tested on pre-cutoff events, mainly by displacing answers that were correct under Baseline, which allows both passage evidence and model knowledge. On post-cutoff events, only o4-mini increases adoption (+13.7 percentage points). A four-prompt comparison on 902 post-cutoff questions finds that passage priority without checking raises adoption, while moving to Verify lowers it in all five models. Adversarial-Aware, which warns of misleading passages and prioritizes model knowledge, restores 82.5-98.9% of displaced pre-cutoff answers with under one point of change in true-passage accuracy. FutureBench supports repeated evaluation on fixed cohorts and extension to new events as models change.

[NLP-50] Safe to Omit Worth Omitting? Keeping the Answer and Cutting Latency When an LLM Agent Skips Anothers Message ICLR2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多智能体系统中接收端智能体因等待辅助端智能体的消息（文本或其潜在的键值缓存，KV cache）而引入延迟的问题，同时在不显著影响最终答案准确率的前提下实现通信跳过以提升效率。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于置信度的有限样本检验机制：接收端在未接收消息前即可读取自身置信度，并通过统计检验认证一个阈值，在高概率下确保跳过消息后答案改变的比例不超过5%；若无任何路径满足该阈值，则系统维持正常通信。关键创新在于，该机制不依赖于消息的准确性，而是基于消息对答案的扰动频率与可预测性来判断是否可安全跳过，且实验证明即使跳过后的路径精度低于接收端单独推理，仍能保留绝大部分性能增益。在多个数据集（OpenBookQA、ARC-Challenge、MMLU-Pro、SQuAD、GSM8K）和不同模型组合上的测试表明，该方法可在保持答案稳定性的同时，有效减少通信开销，尤其在文本消息场景下节省数百毫秒延迟，而在KV缓存场景中收益较小，且认证有效性在部分任务（如SQuAD）中成立但在另一些任务（如GSM8K）中不适用。

Abstract:In multi-agent systems, a receiver agent often waits for a helper agent’s message (text or its latent KV cache), which can improve performance but adds latency. We study when a receiver agent can skip the message safely (the final answer rarely changes) and beneficially (the time saved exceeds the cost of deciding). Our mechanism reads the receiver agent’s confidence without the message and uses a finite-sample test to certify a threshold at which, with high probability, at most 5% of skipped answers change; if none passes, the system keeps communicating. We test it on OpenBookQA, ARC-Challenge, and MMLU-Pro with three Qwen model pairs, on cross-family agents, and on SQuAD and GSM8K. Four insights emerge. First, oracle headroom is weak evidence that messages help: control inputs without answer-specific content, matched to change answers as often as real messages, reproduce a median 76% of the oracle’s gain. Second, whether a message can be skipped depends on how often and how predictably it alters the answer, not on its accuracy; every certified KV-cache path is less accurate than the receiver agent alone. Third, where text messages help, skipping keeps most of their gain: on unseen questions in the four such settings, the policies skip 59 to 80% and keep an estimated 76 to 95% of the gain. In two prospective tests with all rules fixed in advance, our mechanism skips a three-agent system’s verifier on 39.9% of sealed questions, keeping 12.55 of its 12.80-point gain, and a 32B helper on 68.4% of held-out questions, keeping its whole gain. Fourth, safety does not determine efficiency: at batch size one, skipping text saves hundreds of milliseconds per query and skipping KV cache far less. Certification extends to SQuAD but not to GSM8K. In eleven tests on unseen questions, every certified policy we could test kept its change rate’s 95% upper bound below 5% under our answer parsers.

[NLP-51] Language Models Make New Research Sound Old

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在科研验证中存在“报告偏差”（reporting gap）的问题，即大语言模型（LLM）倾向于将尚未充分研究的开放性研究问题误判为已有充分研究，从而高估已有文献的覆盖程度。其核心解决方案是通过引入双重验证机制：首先由模型独立判断研究问题的状态，再分别核查引用文献的全文内容以确认其实际支持程度，最终整合这两部分判断生成修正后的答案。该方法显著提升了模型对开放性问题的准确识别能力，使GPT-6-Astra在普通回答中明确指出问题未被研究的比例从8%提升至95%，并有效缓解了不同能力水平模型间报告偏差随能力增强而加剧的现象。此外，该框架不依赖模型权重或内部激活信息，具备对闭源前沿模型的兼容性，且通过融合多模型评分与规则学习实现了对审稿人新颖性评级的精准预测。

作者: Guy Zyskind
机构: University of Miami(迈阿密大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
