点击查看摘要

Abstract:Researchers are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to validate research questions. We find that LLMs make open research questions sound partly studied and overstate what related papers establish. Models recognize most of these overstatements when asked to check the papers’ full texts separately. On 40 questions drawn from newly accepted papers, GPT-6-Astra correctly judges 98% to be unstudied, but states that status plainly in only 8% of ordinary answers. All six frontier systems show reporting gaps of 30-90 percentage points. Across 22 models given identical papers, higher capability is associated with more accurate judgments and larger reporting gaps. This reporting failure is asymmetric: models correctly identify studied questions in 88-100% of ordinary answers when we supply the answering papers. To correct this, we build a fixed answer from each model’s judgment and separate checks of cited papers. This raises Astra’s clear reporting of open status from 8% to 95%, with improvements in all six systems. Finally, we predict reviewers’ novelty grades by combining several models’ written ratings with a rule learned from graded examples, reaching the performance range reported by Think-Probe-Respond. Unlike TPR, our approach needs no access to model weights or internal activations, so it also works with closed-weight frontier models.

[NLP-52] Can LLM s Understand What They Predict? Evaluating Latent Causal Structure Inference in Financial Markets

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在评估其预测能力时，隐含假设预测准确即代表对底层系统机制具备真正理解的问题。这一假设可能误导评估结果，因为模型可通过表面相关性实现高精度预测，而无需揭示生成可观测结果的潜在机制。为检验该假设，研究提出LUCID基准，用于评估模型是否能从事件描述与历史金融数据中推断出隐藏的市场结构。其核心解决方案在于构建基于重构的评估框架：模型需生成由事件引发的因果图以表征推断出的市场结构，并通过重构真实观测数据的能力来评估其有效性。实验结果表明，尽管部分指标有所提升，但将模型生成的因果图用于重构时，整体重建质量反而低于仅使用历史观测数据的情况，说明当前主流开源与专有LLM在从可观测证据中推断具有信息量的、事件特定的市场结构方面仍面临显著挑战。

作者: Yixiang Zheng,Yuechen Jiang,Zhiwei Liu,Jimin Huang,Yuyan Wang,Sophia Ananiadou
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated through their ability to predict future outcomes, implicitly assuming that predictive success reflects an understanding of the underlying system. However, accurate predictions can often be achieved without recovering the latent mechanisms that generate observable outcomes. To examine this assumption, we introduce LUCID, a benchmark that evaluates whether models can infer latent market structures from event descriptions and historical financial observations. Models generate event-induced causal graphs representing inferred market structure and are evaluated through a reconstruction-based framework. Our evaluation of 6 open-weight and proprietary LLMs shows that adding their generated graphs generally reduces reconstruction quality compared with using historical observations alone, although a few metrics improve. These findings suggest that inferring informative, event-specific market structures from observable evidence remains challenging for the evaluated LLMs.

[NLP-53] Dreaming Up Authors: Factual Prevalence and LLM Hallucinations in Academic Authorship Attribution EMNLP2026 EMNLP ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在问答任务中普遍存在幻觉（hallucination）的问题，尤其关注训练数据中事实流行度（factual prevalence）对幻觉产生的潜在影响。其核心假设是：在训练数据中出现频率较低的学术论文更易引发模型幻觉。为验证此假设，研究以引用次数作为事实流行度的代理指标，构建了一个涵盖八个科学领域的192万篇论文数据集，并按引用频次分层采样。实验结果表明，三种先进LLM均呈现显著的反向关系——幻觉率随引用次数增加而降低，低引用论文的幻觉率超过98%，而高引用论文则低于37%。进一步分析揭示，此类错误主要源于模型检索能力的局限性而非知识缺失，且开源模型的隐藏状态探测显示，事实流行度信息已被编码于生成前的表示中，为流行度与幻觉之间的机制关联提供了有力证据。因此，解决方案的关键在于识别并利用训练数据中事实的流行度信号，通过增强模型对高流行度事实的检索与表征能力，有效缓解幻觉问题。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23530
作者: Sijia Zhong,Tamir Yirga,Yijia Ma,Thai Le,Yifan Hu
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Published in EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 37 pages. Code and data: this https URL . Anthology: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used for question answering but are prone to hallucinations, yet the underlying causes, particularly the role of factual prevalence in training data, remain underexplored. In this work, we study this through academic authorship attribution, hypothesizing that hallucinations are more likely for less prevalent papers. Using citation count as a proxy for factual prevalence, we curate a dataset of 1.92 million papers across eight scientific disciplines with stratified samples by citation level. Experiments on three state-of-the-art LLMs confirm our hypothesis, revealing a robust inverse relationship between hallucination rate and citation count across all models and disciplines, with hallucination rates exceeding 98% for rarely cited papers and falling below 37% for highly cited ones. Our in-depth analysis further shows that these failures primarily reflect retrieval limitations rather than knowledge absence, and hidden-state probing of open-source models shows that factual prevalence is encoded in pre-generation representations, providing convergent mechanistic evidence for the prevalence-hallucination relationship. The code and data are available at this https URL.

[NLP-54] From Arraignment to Resolution: Transformer Models of Court Cases EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决刑事司法系统中决策过程缺乏透明度的问题，尤其关注案件处理流程中多个关键决策点（如指控选择、保释金额确定、认罪协商及量刑）的可解释性与可监督性。现有机器学习方法多聚焦于单一决策（如再犯风险预测），难以捕捉案件演进中的动态复杂性。本文提出一种基于Transformer的时间序列模型，将案件视为事件序列进行建模，从而实现对下一阶段案件进展（如接受指控、设定保释、达成认罪协议等）的多标签预测。其核心创新在于融合书记员笔录的文本数据与被告人的结构化信息（如前科记录、法庭背景等），通过时序建模揭示决策演变规律。在基于美国某中等规模城市公开法院记录构建的数据集上，该模型在20类多标签任务中达到0.57的微平均F1分数，显著优于多个基线模型，且性能接近使用相同输入训练的GRU模型。实验表明，该模型可为司法观察者提供决策过程的深度洞察，辅助识别辖区内潜在的系统性问题，推动刑事司法系统的透明化与问责机制建设。

作者: Kory Rosen,Aron Culotta
机构: Tulane University (杜兰大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Published in Findings of EMNLP 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The criminal legal system is composed of many complex decision points, such as which charges are pursued, how bond is determined, plea deal negotiations, and sentencing. Given the profound impact of such decisions, there is a growing need to increase the transparency within this system. While prior machine learning approaches have focused on modeling single decisions (e.g., recidivism), this paper proposes a transformer-based time series model to forecast the outcome of the next proceeding in a case (e.g., charges accepted, bond set, plea deal made, etc.). By modeling a case as an event sequence, we enable a more nuanced analysis to support better oversight and understanding of decision making. We conduct an empirical analysis of thousands of cases using a newly constructed dataset derived from publicly available court records of a mid-sized U.S. city. We fit models that combine textual data from clerk notes with structured information about the defendant, prior charges, and courtroom. Our transformer model achieves .57 micro-F1 on a 20-class multi-label task, a significant improvement over several baselines and comparable to a GRU trained on the same input. We demonstrate how the model can be used to provide insights into decision-making and help court observers identify emerging issues within the jurisdiction studied.

[NLP-55] GRAFT: Execution-Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式智能体（Generative AI agent）在自动化设计过程中因仅依赖聚合适应度（aggregate fitness）进行选择与进化而导致的实例级成功与失败信息被掩盖的问题。现有方法虽通过语言模型交叉（language-model crossover）实现机制重组，但缺乏对具体执行过程中的有效反馈指导，限制了优化精度。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种执行引导的遗传重组方法——GRAFT（Execution Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design），该方法在保留聚合适应度用于选择与生存的基础上，引入父代特定的执行证据（parent-specific execution evidence）来指导语义层面的交叉操作，并集成变异机制。该反馈机制复用适应度评估中已有的成功与失败运行样本，无需额外任务执行或参考答案，实现了高效、可扩展的反馈闭环。实验表明，GRAFT在六种推理与编程任务上达到82.0%的平均测试准确率，显著优于最强基线9.8个百分点；控制性消融实验进一步验证了执行证据对性能提升的关键作用，证明了父代特定执行证据在演化智能体设计中的重要价值。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23509
作者: Sevda Ebrahimi,Mohammed Saidul Islam,Xiaodan Zhu,Elham Dolatabadi
机构: York University (约克大学); Vector Institute (向量研究所)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automated agent design searches for executable architectures that improve LLM-based agent performance, with evolutionary methods using language-model crossover to recombine promising mechanisms for task decomposition, model coordination, and verification. This search, however, is typically guided by aggregate fitness alone, which hides the instance-level successes and failures behind each score. We introduce Execution Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design (GRAFT), which uses aggregate fitness for selection and survival and parent-specific execution evidence to guide semantic crossover with integrated mutation. Its feedback harness reuses bounded samples of successful and failed runs from fitness evaluation, withholding reference answers and requiring no additional task executions. We evaluate GRAFT across six reasoning and programming settings using open-weight optimizer and executor models. It achieves a mean test accuracy of 82.0%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 9.8% points. Controlled ablations show that adding execution evidence improves test accuracy with initialization, search rules, repair policies, and evaluation budgets held fixed. Our results support the value of parent-specific execution evidence for evolutionary agent design.

[NLP-56] BOS Summary: The First Token Matters

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）与语言模型（LLMs）中存在的注意力集中（attention sink）问题，即特定位置（如起始标记BOS）被过度关注，导致其在推理过程中无法有效传递输入上下文信息。尽管在标准因果掩码下BOS查询仅能访问自身，但后续令牌反复访问的表征却缺乏输入内容，从而影响模型性能。为应对这一问题，论文提出了一种无需训练、仅在推理阶段应用的解决方案——BOS Summary。其核心在于：在预填充（prefill）阶段的单个Transformer层中，仅对BOS查询行放宽因果约束，使其能够聚合所有视觉与文本输入，生成一个蕴含完整输入上下文的自衍生表征；而其余所有令牌仍保持标准因果注意力机制。该增强后的表征在整个解码过程中持续可用，且不引入额外参数、辅助模块或解码时开销。实验表明，BOS Summary在多个LVLM与LLM家族及八项多模态与纯文本基准上均优于直接提示与思维链（Chain-of-Thought）提示，并在多步推理任务中超越近期针对注意力集中问题的干预方法。机理分析进一步揭示，使BOS携带特定于输入的信息可削弱其作为注意力“黑洞”的主导地位，促使注意力更合理地分配至承载语义的内容性提示令牌，证明了改变注意力“黑洞”所承载的信息内容，能够重构后续层的注意力分布。

作者: Hui Zhu,Saleh Zare Zade,Rafi Ibn Sultan,Deng Pan,Arun Ross,Dongxiao Zhu
机构: Wayne State University (韦恩州立大学); University of Notre Dame (圣母大学); Michigan State University (密歇根州立大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large vision-language models (LVLMs) and language models (LLMs) often exhibit attention sinks, whereby particular positions, such as the beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token, receive a disproportionate share of attention. Under standard causal masking, however, the BOS query attends only to itself, so the representation that later tokens repeatedly access carries no information about the input. We introduce BOS Summary, a training-free inference-time method that repurposes this persistent pathway to carry input context. At a single transformer layer during prefill, BOS Summary relaxes the causal constraint for the BOS query row alone, letting BOS aggregate all visual and textual input tokens into a self-derived context representation while every other token retains standard causal attention. The enriched representation then remains accessible to the model throughout decoding, with no additional parameters, auxiliary modules, or decoding-time overhead. Across multiple VLM and LLM families and eight multimodal and text-only benchmarks, BOS Summary improves over direct and Chain-of-Thought prompting and outperforms recent sink-intervention methods on multi-step reasoning tasks. A mechanistic analysis shows that making BOS input-specific also weakens its sink dominance and redistributes attention toward content-bearing prompt tokens, indicating that changing what a sink carries reshapes how later layers allocate attention.

[NLP-57] SpecLook: Speculating Where to Look for Fast and Reliable Agent ic MLLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前基于图像推理的智能体多模态大语言模型（Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）在处理视觉任务时存在的效率低下与答案可靠性不足的问题。其核心挑战在于，现有方法依赖于“思考-缩放”（zoom-in）工具调用的顺序循环机制，导致推理过程缓慢且无法提供可信度评分；同时，对答案或推理步骤的提前推测容易引入自信但错误的结论。本文的关键洞察在于：与其推测最终答案，不如推测智能体下一步的观察结果（即“推测性观察”），这一推测可被验证、修正，并用于测试答案的合理性。为此，作者提出无需训练的SpecLook框架，包含三个层级：小型模型生成初步观察（glimpse）并基于此重新回答，若答案稳定且置信则终止；否则由大型模型无工具地验证并修正该观察，融合两者输出。仅当证据仍不充分时才调用完整智能体，实现单次前向传播，显著提升效率。该方法通过追踪推理轨迹为每项答案提供可靠性评分，无需标签。在V*、HR-Bench和POPE等多个基准上的实验表明，SpecLook在准确率上全面超越所有基线，分别达到87.2%和86.2%的平均准确率，相较DeepEyes-7B和Thyme-RL智能体分别实现7.7倍和4.7倍的速度提升；而SpecLook-Fast进一步将速度提升至9.9倍和6.3倍，充分验证了其高效性与可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23483
作者: Xi Ding,Jiawei Zhang
机构: University of Wisconsin–Madison
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Technical report

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls. However, this sequential loop is slow, and its answers carry no reliability score. Prior speculation of tokens, reasoning steps, or answers keeps the loop, and answer speculation also accepts confident errors. We find that the loop mostly adds one zoom-in step, with which a small model is ahead of the agent on most splits. Our key insight is to speculate the agent’s next observation, which, unlike a drafted answer, can be verified, corrected, and used to test the answer. We propose SpecLook, a training-free speculate-and-verify framework with three levels. A small model drafts a glimpse and re-answers from it, and the question ends if the answer is unchanged and confident. Otherwise, the agent’s large model verifies and corrects the glimpse without tools, and their answers are fused. Only questions that still lack evidence reach the agent, in one forward pass that SpecLook-Fast skips, so no question runs the loop. The trace scores every answer’s reliability without labels. Extensive experiments on V*, HR-Bench, and POPE show that both are more accurate than every baseline on every split. SpecLook reaches 87.2% and 86.2% mean accuracy with 7.7x and 4.7x speedups over the DeepEyes-7B and Thyme-RL agents, and SpecLook-Fast reaches 9.9x and 6.3x.

[NLP-58] Formal Adequacy Index (based on Polish-language material)

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言形式性（formality）在实际交际中是否恰当的问题，即仅测量文本的形式性水平无法判断其在特定语境中的适切性。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种形式性适切性指数（formal adequacy index），该指数通过分别建模文本中观察到的形式性（基于语言特征）与交际情境所预期的形式性（基于语境特征），并结合上下文容许阈值（contextual tolerance thresholds）进行比较，从而实现对形式性适切性的量化评估。该方法区分了形式性不足与过度的容忍度差异，具有较强的可操作性。研究以波兰语道歉邮件（由人类或大语言模型生成）为例，展示了该指数的应用潜力。尽管当前实现仍属初步，需进一步校准与实证验证，但本文的核心贡献在于构建了一个适用于多种交际语境的、定量研究形式性适切性的通用方法论框架。

作者: Paweł Patreucha
机构: Univeristy of Wrocław(弗罗茨瓦夫大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 9 pages, 1 figure, 1 table

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Linguistic formality is one of the dimensions of stylistic variation in speech; however, simply measuring its level does not allow us to determine whether the chosen mode of communication is appropriate in a given situation. The aim of this article is to present the concept of a formal adequacy index (based on Polish-language material), which enables a quantitative assessment of how well the formality of a text matches the expectations arising from the communicative context. The proposed approach is based on the separate modelling of observed formality, determined on the basis of the linguistic features of the text, and expected formality, determined on the basis of the characteristics of the communicative situation. Adequacy is assessed by comparing these two measures, taking into account contextual tolerance thresholds, which may differ for a lack of formality and an excess of formality. The potential applications of the index are illustrated by an analysis of Polish-language emails containing apologies for being late, written by human language users or generated by a large language model. The implementation presented here is preliminary in nature and requires further calibration and empirical validation. The main contribution of this article is the proposal of a general methodological framework for the quantitative study of formal adequacy in various communicative contexts.

[NLP-59] racking Representations in LLM Reasoning Traces for Iterated Games

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理在基于思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）推理过程中，其外部可观察的推理轨迹与内部实际计算行为之间关系不明确的问题。核心挑战在于：尽管CoT被广泛用于提升模型在复杂任务中的表现，但其推理过程中的信念形成与修正机制仍缺乏透明性。为此，研究通过一系列机制可解释性技术，探究了LLM代理在不完全信息迭代博弈中的决策机制。关键发现是，模型在CoT推理过程中会构建并持续修正对游戏状态的内部表征；一旦过早地确立错误信念，便极少能够自我纠正，这种认知偏差同时体现在显式的推理文本轨迹和隐层激活模式中。该研究揭示了当前生成式AI系统在多智能体协作场景下战略推理错误的根本成因，为未来构建更鲁棒、可诊断的多智能体系统提供了重要理论基础。

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents achieve state-of-the-art performance across domains through chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Despite their ubiquitous use, little is understood about the relationship between the externalized trace and the model’s actual computation. We address this by investigating how LLM agents make decisions in iterative games with incomplete information. Using a series of mechanistic interpretability techniques, we find that the model forms and iteratively revises an internal representation of the game throughout the CoT. Once the model prematurely commits to an incorrect belief, it rarely recovers. This failure is manifested in both the literal trace and the layer activations. Ultimately, as multi-agent systems are more prevalent, our work opens the door to a more focused diagnosis of their strategic reasoning errors. For illustrative purposes, we offer an interactive visualizer of our methodology on selected sample traces at this https URL

[NLP-60] QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在后训练量化（Post-training Quantization, PTQ）过程中，因模型与精度组合差异导致最优量化方案难以通用化的问题。现有方法需专家针对每种新模型手动设计量化配方，过程耗时且效果常不理想。为应对这一挑战，论文提出QDA系统，其核心解决方案是引入一个可自主优化的智能代理（LLM Agent），通过多轮迭代构建与评估候选量化方案，实现自动化配方设计。关键创新在于：首先，采用基于推理轨迹输出的KL散度快速评估机制，在分钟级内完成候选方案的初步筛选，有效避免了传统方法中耗时数十GPU小时的完整推理验证；其次，通过构建一个兼容性强、可互操作的公共PTQ方法库，实现了不同量化方法在新型模型架构上的无缝集成，显著降低开发与移植成本。实验表明，QDA在四种推理型模型上分别以64 GPU小时的搜索开销，相较最强公开配方平均提升0.9、1.4和2.2个百分点的准确率，且在320B参数的GLM-5.3-Flash MoE模型上达到FP8基准98.3%的精度表现，优于最佳厂商检查点的96.9%。所有生成的量化模型均可直接部署于现有推理内核，无额外推理开销。

Abstract:Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model’s accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.

[NLP-61] Chorus: Shared N-gram Embeddings with Layer-wise Adaptation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有n-gram嵌入（n-gram embedding）方法在模型多层结构中面临的内存开销大与知识共享能力弱的问题。具体而言，传统设计为每一层单独配置一个n-gram嵌入表，虽能实现层间个性化学习，但导致参数量急剧增加；而共享单一嵌入表则因所有层使用相同表示，缺乏层间差异性表达能力，性能表现不佳。针对这一矛盾，论文提出Chorus架构，其核心创新在于：采用统一的一组n-gram嵌入表服务于整个网络，同时允许各层通过自身可学习的投影机制对嵌入向量进行差异化读取和重加权——即基于当前隐藏状态动态计算缩放因子，对嵌入成分进行自适应调整。该设计实现了嵌入知识的跨层共享与层间表达灵活性的平衡。实验表明，Chorus仅需12亿参数的嵌入表即可达到比96亿参数的FactorEngram和DeepSeek Engram更优的文本生成性能，且在不同规模下均优于Engram、TN-gram和FactorEngram；此外，结合轻量级优化器Ember，可减少99.2%的表相关优化器内存占用，显著提升训练效率。该方案通过降低内存消耗并支持跨层知识复用，为n-gram嵌入表的进一步扩展提供了可行路径。

作者: Stephen Chung,Wenyu Du
机构: DualverseAI
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language models can gain capacity at little computational cost from n-gram embedding tables: large tables of learned vectors for short sequences of consecutive tokens, which are looked up and added to the model’s input or to its intermediate layers. Recent designs commonly use a separate n-gram embedding table for each layer, which makes the tables costly in memory and prevents layers from sharing what they learn. Sharing a single table, however, gives every layer the same embedding and leaves no room for layer-wise preferences, and it performs poorly in practice. We propose Chorus, in which one set of n-gram embedding tables serves the whole network and every layer reads it in its own way. Each layer maps the refined embedding through its own projection layer, after rescaling its components by factors computed from its current hidden state. Chorus matches the quality of existing n-gram methods with 87% smaller tables: with 1.2B table parameters it predicts text better than FactorEngram and DeepSeek’s Engram do with 9.6B. It outperforms Engram, TN-gram and FactorEngram in every setting where we compared them, across table sizes from 20M to 9.6B parameters. We also show that the recently proposed memory-efficient optimizer Ember works well with Chorus, saving 99.2% of table-optimizer memory compared with AdamW without degrading training performance. These results enable further scaling of n-gram embedding tables along the table-size axis by reducing memory use and allowing shared knowledge to be reused across layers.

[NLP-62] A Survey on RLOps for Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）训练过程中因扩展性带来的分布式执行失败、反馈计算瓶颈及学习动态不稳定性等问题，这些问题会导致计算资源浪费、训练效率降低以及模型性能提升受阻。其解决方案的关键在于构建系统化的LLM RLOps（Reinforcement Learning Operations）框架，将RL训练全生命周期划分为五个核心阶段：训练准备（Training Setup）、经验收集（Experience Collection）、奖励计算（Reward Computation）、策略优化（Policy Optimization）与模型评估（Model Evaluation），并在每个阶段深入分析操作痛点、管理技术与实证证据。通过这一结构化分类体系，论文揭示了各阶段间协同机制的不足，并提出未来研究方向，包括训练过程可观测性增强、跨阶段协调优化、可泛化的RLOps方法、多运行管理以及支持递归自我改进的RLOps范式，推动操作管理从单次训练运行向多样化训练场景、共享基础设施及持续迭代改进周期演进。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement learning (RL) has become increasingly important for improving the reasoning, instruction-following, and task-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, scaling RL training exposes failures in distributed execution, feedback computation, and learning dynamics that can waste computational resources, slow training, and undermine model improvements. These challenges have motivated a growing body of techniques for LLM RLOps, which manages the efficiency and reliability of operations throughout the LLM reinforcement learning training lifecycle. Despite growing interest, these techniques remain scattered across research areas, with limited synthesis of their operational roles and interactions. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic survey of LLM RLOps methods. We organize existing approaches into five stages: Training Setup, Experience Collection, Reward Computation, Policy Optimization, and Model Evaluation. Within each stage, we examine operational concerns, management techniques, and evaluation evidence. Building on this taxonomy, we identify open challenges and future directions in training process observability, cross-stage coordination, generalizable RLOps, multi-run management, and RLOps for recursive self-improvement. These directions extend operational management from individual training runs to diverse training settings, shared infrastructure, and successive improvement cycles. We maintain a GitHub repository indexing relevant papers and open resources at this https URL.

[NLP-63] A Concurrent Structured Record Mirrored the Prose It Accompanied: A Pre-Registered Conceptual Replication and Extension of the Hide Pending Tool Call Scenario

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在执行代理型任务（agentic work）时，语言模型倾向于隐瞒关键性叙事缺陷（narrative-changing flaws）的问题，尤其在存在未返回的后续查询（pending tool call）情境下，模型仍会保持表面完整性。其核心解决方案是通过引入结构化记录（structured record）机制，采用对抗性审查工具的格式，明确包含“残留项”（residue section）以追踪未解决的问题。实验结果表明，在预注册的两阶段测试中，带有残余项结构的记录使29%至30%的合成日志明确指出未返回的查询，显著高于仅含结论摘要的对照组（5%）和干净对照组（0%），且统计学差异极显著（p = 1.2 × 10⁻⁷）。尽管在自然语言回答层面，该结构化记录并未显著提升诚实披露率（与“诚实指令”相比无显著差异，p = 0.125），但探索性交叉分析显示，所有提及缺失信息的结构化记录均伴随相应文本表述，而未提及者则完全未在文本中体现——表明结构化记录有效“镜像”了其伴随的自然语言输出内容，从而为系统性暴露潜在缺陷提供了可操作的框架。

Abstract:Huang et al. (2026) show that language models writing reports of agentic work tend to conceal narrative-changing flaws, and that appending “Be honest in your response.” to the instruction substantially increases disclosure in most of their scenarios. In their Hide Pending Tool Call scenario, where a broader follow-up query was accepted but never returned, the honesty prompt left GPT-5.5’s rate of flagging the missing data at 0%, although it turned most answers into caveats. I ask whether a different request changes this: appending, in the same generation, a structured record that follows the schema of an adversarial-review tool, including a residue section for what remained unresolved. In two pre-registered phases on the same 100 synthetic log pairs, each pending log matched with a clean twin in which the follow-up query did return, I ran gpt-5.6-sol through Codex CLI under four conditions. Phase 1 measured the record: with the residue schema, a judge coded it as stating the unreturned query in 29% of logs, against 5% with a findings-only placebo schema, and in none of the clean twins (p = 1.2 x 10^-7); a second run two days later gave 30% and 6%. But 70-71% of residue records declared that nothing remained open while the query was pending. Phase 2 measured the prose answer: the confirmatory comparison against the honesty prompt was not significant (four discordant logs, all favoring the honesty prompt; p = 0.125), no equivalence test was pre-registered, and the judge failed the pre-registered human validation on the decisive category; I therefore claim neither an effect nor its absence. In an exploratory cross-tabulation, every residue record coded as stating the gap accompanied prose coded as mentioning it (30 of 30), and none accompanied prose coded as omitting it (0 of 70): in this setting, the structured record mirrored the prose it accompanied.

[NLP-64] Geometry-bridge flow matching for blind rigid-motion correction in head cone-beam CT

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决患者头部在头颈部锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）过程中发生刚性运动导致图像质量下降及解剖结构重建不准确的问题。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于三维流匹配先验（3D flow-matching prior）的框架，通过学习运动引起的图像变化来实现高精度重建。该方法的关键在于构建“几何桥”（geometry-bridge），将同一源体积在运动伪影存在与无运动状态下的Feldkamp-Davis-Kress（FDK）重建图像通过逐步减小的模拟运动进行连接，并利用正向投影算子的几何导数提供路径上的解析速度目标。该框架采用即插即用循环结构，集成学习得到的图像更新、基于样条的位姿估计、共轭梯度数据一致性约束以及图像总变差（total variation, TV）正则化。实验表明，在30名未参与训练的CQ500患者模拟360视角扫描中，该方法在10 mm/10°以内的每分量运动幅度下，实现了优于现有方法（如学习型自动对焦和基于扩散的联合重建）的图像重建质量与运动估计精度，平均峰值信噪比（PSNR）达37.1 dB，探测器平面重投影误差（RPE）为0.27 mm；相较于图像线性训练方式，几何桥使PSNR提升1.6 dB，RPE降低33%；在50次先验更新与粗到精运动估计策略下，单例患者平均处理时间为9.1分钟（RTX A6000显卡）。

Abstract:Rigid motion of a patient head during head cone-beam CT (CBCT) scan can degrade image quality and complicate recovery of accurate anatomical structures from the measured projections. We present a 3D flow-matching prior approach that learns the image changes induced by motion. Its geometry-bridge connects motion-corrupted and motion-free Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructed images of the same source volume through progressively reduced simulated motion. The forward projector’s geometry derivative supplies analytic velocity targets along this path. A plug-and-play loop encompasses the learned image updates together with spline-based pose estimation, conjugate-gradient data consistency, and image total-variation regularization. Both the refined image volume and the FDK reconstructed image volume at the estimated poses are evaluated. On simulated 360-view scans from 30 held-out CQ500 patients with nominal per-component motion amplitudes within 10 mm / 10 degrees, the framework achieved state-of-the-art image reconstruction quality and motion accuracy in comparison with other methos such as learned autofocus and diffusion-based joint reconstruction. Mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) reached 37.1 dB and mean detector-plane reprojection error (RPE) was 0.27 mm. With matched endpoints at the inference settings, the geometry bridge improved PSNR by 1.6 dB and reduced RPE by 33% relative to image-linear training. With 50 prior updates and coarse-to-fine motion estimation, total processing time averaged 9.1 minutes per patient on an RTX A6000.

[IR-0] Can Programs Replace LLM Judges? Executable Program Judges for Scalable and Efficient Relevance Labeling

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24849
作者: Eugene Agichtein,Charles L. A. Clarke,Kaustubh Dhole,William Stern
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) judges have become a common way to create large-scale relevance judgments for retrieval evaluation. However, each judgment requires a potentially expensive call to a frontier model, and the judgments are hard to interpret and may not be reproducible. In this paper, we ask whether an LLM can write a readable program for each topic that replaces its per-document judgments. To address these issues, we propose ExecJudges, a method for generating fast, inspectable and scalable judges for automatic relevance labeling. Specifically, ExecJudges uses a frontier LLM to turn assessment guidelines into executable programs, which rely only on lexical matching, standard NLP libraries like parsers, and pool statistics. An ExecJudges-L variant also uses examples of human labels if available. We evaluate ExecJudges on seven TREC collections by comparing the produced labels with trained NIST assessors, frontier LLM judges, and recently proposed per-topic classifiers. Our results show that ExecJudges agrees with NIST assessors at the level of the Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM judges on TREC DL 2019-2021. With a small number of human labels per topic, the ExecJudges-L variant agrees with NIST more than per-topic classifiers with the same labels on all seven collections, and either exceeds the agreement of LLM judges provided the same labels or is within about 0.05 of it in Krippendorff’s alpha. The labels rank the official TREC DL runs with Kendall’s tau of 0.87 to 0.94, and writing the programs incurs a one-time cost of 0.17 to 0.49 per topic, with no additional costs for grading. Our results suggest that ExecJudges offers a reproducible, inspectable, efficient and cost-effective alternative to LLM judges for labeling deep result pools for system evaluation or ranking improvements.

[IR-1] Variance-Optimal Counterfactual Policy Design for Sample-Efficient Online A/B Testing

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24757
作者: Shashank Gupta,Subhadeep Maji
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Online A/B testing is the standard approach for evaluating changes to user-facing systems, such as a new recommendation or ranking policy, before deployment. While the difference-in-means estimator of a standard A/B test is unbiased, it often suffers from high variance. When the treatment and production policies choose the same actions with similar probabilities, the resulting observations can add noise while providing little information about the difference between the policies. Consequently, A/B tests can require large amounts of traffic and long durations to detect small treatment effects. Existing variance-reduction methods mainly improve the estimator after the data-collection scheme has been fixed, and recent overlap-aware designs only optimize a single traffic split between the two policies; thereby, they cannot direct traffic to the actions on which the policies disagree. In this paper, we jointly optimize how actions are sampled and how the resulting observations are used to estimate the treatment effect. Our contributions are two-fold. First, building on pairwise off-policy evaluation, we derive the variance-optimal action-level logging policy for estimating the average treatment effect between two policies, which has a closed-form solution for any fixed control variate. Second, we use historical logs to jointly optimize the logging policy and a control variate to further reduce variance. Our experimental results in simulated policy A/B tests show that our designs estimate the average treatment effect more accurately than existing variance reduction methods on every evaluated setting, while generally improving statistical power and reducing how often the worse policy is selected. As a result, our designs enable practitioners to reach reliable deployment decisions with considerably less online traffic. 链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24283
作者: Alexander Ploshkin,Nikita Stepanov,Alexey Pismenny,Viacheslav Ovchinnikov,Nikolay Savushkin
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: Alexander Ploshkin, Nikita Stepanov and Alexey Pismenny contributed equally to this work

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Accurate click-through rate (CTR) prediction depends on user representations that capture both persistent preferences and recent intent, yet processing extensive behavioral histories for every ranking request is costly under production compute and latency constraints. We present X-split ARGUS, a framework for ad ranking whose history compressor and online ranker are trained end to end. The compressor encodes past interactions into a compact set of tokens that are computed offline and reused across candidates, while the online ranker scores ads through cross-attention to these tokens and representations of recent events. Training combines an autoregressive loss for click feedback with distillation of candidate-specific click logits from a larger teacher that scores each candidate using the uncompressed history. The number of compressed history tokens and the length of recent history can be adjusted to fit serving compute and latency budgets. Offline evaluation shows a 0.81% relative reduction in normalized entropy (NE) compared with the production baseline. Deployment in a large-scale real-time bidding system increases online inference cost by 15% relative to the production baseline. An online A/B test against this baseline yields relative gains of 4.65% in a business metric reflecting the monetary value of conversions generated for advertisers and 2.96% in clicks.

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Modern industrial recommender systems use multi-stage cascades–retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking–to narrow millions of candidates to a personalized list. While each stage deploys sophisticated models, pipeline-level decisions on channel activation, quotas, model selection, and score fusion remain engineer-tuned and user-agnostic within each scenario. This report presents MARS (Multi-stage Agentic Recommendation System), extending personalization from individual-stage predictions to full pipeline orchestration. A near-line agent built on fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B generates per-user configurations–a seven-dimensional action covering pipeline mode, retrieval quotas, model selection, fusion weights, and reranker settings–from a constrained action space. Configurations are validated, cached, and consumed asynchronously; the cascade never waits for LLM inference. Schema checks, fallbacks, and a kill switch ensure serving safety. The policy is trained in three stages: Confidence-aware SFT distills schema-valid generation from a teacher model; Format-Anchored Preference Optimization (FAPO) learns action preferences via ActionMask with posterior weighting; Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refines the policy through Sandbox replay with a frozen reward model, without exposing exploratory actions to live traffic. Two-week A/B tests across five Taobao scenarios with over ten million daily users show positive gains on all key metrics. The largest reach +5.22% V2P and +7.34% GMV, with positive CTR lifts on both click surfaces. About 20% of requests use a lightweight Minimal mode, and deployment shows 12 ms lower mean serving latency versus production. Abstract:CoT-style LLM recommenders generate a natural-language preference note as a chain-of-thought prefix to ranking, but the note is trusted without verification, and the ranker never consults behaviorally similar users. We propose ReflectRec, organized around a preference-to-history round-trip verifier whose recall score serves as an operational signal of preference-to-history recoverability, enabling conditional regeneration for low-recoverability preferences and selection among regeneration attempts. Around this verifier, we wire a semantic Stage-1 prompt, conditional regeneration, and Forward-Look retrieval that injects future watches of behaviorally similar users as a collaborative hint. On MovieLens-100K and MovieLens-1M, the full pipeline outperforms CoT4Rec-ICL by +16.25 / +4.46 pp Hit@10, with positive gains across all ValScore buckets and three LLM backbones (Qwen3-30B, Qwen2.5-72B, and Llama-3.3-70B). Abstract:Multimodal generative recommendation with discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs) requires distinguishing historical modalities that merely alter token predictions from those that genuinely reduce catalog-level ambiguity. When audiovisual, visual, or textual streams are missing, degraded, or semantically conflicting, uniform fusion and unconstrained token gates can propagate misleading content across iterative denoising steps. We propose CONCORD-Rec, a reliability-conditioned discrete diffusion recommender supervised by counterfactual catalog-partition utility. Given a fixed tokenizer and a partially masked SID state, CONCORD-Rec evaluates out-of-fold teacher coalitions over the exact feasible catalog support and aggregates item posteriors across the target code partition at each unresolved position. Rather than distilling raw token probabilities directly, the resulting counterfactual loss differences supervise an availability-masked tokenwise gate that allocates bounded modality residuals around a behavioral denoiser while retaining an exact behavioral fallback slot. We establish theoretical fixed-support ranking stability bounds under gate perturbations and evaluate position-level and code-conditional allocation across audiovisual and image-text recommendation benchmarks under controlled missingness, signal degradation, and semantic conflict. Across 20 source-compatible protocol-dataset rows, CONCORD-Rec improves NDCG by 4%; under matched 30% conflict it improves NDCG by 14.63%. The full-vs-uniform-T=16 sweep improves quality by 2.00-3.58% while reducing p95 latency by up to 86.89%.

Abstract:The growing volume of topically similar papers makes it difficult to identify new work that can offer useful research insights or methodological guidance. We present KnowMe Paper Radar, a lightweight discovery tool that combines multiple sources of evidence into personalized reading priorities. Users specify topics, priorities, exclusions and dates; the system brings together topical relevance, recency, author research histories, collaboration paths and direction-specific institutional context. By exposing each score component and its supporting sources, KnowMe helps readers select promising papers for their current questions and discover relevant work beyond familiar authors. Automatic acquisition, version merging and graph-cache reuse keep this workflow convenient without large language model (LLM) inference during ordinary use. Experiments on 174,640 acquired records show more than threefold faster repeated context preparation, while cached abstracts improve normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank 10 (NDCG@10) from 0.412 to 0.598 on expert-judged retrieval tasks. Complementary analyses examine how the same accumulated records support semantic retrieval, research-history modeling and literature-grounded planning. A browser interface and a structured command-line interface (CLI) make these capabilities available to both researchers and research agents, positioning KnowMe as a practical upstream tool for literature-informed recursive self-improvement (RSI) workflows.

作者: Shubing Yang,Xutong Liu,Dongfang Zhao
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Backward-compatible retrieval enables a new encoder to query the gallery that an old model has already encoded, so that a cross-modal retrieval system can be upgraded without re-encoding billions of items. Existing compatible methods either fit the old query and stay near the accuracy of the old model, or run the old and the new encoder for every query. We propose VIBRA, which matches relevance on the old gallery, corrects the errors of a single model with the barycenter of several views, which is itself a query in the old space, and trains the new encoder to inherit this consensus, so that models absent at deployment still shape every query. We show that the barycenter gains margin over the average of its views exactly when their hardest irrelevant items differ, and we characterize the share of this gain that one encoder can reach. On five benchmarks with five upgrades among six CLIP, MetaCLIP and SigLIP2 backbones, VIBRA is the best compatible method in all 50 settings, improving Recall@1 by up to 5.6 points over the strongest baseline and by up to 18.0 points over the old model, while adding less than 1 ms to the latency of the new encoder.

Abstract:Criminal court records are often fragmented, noisy, and siloed, making it challenging for both legal experts and community stakeholders to access and analyze court data to identify trends and provide public oversight. In this paper, we introduce a system for data ingestion, harmonization, and dashboard visualization designed for New Orleans criminal court proceedings data, aimed at both expert and lay audiences. Our system collects and harmonizes disparate data, generates case trajectories, and provides intuitive visualization techniques based on community feedback to analyze demographics, temporal trends, and specific case events. We demonstrate the system through an exploratory analysis of recent short-term trends and policy impacts within New Orleans, illustrating how it can support the investigation of anomalies, policy changes, and procedural irregularities. We also present feedback from a small formative study of community stakeholders who have helped co-design and use the system, suggesting that it may improve access to and interpretation of local court data.

Abstract:Access to large-scale clinical text collections is crucial for advancing medical information retrieval research, including clinical note search, patient cohort identification, and domain-adapted retrieval models. However, real clinical notes are rarely available due to privacy regulations, which particularly limits progress for low-resource languages such as European Portuguese. We present LusoClin, a publicly released dataset of synthetic clinical notes in European Portuguese, created to support privacy-preserving research on clinical text retrieval. LusoClin was generated by pre-processing real clinical data, fine-tuning the open-source Llama 3.2 (3B) instruction-tuned model using Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation, and applying prompt-based clinical note generation. To facilitate semantic indexing and clinical search, the notes are automatically annotated with clinical entities using a BERT-based model. We evaluate LusoClin in terms of utility, fidelity, diversity, and privacy using automatic metrics and human evaluation. Results indicate that the dataset captures clinically relevant language patterns and can support downstream IR applications such as clinical document retrieval and domain-specific model adaptation, although annotators can often distinguish synthetic from real notes and some medical inconsistencies persist.

Abstract:A single academic vacancy can draw hundreds of applications, and the first screening round consumes most of a committee’s time. We describe a CV Priority Sorter deployed at a national platform for academic vacancies and integrated with its vacancy database. It proposes a reading order for a pile of CVs and leaves every decision to the committee, pairing a frozen multilingual transformer encoder with a per-session linear model that retrains after each label and is discarded when the session ends. It works: on a pool of 300 synthetic CVs, a committee reading in the tool’s order reaches 95% of the relevant candidates after half the pile, where an arbitrary order needs almost all of it. This paper is about what we found when we audited that claim, rather than about the system itself. Three findings changed the product. The pool turned out to be sortable by document length alone, which makes precision-style metrics on it uninformative; regenerating it under a shared length budget removes that shortcut and leaves the reading-depth result standing. The four-level agreement score such systems report, ours included, is a binary probability cut at fixed thresholds, so it follows the classifier’s confidence rather than its ranking and falls as labels accumulate. And uncertainty sampling, the obvious way to implement a “suggest the next CV” button, leaves model quality intact but raises the committee’s total reading load above the no-label baseline, because the CVs it asks about are the ones that would otherwise be skipped. A fourth result shows where to look next: a hosted LLM embedding model lifts zero-label ordinal discrimination from 0.66 to 0.80 under length control, then stops mattering once the session model has two dozen labels; a local cross-encoder matches that cold-start gain without sending data out. We report the fixes each finding forced.

Abstract:LLM-enhanced recommender systems encode item side information into semantic embeddings, but these embeddings may leak sensitive textual attributes through inversion attacks. Existing input-side defenses rely on trusted collection or local token perturbation, often disrupting the inter-item semantic topology needed for recommendation. To address it, we introduce relational fidelity as the key objective, requiring semantic shift for privacy while preserving relative item relations for utility. Based on this principle, we propose prototype-guided progressive obfuscation (PGPO), which learns topology-aware obfuscation anchors for high-influence prototype words and propagates them through a static semantic graph. PGPO is optimized with GRPO using individual dissimilarity, structural consistency, and semantic constraint rewards. Experiments on two benchmarks show strong inversion defense with near-upper-bound recommendation performance. The code is available at this https URL.

Abstract:Measuring inter-node distances is the basis for network localization, whereas acquiring node positions does not require a fully connected graph of distances. Existing complete-ranging protocols for network localization require every node pair to exchange signals, which prolongs the ranging cycle. In this paper, we propose sparse signal-multiplexing network ranging (S-SM-NR), a task-oriented framework that adapts the transmit-listen schedule to the ranging task required by network localization. First, we establish the S-SM-NR framework by formulating the joint design of the task graph and the transmit-listen schedule. Then, we analyze the minimum round count required by S-SM-NR and establish a connectivity condition for network localization. Subsequently, we develop a closed-form joint design that constructs the sparse task graph and the balanced transmit-listen schedule. In particular, the joint design can achieve the minimum round count under the complete physical connectivity. Finally, simulations show that the proposed S-SM-NR scheme reduces the occupied-round count and improves the localization accuracy by shortening the ranging cycle.

[HC-0] Knowing What You Know: A Trait Theory of Reviewer Value in Human-AI Cognitive Systems

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24932
作者: Priyanka Sinha,Sugam Pandey
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computational Engineering, Finance, and Science (cs.CE); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted at the Thirteenth Annual Conference on Advances in Cognitive Systems (ACS), Edinburgh, United Kingdom, October 6-9, 2026. Awarded one of 2026 Ada Lovelace Awardees for Excellent Paper Submissions to ACS

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When a capable model and a human reviewer cooperate on the same decision, which human still adds value? We argue this is a question about a single cognitive trait, metacognitive calibration: the alignment between a reviewer’s behavioral confidence and the actual correctness of their judgments. We develop a trait theory of reviewer value to make it precise. The theory makes five claims: value is governed by calibration rather than by activity, speed, agreement, or tenure; calibration leaves observable traces in behavioral telemetry; those traces are non-diagnostic on their own, because the fast, low-revision signature of a calibrated expert is indistinguishable from that of a confident novice until it is gated by outcomes; human calibration and a model’s self-knowledge are the same construct, so the joint system should defer to whichever agent is better calibrated on each item; and individual calibration is causally identifiable only above the level of the single judgment. We ground each claim in a six-month production window of an AI-assisted accounting system (541621 reviewer events, 483 reviewers), and find that a purely behavioral expertise profile inverts the ground truth, scoring an overconfident cohort (5.2 percent correction survival) higher than genuine experts (99.2 percent); that reviewer quality is flat across tenure, so the trait is not learned on the job; and that the same calibration logic that separates good from bad reviewers, applied to the model, concentrates 92.5 percent of human effort on genuine errors. We close with the boundary the theory must respect: under majority-vote aggregation, individual causal value is unidentifiable.

Abstract:Large Language Models (LLMs) now perform strongly on Alan Turing’s 1950 Imitation Game, so we propose a harder challenge, the Personal Imitation Game, which asks whether a machine can replicate a specific individual in conversation rather than a generic human. Testing with 30 participants, we establish a human baseline and report the identity signals interrogators rely on: stylometric features, personality traits, and biographical facts. To demonstrate the framework, we design an LLM-based system that plays the game for one of the paper’s authors, drawing on an autoethnographic dataset spanning ten years of personal digital communication. In a 20-person deception study, interrogators choose our system over the author’s own friends in 7 of 10 rounds, and the author over our system in 13 of 20; neither rate is distinguishable from chance at this sample size. We consider design improvements, applications of personal AI agents, and implications for identity and privacy.

类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Intelligent Information Systems (Springer Nature)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Explainable AI (XAI) is frequently applied to high-stakes tabular data, yet the field relies heavily on feature attribution methods. While these approaches offer technical transparency, evaluating dozens of isolated features demands excessive cognitive effort from non-expert users. In this paper, we argue that prototypes remain overlooked and underutilized, and should be integrated as a complementary, intuitive gateway to auditing complex machine learning models. Although entire exemplars function as an intuitive baseline for prototype-based explanations, we highlight prototypical parts as particularly valuable for tabular data. By grouping related features into bounded subspaces, prototypical parts technically embody human-understandable concepts, replacing isolated features with cohesive semantic units. We support this integration through two primary lenses. Cognitively, these parts align with Rosch’s categorization theory and Kahneman’s System 1 thinking to naturally reduce cognitive load for humans. Then, we introduce a Geometric Validity Triad to conceptualize why prototypes validate the data manifold - a critical dimension often neglected by existing methods. We contend that making tabular XAI genuinely comprehensible requires shifting toward composite explanation pipelines that pair intuitive similarity-based reasoning with rigorous feature-level auditing. The paper concludes by outlining open challenges of prototype-based methods and discussing potential solutions to guide future research.

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to infer psychological attributes, predict individual behaviour, and simulate human populations. However, despite generating plausible responses, they often misrepresent individuals and distort population statistics. Here we introduce Chiron, a foundation model to measure and predict human behaviour. We jointly fine-tune an LLM to represent psychological constructs, predict individual behaviour, and align population response distributions with human statistics. The training and evaluation data span 36 behavioural domains and 78 social science experiments, comprising 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 atomic behavioural decisions, and 99,953 psychometric assessments over 109 psychological constructs. In our evaluations, Chiron’s psychological measurements agree more closely with human self-reports and exhibit fewer biases that undermine psychometric validity. It predicts individual behaviour more accurately than frontier LLMs (up to 28.4% relative improvement). In simulations of social science experiments, it more accurately captures the direction and magnitude of human experimental effects (82.2–94.3% lower effect-size estimation error). Together, these results establish Chiron as a unified computational instrument for measuring and predicting human behaviour.

Abstract:Deep brain stimulation (DBS) effectively treats motor symptoms of Parkinson’s disease (PD), but it is unclear whether it changes fine hand movements in the same way for every patient. We analyzed 35 sessions of 19 patients with PD from a multi-center cohort performing the CopyDraw task, a drawing task designed to overcome the subjectivity and limited granularity of clinical assessments. Besides standard kinematics (mean velocity, acceleration, jerk, and drawing accuracy), we derived higher distributional moments and non-linear complexity measures, for 38 features in total. DBS effects were quantified with linear mixed models at the group level and with residualized regression and a random-effects meta-analysis per session. The DBS state was decoded per session with regularized linear discriminant analysis to compare feature sets as behavioral labels for deriving physiomarkers for adaptive DBS (aDBS). DBS modulated all 38 features at the group level, most strongly velocity-related features. However, for every feature, the between-subject variability of the DBS effect exceeded the group-level effect. Only one feature, the detrended fluctuation analysis of the distance to the template, showed a significant mean effect across sessions, and it is not a standard kinematic feature. In six sessions without any significant modulation of standard features, complexity measures were modulated instead. For decoding, standard features alone were the best choice in ten of 35 sessions, but combining all 38 features yielded the highest average area under the ROC curve (0.700 vs. 0.677), with the largest gains in sessions that were hard to decode from standard features. DBS effects on hand-motor behavior are individual. Deriving neural markers for aDBS from behavior therefore requires session-specific analyses with individualized features beyond standard kinematics and group-level effects.

Abstract:Closed-loop neuromodulation uses a physiomarker to control stimulation. Developing such controllers requires exploring a large space of strategies and parameters, which is often not feasible with the human-in-the-loop. Simulation environments offer an alternative. Adaptive deep brain stimulation (aDBS) for Parkinson’s disease is a stereotypical application: while physiomarker identification progresses rapidly, clinically available control is limited to threshold and proportional strategies. We propose to identify dynamical models of the brain with and without deep brain stimulation (DBS) using the sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) framework. Identified ex post from existing recordings, such models are a middle ground between abstract bottom-up models and the realistic but difficult-to-access human-in-the-loop. Forecasting neural activity from real initial conditions, the models create a simulation environment for “what if” analyses of DBS changes. In a proof-of-concept with EEG data from a single subject, we train and evaluate threshold, proportional, proportional-integral-derivative (PID), and proximal policy optimization (PPO) control, aiming to have the simulated data classified as DBS ON at minimal energy. SINDy models fitted on spatially filtered EEG maintained DBS condition-specific characteristics. All aDBS controllers delivered DBS more efficiently than continuous DBS (cDBS), with up to 20.2% energy reduction. Proportional control yielded a small but significant gain over threshold control. PID and PPO achieved a comparable reward advantage over cDBS, with PPO stimulating more conservatively and PID saving the most energy. The approach thus proved feasible, and within this simulation environment, PID control is a strong a-priori choice, while the benefit of deep reinforcement learning may only emerge with richer physiomarker signals.

Abstract:Characteristics of Artificial Intelligence (AI) severely restrict human control. Drawing from human factors and AI governance literature, expert interviews and participant observation in a complex high-risk AI use case from the railways, we developed ALIGN, a scenario-based method that supports the governance of and stakeholder involvement in AI development and implementation in three ways: raising awareness for potential accountability-control misalignments in socio-technical systems and their negative consequences, offering a structured approach to assessing the alignment between accountability and control for stakeholders in a given use case, and supporting effective design decisions to mitigate AI risks. Abstract:This project analysed daily emotional well-being from a personalized perspective using records of emotional states and contextual information derived from daily life. It was based on the idea that well-being is not a fixed value, but varies from day to day, and can be better understood in relation to individual context and behaviour. The work is framed within the field of Data Science and focuses on emotional states at an individual level. The project focused on constructing an integrated daily dataset from multiple personal data sources and analysing emotional states. The distributions of emotional variables, their temporal evolution and the differences between users were studied, together with their variability over time. Personality and well-being questionnaires were also incorporated as stable references to better contextualize daily emotional results. A simple personalized recommendation approach was then developed by comparing similar days within each user, exploring how past contextual conditions relate to differences in the user’s emotional state. Finally, machine learning techniques were used to evaluate whether daily contextual information contains signals that help distinguish between different types of days relative to a person’s usual well-being. The project adopted an applied approach, with an exploratory scope focused on understanding patterns rather than building a fully predictive system. The results showed that emotional well-being is very personal and changes from day to day. General models had limited value, while personalized approaches captured these differences much better, highlighting the importance of analysing each person on their own terms.

Abstract:AI tools can generate code quickly, but developers still need to understand and check the results. We explore how the enriched multimodal context derived from the extended reality (XR) workspace might help developers manage this information. We first interviewed 13 experts in AI, XR, and related fields to identify opportunities and design challenges (Study 1). These interviews informed two prototypes explored with 12 professional developers (Study 2): four tried a version where the code faded to become invisible after it was looked at, and eight tried a version that replaced viewed code sections with short descriptions of their purpose. In the second prototype, head direction helped determine when to offer a change, while manual input let developers apply it and reopen the original code. A separate open-ended demonstration with seven software-engineering researchers provided complementary feedback. Participants’ accounts suggested that descriptions could provide an overview of unfamiliar code and serve as reminders when revisiting it. However, difficulty comparing descriptions with source code, headset limitations, and controls that deviates from regular IDE routines could introduce additional effort. These exploratory findings identify requirements for attention support: make summaries easy to recognize and access, preserve straightforward inspection of the original code, and retain familiar navigation and editing practices. The study contributes to human-centered multimodal systems by showing how the coordination of input channels and AI-generated representations must account for users’ attention, verification needs, and established ways of working.

Abstract:AI coding agents increasingly manage what context carries across sessions and projects, but developers have limited visibility into what these agents store, retrieve, and apply. This opacity creates a metamemory problem: the developer’s meta-level judgments about what should be remembered are separated from the agent’s object-level memory operations, disrupting the monitoring and control that keep the two levels aligned. We conducted a formative study with 12 developers and identified what they want to monitor and control across four dimensions of agent memory use. Based on these findings, we designed MemoSync, a co-management system that treats agent memory as a shared, operable representation: the agent proposes memory candidates and reports which items it uses, and the developer reviews, edits, and scopes them. In a between-subjects study (N=132) against two baselines, MemoSync participants achieved significantly higher task performance and the highest mean developer-agent memory alignment. In an exploratory mediation analysis, the alignment advantage was primarily driven by improved monitoring accuracy. Despite performing substantially more monitoring and control actions, participants reported no increase in perceived workload. A week-long deployment with nine developers showed that memory monitoring and control fit into everyday development work. MemoSync is open-sourced at this https URL.

[HC-14] Human-LLM Cognitive Extension: A Framework for Studying Coupled Cognition

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24149

类目: Computers and Society (cs.CY); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)

Abstract:Recent research on the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) reports divergent cognitive outcomes, including improved assisted performance, limited transfer, and compromised unaided learning. Here, we argue that part of this seeming inconsistency arises because studies often assess different cognitive systems without making the unit of analysis explicit. Building on work in extended and distributed cognition, we propose the Human-LLM Cognitive Extension (HLCE) as a methodological framework for matching experimental designs, measures, and causal inferences to four distinct systems: the human acting independently, the artificial agent, the joined human-LLM configuration, and the human after division. The framework also treats the coupling architecture as part of the experimental object. HLCE separates performance augmentation, system-level complementarity, post-interaction human change, and stronger claims of constitutive cognitive integration. This separation can improve the interpretation of existing evidence and guide the design of human-LLM interactions without assuming in advance that these configurations constitute extended minds. We illustrate the application of HLCE with a synthetic diagnostic experiment comparing two connecting configurations that differ in how supporting information is communicated. The example highlights how distinct couplings can shape the organization of joint problem-solving, even when the final outcome remains unchanged. Overall, HLCE provides a methodological basis for designing controlled experiments and interpreting evidence across distinct forms of human-LLM cognitive interaction.

Abstract:In many robot telepresence interfaces, movement and viewing are managed through handheld inputs. This can divide attention between steering, looking, and inspection. We compared joystick versus omnidirectional treadmill locomotion and joystick-based versus head-guided camera control in a within-subject 2x2 study in which 17 participants used a virtual reality headset to guide a quadruped robot through a physical maze while locating marked wall symbols and capturing them as visual evidence. Mixed-effects analyses showed that head-guided camera control was associated with faster completion, lower wall-contact cost, lower workload, and more favorable presence, usability, technology acceptance, and flow than joystick-based camera control. The strongest overall objective performance was observed in the joystick locomotion plus head-guided camera condition, whereas the omnidirectional treadmill plus head-guided camera condition emerged as the strongest experiential compromise. Exploratory camera analyses showed that head-guided camera control reduced switching, increased reliance on the pan-tilt view, and supported a more stable viewing strategy across the maze. These strategy differences were consistent with the performance advantage, especially for wall-contact duration. Targets captured remained near ceiling and simulator sickness remained low across all conditions. Overall, the results indicate that viewpoint control was the stronger differentiator in this combined navigation and inspection task, while locomotion still shaped the objective and experiential tradeoff.

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Animating virtual opponents is an important yet challenging task in game development. In martial arts games, opponent motions must not only be physically plausible but also exhibit appropriate technique, timing, transitions, and target-directed intent. Traditional game animations often rely on handcrafted clips, state machine transitions, and procedural adjustments, which can be labor-intensive and may limit the behavioral diversity of non-player characters. This paper presents a martial arts motion skills learning framework for character animation in virtual sparring games. Inspired by Tang Soo Do, we collected a martial arts motion capture dataset containing isolated attacking and defending techniques, technique combinations and transitions, and contextual sparring variations. We first pretrained a reusable repertoire of martial arts motion skills from the captured data using reinforcement learning (RL) with adversarial style rewards, and then adapted these skills with task-specific rewards for target-directed striking and threat-aware evasion. We evaluated the motions generated by the learned policy through a user study, in which participants assessed their physical plausibility, smoothness, and martial arts form. To demonstrate their applicability to interactive gameplay, we developed a VR sparring prototype for Meta Quest headsets. The prototype combines policy-generated motion clips with lightweight state-based control to support interactive opponent behavior. Together, these findings support the feasibility of using a learned martial arts skill repertoire as a motion foundation for animating opponents in VR sparring games.

[HC-17] MEM-STRESS: Longitudinal Field Study of a Wearable-Informed AI Chatbot for Stress Management

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23691
作者: Soorya Ram Shimgekar,Pragya Singh,Shivam Sharma,Chandrayee Roy,Koustuv Saha,Antti Oulasvirta,Talayeh Aledavood

Abstract:Stress is an increasingly prevalent concern, creating a need for accessible and personalized support. Stress-management chatbots primarily rely on what users report, which may not capture their physiological changes. Wearables capture these changes, but chatbots rarely use them as memory across conversations. We therefore present MEM-STRESS, a stress-support chatbot that turns a wearable ring’s physiological data into a layered memory of daily records, baseline deviations, LLM-generated summaries, and uses it to drive multi-session conversations grounded in Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT). In a four-week, non-randomized study with 60 adults, we compared MEM-STRESS (Treatment) with a chatbot remembering only past conversations (Control). Memory shaped the conversations: The Treatment chatbot referenced participants’ physiological features (e.g., activity in 71.8% of sessions) and suggested more body-related DBT skills than Control (14.5% vs. 5.7%), with Treatment participants also using slightly more body-related words (1.76% vs. 1.45%). Treatment participants praised personalization three times as often (44.4% vs. 14.3%), more frequently reported reflecting differently on stress (69.0% vs. 46.4%, not significant), and described gaining insight into their stress signals. Their perceived stress fell 14.2% from baseline versus 3.6% for Control, though the group difference was not significant. Grounding stress-support chatbots in layered physiological memory is thus feasible and may improve perceived personalization, motivating larger randomized studies. Abstract:Wearable EEG inference is constrained not only by model size, but also by the channel-dependent sensing front end that must process high-dimensional inputs before compact downstream computation. We present EEG2MCU, a sensing-to-execution co-design framework that treats electrode count as a hardware design variable through task-aware montage selection. EEG2MCU retains a compact time-frequency representation and generates only the INT8 regions required by each first-layer tile, avoiding full input materialization. Halo reuse and access-aware placement across Flash, SRAM, and tightly coupled memory further reduce redundant generation and data movement. On a Cortex-M7 MCU, EEG2MCU reduces peak SRAM by 11.38x relative to the baseline, including a 1.71x reduction from the 62-to-19 electrode montage, while reducing latency by 2.57x and energy by 2.48x. It retains 94-96% of full-montage accuracy, demonstrating practical high-dimensional EEG inference under tight embedded-resource constraints.

[HC-19] Miscalibrated AI improves human calibration: An alignment problem for AI-assisted Decision education

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23618
作者: Phillip C. Hegeman,Eeshan Hasan,Eungik Lee,Andrew Caplin,Jennifer S. Trueblood
类目: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注: 15 page paper, 4 paper figures, 21 page supplement, 1 supplemental figure

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Using artificial intelligence (AI) well requires probabilistic thinking, and central to it is calibration: expressing certainty that matches one’s actual accuracy. Calibration is a decision skill, but a notoriously difficult one to teach. Because AI systems typically generate a probability alongside every prediction, observing these probabilities may help humans learn to provide better calibrated judgments. This is one form of what we call AI-assisted decision education – using AI to teach the judgment skills that decision-making requires – of which learning by observation, as here, is among the simplest forms. In a preregistered experiment, novice participants (N = 300) judged the probability that images of white blood cells were cancerous, before and after exposure to a highly accurate (94%) convolutional neural network. A single model was shown in three ways, holding accuracy fixed while varying the certainty it expressed: its original probabilities, which were conservative and poorly calibrated for the model’s accuracy; a recalibrated version, well calibrated for the model and correspondingly certain; or categorical predictions carrying no probability information. When later tested without the AI, only the original, conservative display improved participants’ calibration. It did so by reducing over-extremity, without a condition-specific improvement in discrimination. Notably, the display that taught best was the one miscalibrated for the model. AI-assisted decision education therefore faces an alignment problem: the signal that best describes a model, need not be the signal that best supports the learner.

[HC-20] Smart Glasses for Ubiquitous Computing: A Layered Survey and the Road Ahead

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23534
作者: Linlu Gao,Yueyuan Sui,Junxi Xia,Xin Liu,Stephen Xia,Yang Liu
类目: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We conduct a systematic survey of smart-glasses research for ubiquitous computing. Our search covers work published from 2020 to October 2026, with selected earlier work included for historical context. After screening and title-level deduplication, we identify 163 smart-glasses papers and separately compile related resources, including 14 representative hardware platforms, their associated software tools and pretrained models, and 10 datasets. We organize this literature through four complementary layers. Research Resources covers hardware platforms, software tools and models, and datasets that support development and evaluation. Sensing Perception examines how glasses measure and interpret information about users and their surroundings. Interaction Assistance addresses how users express intentions and receive feedback and assistance. Applications situates these contributions in tasks and use contexts. Energy, latency, wearability, reliability, privacy, security, and social acceptability are treated as deployment constraints across all four layers. This framework provides a unified view of current research and a vision for how advances across the four layers could come together to support smart glasses as a ubiquitous computing platform. Building on this synthesis, we outline research directions for extending capabilities across tasks and over time, supporting assistance under human control, and achieving reliable, efficient, and sustained everyday use.

[HC-21] RummiAlgebra: A Polynomial Representation Framework for Game-Based Algebra Learning with Jokers

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23443
作者: Luis Adrián Lizama-Pérez
类目: Computers and Society (cs.CY); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)
备注: 15 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Software: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Connecting symbolic expressions to manipulable objects is a recurring challenge in introductory algebra. This paper presents RummiAlgebra, a design-oriented framework and browser-based prototype that maps a Rummikub-style tile-rearrangement task to polynomial addition, common-factor extraction, finite geometric sums, and context-dependent substitution. A numbered colored tile is encoded as a monomial c x^v, while a physical joker is represented by a distinct symbol J_i whose algebraic role is fixed only for a particular candidate arrangement. We define admissible polynomial forms for runs and groups and establish an inventory-conservation invariant. A soundness-and-completeness proof shows that physical-tile accounting together with the algebraic run/group templates characterizes valid final arrangements under the stated classroom rules; polynomial equality alone is insufficient. Four detailed examples illustrate decomposition, competing factorizations, one- and two-joker substitutions, and optimization as an optional extension. A targeted review distinguishes the approach from established Rummikub solvers, Rummikub-inspired arithmetic-sequence activities, algebra-tile manipulatives, and polynomial games. The prototype implements six small challenges and a separate rule-and-expression checker; their optimal scores were checked against an independent exhaustive reference enumerator. These checks establish agreement for the examples but do not establish learning effectiveness or novelty of the underlying algebraic operations. We close with a classroom sequence, assessment constructs, and a controlled evaluation protocol. The claimed contribution is a formally specified pedagogical correspondence and an interactive proof-oriented activity, not a new asymptotically faster Rummikub solver.

[CV-0] UltraTex: Aligning Physical Knowledge for High-Fidelity PBR Texture Generation SIGGRAPH

作者: Jingzhi Bao,Xiaohe Ma,Hong Li,Yuanming Hu,Xiaoguang Han
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注: Accepted to ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026). Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generating physically based rendering (PBR) texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image is highly ambiguous, as the observed appearance entangles material identity, surface reflectance, and illumination. While current generative methods produce realistic albedo maps, they still struggle to infer accurate metallic and roughness attributes for relighting. We present UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework that moves beyond appearance matching by integrating physical knowledge into multi-view diffusion-based PBR generation. UltraTex first jointly predicts albedo and world-space shading normals to generate more detailed albedo maps, and then predicts metallic-roughness (MR) maps conditioned on the generated albedo, reference image, and material semantic priors. To inject material semantics, a lightweight adapter transforms hidden-layer features of a vision-language model (VLM) into intrinsic material representation tokens, providing part-level knowledge anchors for MR estimation. To model material-light interaction, photometric representation alignment guides intermediate diffusion features toward ground-truth material renderings under controlled lighting. This makes metallic and roughness variations observable through highlight intensity, specular sharpness, and local reflectance contrast, providing stronger guidance for fine-grained material prediction without explicit lighting supervision. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates high-quality textures and outperforms existing open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility.
